tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sam+baratrohas+ya.apanahitasukhabāṇabiharatisma/ // /༄༅/ /bde mchog bstod chen gyi rang 'grel phan bde'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i stod cha bzhugs/
༄༅/ /sam+baratrohas+ya.apanahitasukhabāṇabiharatisma/ // /༄༅/ /bde mchog bstod chen gyi rang 'grel phan bde'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i stod cha bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa m+ba ra tro ha s+ya a pa na hi ta su kha bā ṇa bi har ti sma// //༄༅/ /bde mchog bstod chen gyi rang 'grel phan bde'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i stod cha bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdaum pa'i bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi rgya cher bshad pa/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa rig sngags 'chang mtha' dag gi nges pa'i tshig sbas pa'i don ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa phan bde'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'gyur med ye shes kyis/ /srid gsum gnas 'di kun khyab par/ /gsal mdzad bla ma rje btsun la/ /rtag tu spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab gsal dri med mtshan dpe'i 'od 'bar in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po ltar/ /mthon ka'i 'od kyi drwa ba 'gyed cing dpag yas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor spro/ /bde chen ye shes nyams brgya'i rol pas shes bya kun la rtag rol ba/ /bla ma he ru ka yi zhabs rdul phreng ba spyi bor 'dzin gyur cig /rab dmar 'char ka gsal ba'i 'od kyi drwa bas khebs shing bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /'chi med na chung bde chen bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin mnyen lcugs sku/ /'dod chags chen pos rnam par rol mkhas rgyal ba kun la bde sbyin ma/ /rdo rje btsun mor dngos kun rab 'dud bdag kyang bdag po'i sar 'god mdzod/ /bla ma'i zhal lung las thob ye shes kyis/ /rab bos rnal 'byor ma kun dga' bskyed pa/ /chos kun snying po len mkhas 'gro rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tshor rdo rje 'dzin gang rgyal gyur cig /rgyud don shin tu rgya che gang yin pa/ /blo dman rnams kyis bde blag rtogs phyir dang*/ /bdag gzhan bsod nams rgya cher spel ba'i phyir/ /rab tu rgyas pa'i rgyun bshags bdag gis spel/ /gzhung nyung ba la don mang ba/ /skye bo rnams kyis go phyir dang*/ / slob ma yis ni gsol btab nas/ /slar yang de don bshad par 'dod/ /'di la don bcu ste/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang sgom pa dang*/

chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ sdom bzung lam bsten pa dang bcas pa dang*/ yongs su bsngo ba'o/ /de la phyag 'tshal ba ni bstod pa'i mchod pa yin te/ de'i phyir yan lag logs su ma bgrangs kyang rung ste/ de ltar na de la phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa gnyis so/ /'on kyang snga ma ltar bshad na/ dang po la bstod yul ngos bzung ba/ de la bsod nams bsags pa'i phan yon/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa/ de rnams kyi don bsdu ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bstod bya'i yul slob dpon dang rdo rje 'chang dbyer med pa la'o/ /de la yon tan ci mnga' na/ rang don tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pa dang*/ gzhan don gyi dbang du byas na/ srid pa gsum gyi sems can rnams dang zhi ba'i 'gro ba nyan rang dgra bcom pa kun gyi yon tan thams cad bskyed par mdzad pas dpal dang*/ srid zhi'i mtha' las skyob pas mgon dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dren par mdzad pas 'dren pa'i mchog ces pa'o/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka'i dbang du byas nas sku gsum gyi yon tan mnga' ba ste/ zab mo stong pa nyid dang*/ gsal ba sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i skur bstan zhing chos gsung pa ste/ de gnyis ngo bo dbye ba med pas ni zab gsal dbyer med kyi sku ste sprul sku yin no/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs la sogs pas rtogs par mi nus shing*/ so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kho na'i spyod yul yin pas sam/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi bde ba chen po 'di lta bu gzhan med pas na dpe med pa zhes bya/ bde ba chen po de nyid kyi rang snang lha skur rdzogs pas bde rdzogs te longs spyod rdzogs sku'am dpe med bde rdzogs kyi sku yin no/ /dga' ba thams cad kyi rab tu gyur pas rab dga' ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po mthar thug pa de nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i stong pa nyid la ro mnyam du zhugs pa'am bde ba des nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos thams cad kyi kun rdzob rgyu 'bras dang*/

don dam stong pa nyid gcig char mkhyen pas rab dga' mkha' mnyam gy-i sku'am chos sku zhes bya ste/ de rnams kyi don bsdus pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sku gsum brnyes te sems can gyi don mdzad pa la bstod do zhes tshigs bcad 'di mchod par brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rtsom par dam bca' ba yin te/ bstod pa'i phan yon/ bsten pa'i phan yon/ bsgoms pa'i phan yon/ phan yon de dang ldan pa'i yul la bstod pa dam 'cha' ba ste/ re re la yang tshig rkang pa re re sbyar ro/ /gsum pa la rten gyi dkyil 'khor spyi dang*/ gtso bo yab yum dang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi thod pa dang bcas pa ste 'dab ma'i lha dang*/ bde chen 'khor lo la thugs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gsung gi 'khor lo dang*/ sku'i 'khor lo dang*/ de gsum gyi spyi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang*/ 'khor lo thams cad kyi spyi'i chos dang*/ lus dkyil dang*/ gzhal yas khang gi khyad par rnams dang*/ dur khrod pa la bstod pa rnams so/ /'o na bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la bstod par mi byed dam zhe na/ so so'i bgegs rnams 'joms la 'dud ces bya bas don gyi 'phangs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du gzhal yas khang bshad pas de'i gdan sna tshogs rdo rje dang pad+ma'ang zhor la bstan no/ /'on kyang 'di dag tshig gis zin na ci ma rung snyam na/ ye shes gzhal yas khang la bstod/ /ces pa'i mjug tu/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'jig tshogs la/ /lta 'joms nyi dkyil ye shes dang*/ /skyon bral sna tshogs pad+ma ste/ /thabs shes gzhal yas khang gi gdan/ /phyi rol rdo rje'i sa gzhi gur/ /rwa ba 'obs dang phur bu dang*/ /bka' yi 'khor lo me dpung bcas/ /bdud dpung ma lus 'joms la bstod/ /ces bton te tshig gtso bor byed pa rnams yi rang bar byos shig /de la dang po ni/ 'byung bzhi'i zhes sogs te gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dag pa yin no/

/ji skad du/ dbang po lnga sogs sems gang yin/ /rwa ba lngar ni 'byung ba nyid/ /ces dang*/ rta babs ka ba bzhi po ni/ /yang dag spong ba zhes su brjod/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi po ni/ kha khyer bzhir ni brjod par bya/ /sgo 'khyud bzhi ni gang yin pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi/ /de bzhin me tog phreng brgyan pa/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po yin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do/ / zhes pa ltar te/ dbang po lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rtsig pa de gong nas gong du brtsegs pa ni stobs lnga mtshon pa yin pas/ de ltar byang phyogs so bdun gyi rang bzhin no/ /'di man chad kyi tshig don phal cher ni go sla zhing*/ cung zad dka' ba rnams dkrol bar bya'o/ /ye shes sogs ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid byang phyogs so bdun gyi ldog pa'i chas phye ba gzhal yas khang du sprul zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la yab la bstod pa/ yum la bstod pa/ yab yum gnyis char la bstod pa gsum las/ dang po la rigs ni rigs lnga dang brgya la sogs pa'o/ /bcom ldan ni bdud bzhi bcom pa dang ldan pa'am skal pa drug dang ldan pa'o/ /kun tu bzang po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de ltar mdor bstan zin nas slar rgyas par 'chad pa ni/ gti mug zhes sogs te nyi mas mun pa bsal te 'od zer gyis khyab par byed pa bzhin du ye shes kyi snang bas gti mug spangs pa'o/ /mthing ka ste nag po ni mdog sgyur du mi rung ba bzhin du chos nyid stong pa nyid kyang 'gyur ba med pa'o/ /rnam thar bzhi ni/ slob dpon chen po ye shes zhabs kyis/ ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa kun dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /zhes gsum gsungs pa ltar ram/ 'og nas 'byung ba cung zad ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba zhig kyang ste/ de dag kyang stong pa nyid dang*/

mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas pa ste rim pa bzhin du/ ngo bo rang bzhin med pa dang*/ rgyu rang bzhin med pa dang*/ 'bras bu rang bzhin med pa dang*/ las nyon dang rigs 'dras gsar du 'dus byas pa med pa rnams so/ /zhabs g.yas bde ba chen po dang*/ thugs rje dang bsod nams kyi tshogs mtshon pas thabs kyi rang bzhin no/ /g.yon rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba dang ye shes kyi tshogs mtshon pas shes rab bo/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ chags thogs med par mkhyen pa ste spyan gsum ni de rnam par dag pa'o/ /phyag bcu gnyis rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags pa zhes sbyar te/ rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyod ni gzhan du shes par bya bas 'dir mi 'bri'o/ /bcu gnyis 'gyur ba med pa zhes pa la rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'gags pa dang*/ khams dmar po'i bsgrod pa bcu gnyis 'gyur ba med par byas pa dang*/ yang na rten brten pa bcu gnyis 'gyur ba med par byas pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes sbyar ro/ /yang dag ting 'dzin zhes bya ba ni/ gtso bo byang chub phyogs chos dang sbyar ba ste/ de yang rgyud las/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /zhes 'byung ba yum yang de nyid dag par go dgos pa dang*/ lhag ma so drug rnal 'byor ma rnams kho na la sbyar ba'ang yab yum dbyer med kyi dbang du byas pa ste/ yum gyi dag pa bstan pas de dang de'i yab kyang go ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /ye shes lnga mnyam pa ste ro gcig pa ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dril bus mtshon pa yin no/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar 'khyud rgya mdzad pa ni sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa mtshon no/ /glang po che ni gti mug mtshon zhing*/ de'i pags pa rmongs pa mtshon pa ste de dang bral ba'i rang bzhin no/ /'dir rmongs pa ni chos dang gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa bag chags dang bcas pa'o/

/snying rje chen po ni chos dbyings las bskul bar mdzad pa yin pas/ mchog ste rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i sgras rgyal ba rnams dbyings las bskul ba ni ḍā ma ru dang sgo gsum gyi nyes pa bcad de spangs pa ni dgra s+t+wa dang*/ srid pa ste khams gsum du gtogs pa'i nyon mongs pa mthong sgom gyi spang byas bsdus pa thams cad 'joms pa ni rtse gsum dang*/ rnam par rtog pa ma lus pa gcod pa ni gri gug dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du gshegs pa rnam par dag pa ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ye shes chen pos dngos por 'dzin pa kun 'ching ba ni zhags pa/ bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsi sems can la stsol ba ni thod pa/ tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa ni chu bo bzhi mtshon pa ste/ chu bo bzhi ni/ 'dod pa'i chu bo/ srid pa'i chu bo/ ma rig pa'i chu bo/ lta ba'i chu bo rnams so/ /ma rig pa dang lta ba ngan pa gnyis la re re dang 'dod khams kyis bsdus pa'i nyon mongs gzhan thams cad sdom pa dang*/ khams gong ma'i nyon mongs gzhan thams cad sdom pa la chu bo re rer byas pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang pa ni zhi ba la mi gnas pa/ g.yon bskum pa ni srid pa la mi gnas pa ste/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa/ zhes pa ltar thabs shes des chad mtha' dang 'dzin rtog gi ngo bo 'jigs byed rtag mtha' dang bzung rtog gi ngo bo dus mtshan ma mnan zhing 'joms pa'i tshul lo/ /gdub bu zhes pa la lag gdub bo/ /phyin drug rang bzhin zhes pa la/ mgur chu sbyin pa/ gdub bu tshul khrims/ rna cha bzod pa/ nor bu brtson 'grus/ mchod phyir thogs bsam gtan/ thal ba shes rab bo/ / rgyan rnams dang*/ phyag mtshan gyi dag pa dang*/ de dag gi mtshan nyid rgyas par gzhan du shes so/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba ni chos kyi dbyings mtshon la/ /thod skam lngas ni ye shes lnga ste de de las byung zhes pa'o/ /don mdzad ces pa ni 'phrin las rnam pa bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/

/zhal rnam par 'gyur ba ni shin tu khros pas bzhin 'gyur ba ste/ yod pa dang med par lta ba thams cad la khros te lta ba de nges par rtsa ba nas 'byin pa'o/ /mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa ni bdud bzhi 'joms pa'o/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi ste dgu po de 'dus pa'i ngo bo ni nyams dgu ldan pas mtshon pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug ni zhi lhag dbyer med dang*/ bde stong dbyer med mtshon no/ /kun da ni 'dzag med sku thams cad la khyab pa'o/ /sems byung lnga bcu ni brten pa sems la sbyar ba dang*/ yi ge lnga bcu ni rten lus la sbyar ba'o/ /skyon ni rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug ste/ stag lpags kyi nges don no/ /gnyis pa ni stong pa nyid las bde ba'i ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir dmar mo dang*/ chos kun don dam de bzhin nyid stong par ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ kun rdzob dang thabs shes gnyis su ston pas phyag gnyis dang*/ rab khros ni kun rtogs thams cad la'o/ /dbyings stong pa nyid las 'gro ba rnams la ye shes skyer 'jug pas skra grol ba dang*/ /gcer mo ni sgrib pa gnyis spangs pa mtshon no/ /yan lag bcu gnyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis so/ /spros pa kun ni mtha' bzhi dang*/ mtha' brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ni ye nas 'khor ba spangs shing*/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa po'i 'gro ba rnams kyang rang bzhin ma dmigs pas khrag 'dzag pa dang*/ shin tu rnam par dag pa/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes kyi snang ba me ltar 'bar ba la bdag dang gzhan sbyor ba'i phyir bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba'o/ /thabs shes sogs yab kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sor gdub la sogs zhes pas ni/ gong du bshad pa'i mchod phyir thogs te se ral ka dang*/ dpung gdub kyang bsdus pa yin no/ /des na nor bu rna cha mgur chu gdub/ /thal ba rnams ni phyag rgya lnga/ /'khor lo skerags rkang gdub dang*/ /se ral kha dang gdub phran rnams/

/nye ba'i phyag rgya lnga yin no/ /zhes smras so/ /snang ba ni kun rdzob bden pa'o/ /lha sku ni rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i sku'o/ /de ltar sku'i mtshon don bshad nas/ nang rtsa khams kyi dag pa ni/ mi shigs sogs te mi shigs pa'i thig le ni dpyid ces kyang bya ba ste/ rtsa chu shing gi me tog dang bcas pa dag pa ni dpa' bo/ lte ba'i gtum mo ni de'i dmar cha'o/ /da ni mtshan gyi nges don te/ dang por dzā la sam+ba ra zhes pa'i don rtsa dang zhes sogs te/ rtsa thams cad dhū tī dang*/ dpa' bo dang lha mo'i tshogs thams cad gtso bo dang*/ dag ma dag gi kun rdzob kyi dngos po'i tshogs thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sdom pa ste/ de nyid las byung zhing de nyid du thim pa'i don yin la/ rdul te khrag gi khams khu bar sdom pa ni 'khor lo bzhir dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod las bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'byung ba ste/ de rnams dzā la zhes pa'i sgra tshogs la 'jug pa'i nges don no/ /yang dzā la ni pad+ma/ sam+ba ra ni bde mchog ste/ shes rab ma'i pad+ma la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes kyi bde ba mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa shrī he ru ka zhes pa'i nges don ni/ 'dir bshad bya shin tu mang mod kyi/ re shig 'bras bu la sbyar te/ shrī yig ni bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te bde chen kyi sku dang*/ he yig ni rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs la sogs pa dang bral ba rang bzhin gdod ma nas stong pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ ru yig ni rdul phra rab kyi tshogs pa dang bral ba longs sku'o/ /ka yig ni sprul pa sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir rtag chad dang srid zhi'i mtha' gang la yang mi gnas pa sprul pa'i sku'o/ /yum gyi mtshan gyi nges don bā rā hwi nges don yi ge lnga dang sbyar ba ni/ ngag gi yul 'das zhes sogs te/ w dang srog ā dang*/ r dang srog ā dang*/

hra dang srog ī rnams la ā ring po don la gnyis byung na'ang*/ gzugs 'dra bas yi ge gcig tu byas te yi ge lnga'o/ /de la wa ni bā tsa smra ba ste smra ru med pa la smra bar btags pa ste brjod du med pa/ ra dang a la a ka ra ā ka ra zhes pa rnam pa kun ldan rnam med ces pa'o/ /yang ā ni ā bid+ya swā mi bde ste rig pa kun nas rang rig pa zhes pa'o/ /ha ni nīr+ha ta gzhom med/ i ni dī bu bkra ba'i don la 'jug/des na ngo bo spros pa dang bral bas rnam med rnam pa dkyil 'khor sogs thams cad 'char bas rnam pa kun ldan de nyid so sor rang gis rig pa'i spyod yul las tshig dang rtog pa'i yul ma yin la/ ngo bo gzhom gzhig gis 'gyur ba mi brten kyang gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi snang ba thams cad bkra lam me 'char ba zhes pa'i don no/ /shes dang shes bya gcig gyur ni yul yul can sogs gnyis chos thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i sku dang ye shes zung 'jug go /gzhan yang*/ ba las kyi rlung*/ a tshangs pa'i me/ ra lte ba'i gtum mo/ /a ba dhu no ti sdig pa rnam rtog bskrod pa/ a nu t+pan+na skye ba med pa/ ha haṃ yiga.ī lha ste bde stong la bshad pa yod de rgyas par brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi lugs sogs gzhan du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa 'dab ma'i lha rnams la bstod pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la so sor don tshan bdun bdun dang sbyar ba ste/ phyogs gang du gnas pa dang*/ rlung gi dag pa/ rtsa'i dag pa/ byang phyogs kyi dag pa/ dag bya'i lha/ de'i sku mdog /ce spyang zhes sogs kyi de'i phyag mtshan te bdun no/ /rtsa 'di rnams snying kha'i nang skor gyi phyogs kyi rtsa'o/ /spyi'i mtshan nyid ni thams cad ces pa nas gri gug ces pa'i bar dang*/ sgron ma zhes pa nas/ gshegs ma zhes pa'i bar du'o/

/'dir de bzhin gshegs ma shes/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sangs rgyas ma yin nam/ 'di rnams la sgos su ci ste smos zhe na/ gzhan rnams ni lam la gnas pa'i tshul bzung zhing*/ 'di dag ni rnam par yang de bzhin gshegs mar snang bas so/ /mtshams kyi 'dab mar gnas pa'i snod la bstod pa ni mtshams su sogs so/ /phyogs kyi rtsa'i rigs byung ba zhes pa ni shar lho'i rtsa gsum skor ma'i yal ga yin pa nas/ byang shar gyi rtsa 'dod ma'i yal ga'i bar du'o/ /thabs zhes pa ni sangs rgyas yab rnams te/ gtso bo mi bskyod pa ma gtogs pa'i rigs bzhi po rnams so/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dab brgyad sogs te/ de la nye ba'i mthung spyod ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'o/ /lnga pa drug pa bdun pa rnams la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis gnyis/ /dang po sh+lo lo ka re re ni mdor bstan no/ /sa yi tshul zhes pa dang*/ mngon 'gyur tshul zhes pa dang*/ chos sprin tshul zhes pa rnams la sdeb sbyor kyi dbang gi tshig bsdus pa yin te/ sa la gnas pa'i tshul 'dzin pa zhes pa la sogs pa sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la thugs 'khor gyi dang po bzhi ni gnas sam sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang*/ phyi ma bzhi ni nye ba'i gnas sam/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa la sbyar/ de bzhin du gsum pa 'od byed pa la sogs pa bzhi/ zhing dang*/ nye zhing*/ tshan+do dang*/ nye ba'i tshan+do bzhi ste/ gsung 'khor gyi rtsibs gnyis gnyis la sbyar te/ de bzhin du bdun pa ring du song ba sogs bzhi/ 'du ba la sogs pa bzhi dang sbyar te/ sku 'khor gyi rtsibs gnyis gnyis so/ /rgyas bshad rnams la/ lha bshad pa dang gnas bshad pa/ dang po la/ rab gtum ma sogs nyer bzhi rim pas rdo rje pho nya mo dang*/ tsun+da dang*/ rin chen sgron ma dang*/ rdo rje nyi ma dang*/ rdo rje ro langs ma dang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma dang*/ g.yo ldan ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub ma dang*/ ye shes sgron ma dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ma dang*/

dri ldan ma dang*/ rgya ldan ma dang*/ nye ba'i sgrol ma dang*/ nye ba'i gos dkar mo dang*/ nye ba'i spyan ma dang*/ nye ba'i mā ma ki dang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan dang*/ so sor 'brang ma dang*/ rma bya chen mo dang*/ ri khrod ma can dang*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang*/ phyir bzlog ma chen mo dang*/ gtsug tor dkar mo dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs ma rnams dang*/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi thod pa'i dum bu sogs rim pas/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ sa'i snying po dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ byams pa dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod dang*/ sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ spos kyi glang po dang*/ blo gros mi zad pa dang*/ ye shes rtog dang*/ spobs pa brtsegs pa dang*/ mya ngan dang mun pa kun 'joms dang*/ ngan song kun 'dren dang*/ dra ba can gyi 'od dang*/ zla 'od gzhon nu dang*/ rdo rje 'od dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi snying po dang*/ rdo rje 'od zer dang*/ mthu chen thob dang*/ nor bzang dang*/ bzang skyod dang*/ blo gros rgya mtsho rnams te/ 'jigs byed chen po nyer bzhi lha mo dang bcas pa 'dul ba'i phyir dang*/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub myur ba'i phyir du 'jigs byed rnams kyi ming dang*/ cha lugs sogs mthun par drag por sprul pa yin par bshad do/ /lha brgyad tshan gsum char la phyogs dang phyi'i yul chen/ nang gi rtsa dang khams/ de kho na nyid byang phyogs kyi dag pa bzhi/ lha dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis te/ don bdun bdun gyis ston pa la phyogs kyi rtsibs rnams yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ khams dpa' bo/ rtsa dpa' mo/ gnyis char byang phyogs kyi dag par shes par bya'o/ /yul nyer bzhi po nang du dag tshul ni/ spyi bo la sogs pa ste 'og lus dkyil gyi skabs su 'byung ngo*/ /gsum char la gnas la bstod pa ni tshigs bcad tha ma re re'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ thugs 'khor ba rnams zhes pa la sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/

rigs gsum zhes pa ni/ rigs thams cad bsdu na sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du 'du ba yin la/ de'i ngo bo lha rnams te/ des na ngo bo ni he ru ka'i rdo rje gsum sogs/ rnam pa ni mkha' spyod sogs te/ pho nya ni dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la shin tu myur ba'i don no/ khyad par gzhan zhes pa ni gos dang*/ rgyan dang*/ sku dang*/ bzhugs stangs rnams so/ /de ltar lha rnams kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad nas/ gnas 'khor lo gsum gyi spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ dbus kyi thog phubs zhes sogs so/ /dgu pa la/ gzhal yas khang dang lha gnyis las/ /dang po ni/ 'thung spyod ces pa ni mos spyod kyis te/ gtso bor thams cad du grags pa bzhin sbyor lam dang*/ rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ tshogs lam yang mos spyod du gsungs pa dang*/ tshogs lam gyis bcu gnyis kyang bla med nas bshad pas/ des na mos spyod ni tshogs spyor gnyis ka'o/ /gnyis pa la lha la bstod pa ni/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la byang phyogs dang rtsa'i dag pa/ phyogs dang sku mdog ste khyad par bzhi bzhis bstan pa'i rtsa rnams ni snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa bu ga brgyad du zug pa rnams te/ ming 'di dag ni phyag chen thig le nas kyang bshad do/ /yang bod gong ma rnams mig gnyis la rtsa 'khris ma/ rna ba gnyis la 'khris gsum ma/ sna gnyis la bdud rtsi bu mo/ kha la bdud bral ma/ 'og gi lam du khyi gdong ma zhes tha snyad mdzad/ yang thig le'i rgyud rang na gzhan mthu ma bshad lam dang*/ mthu skyed ma gsang pa/ ro'i rtse mo kha la bshad/ 'on kyang bla ma lho phyogs pa sogs rgya gar ba rnams ni/ ming 'dra yang bde mchog nag po'i lugs shes pa rnams kyi man ngag ni/ gzhan mthu ma lce rtsa ste kha/ mthu bskyed ma gsang ba/ ro'i rtse mo bshang lam/ ro lus la sna'i rtsa ba/ nam mkha' ma rna ba g.yas/ char sbyin ma g.yon/ rul ma mig g.yas/ gtogs ma g.yon zhes bzhed pa ltar te man ngag go

/lwa ba pa sogs kyis lū yi pa la 'god lugs gzhan mdzad kyang des nag po lugs la rigs bgre ba dka' 'o/ /de ltar zhes sogs kyi spyi khyab kyi sku'i rnam pa bshad do/ /dang po sogs ni 'phrin las bstan pa ste/ zhabs 'og gi ro gdan rnams kyang shugs la 'phangs so/ /bgegs de rnams la phur bus btab cing*/ slar mi 'jug pa'i don du rdo rje'i rwa ba la sogs pas mtshams bcings pa dang*/ yang na khro bo rnam rgyal la sogs pa brgyad/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ngo bo yin par bshad pas/ khro bo bcu'i 'khor los 'joms par mdzad pa yin no/ /bcu pa ni/ 'khor rnams nas lang tsho rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar te 'khor rnams kyi bstod pa de dag gi tshig don ni gzhung byang por bzung ba zhig gis go sla bas 'dir ma bris so/ /'dir byang phyogs so bdun dang*/ rtsa khams kyi rnam gzhag dang gzhal yas khang blos bslang ba'i go ba yod pa cig gal che'o/ /bcu gcig pa la/ bde chen 'khor lo sogs 'khor lo lnga so sor sbyar ba dang*/ de ltar sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan gnyis las/ dang po ni snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgyad po lus dkyil gyi bde chen 'khor lo yin la/ chos 'khor gyi lte ba'i dpyid dang*/ lte ba'i rak+ta'i dwangs ma gnyis yab yum gyi bskyed gzhi yin la/ yab yum zhal sbyor du bsgoms pas 'du 'phrod snying khar 'byung ba mtshon/ lha mo bzhi'i bskyed gzhi ni rtsa ba'i rlung bzhi'i ngo bo phyogs bzhi nas 'bab pa de yin la/ thod pa bzhi'i ni mtshams kyi 'dab ma nas bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma 'bab ba'i rtsa dang khams de'o/ /spyi bo nas pus mo'i bar gyi lus kyi cha shas nyi shu rtsa bzhi po de yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir mos dgos shing*/ de dag gi rtsa nyer bzhi po rnams dpa' mo nyer bzhi dang*/ khams nyer bzhi po dpa' bo nyer bzhi'o/ /snying ga chos 'khor gyi phyi'i rtsa brgyad kyi sne bu ga brgyad la zug pa yin te/

chos 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi gnas brgyad ni dam tshig 'khor lo dang*/ rtsa rlung brgyad po de ni ma mo brgyad kyi bskyed gzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ni rlung 'ba' zhig rgyu ba'i rtsa rnams shes rab kyi chos shas che bas/ ma mo bcu gnyis dang*/ rtsa khu ba gtso bor 'bab pa rnams lus kyi chos shas che bas sku 'khor gyi lha dang*/ rdul 'bab pa rnams snga ma las ngag shas che ba'i dbang du byas te gsung 'khor dang*/ dkar dmar rlung gsum cha mnyam par 'bab pa rnams bde stong bskyed pa'i phyir thugs shas che bas thugs 'khor rnams kyi lha'i dag par gzhag pa yin no/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ gru bzhi sogs te tshig don rnams go sla zhing*/ tshad med bzhi la sogs pa rnams 'chad par 'gyur ro/ kha khyer zhes bya ba ni 'dod snam mo/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang zhes bya ba ni/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin kyi gzhal yas khang ngo*/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ kha sogs bu ga brgyad ces sogs te/ de yang dur khrod brgyad ni/ nang lus la sbyar na bu ga brgyad yin pa las/ lā ba pas/ de ltar kha dang lte ba dang*/ rtags dang bshang lam dang smin mtshams dang mig dang*/ sna rnams la yang go bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs par byas te 'dir rgya bod kha cigamig gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ sna gnyis phyogs mthun sdom pas bu ga gsum du mdzad cing*/ lte ba dang smin mtshams kyi sgo gnyis bsnan pa dang*/ kha cig gis 'og sgo gnyis kyang gcig tu byas te/ spyi gtsug gi bu ga bsnan pa'ang yod/ yang bu ga dgu las 'og sgo gnyis gcig tu byas pa ste lugs mang po yod mod kyi/ khungs zhig yod na de dag thams cad mi 'gal mo/ /'on kyang bla ma'i rim pas bde mchog gi rgyud rnams na bu ga brgyad gang yin gsal bar ma gsungs kyang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le sogs gzhan rnams su/ dur khrod brgyad la sbyar ba'i bu ga brgyad ni/ yongs su grags pa'i bu ga dgu la/ sna bug gnyis gcig tu sdoms par bshad pas/

'dir yang de ltar khas blang ngo gsung*/ 'dir bu ga dang*/ dur khrod dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ shing dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang*/ sogs kyi sgras klu brgyad la sogs pa brgyad tshan bcu gnyis po des mtshon pa'i dur khrod kyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /dur khrod gnas zhes bya ba ni/ de na gnas pa rnams la zhes pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ bstod pa'i tshul gyis bstod par 'os pa yi/ /lam bzang mchog gyur lam 'di bshad pa yin/ /smra mkhas gang dag smra ba'i tshig tsam ste/ /nges don yin zhes nges med sna tshogs smra/ /bzhi pa de rnams kyi don bsdu ba ni/ dkyil 'khor de yang khang bzang zhig tu rgyal po dpon g.yog 'dus pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ chos thams cad spros bral du mkhyen pa'i bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig kho na 'gro ba 'dul ba'i don du dkyil 'khaur rab 'byams su snang ba yin no zhes ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa la/ bstan/ bshad/ bsdu gsum las/ dang po la mchod yul ni/ bla ma sogs te/ rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa dkyil 'khor te sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa'o/ /'di'i gsang ba ni gzhan rnams su grags pa'i phyi'i mchod pa yin te/ 'on kyang gsang ba zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i nus pas tshogs rdzogs phul shin tu che ba ste/ sngags kyi skal ba med pa nyan thos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang po brtul po rnams la shin tu gsang ba yin pa dang*/ sha chen la sogs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la phul bas dngos grub myur du thob pa ni/ gsang sngags 'og ma rnams su yang gsang bas so/ /rab gsang zhes bya ba ni nang gi mchod pa'o/ /gsang chen ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/

/bla na med pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsang ba'i dang*/ rab tu gsang ba'i dang*/ gsang ba chen po'i dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni dngos bsham sogs so/ /rgyas par bshad pa la nyer spyod dang*/ 'dod yon dang*/ khyad par gyi mchod pa gsum las/ dang po ni mchod yon sogs tshigs bcad gcig go /gnyis pa ni gzugs sgra sogs tshig bcad gcig ste/ de la rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga mchod ni/ gsang ba'i mchod par mi 'gyur ram/ 'dir yang nang gi zhes smros pas/ phyi'i skabs su ci'i phyir mi 'gal zhe na/ de ni bden mod kyi/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi bde bas mchod pa yin kyang rig ma'i 'dod yon gyi mchod pa yin tshad gsang mchod du mi 'gro ste/ rig mas glu dang gar dang*/ sgeg pa dang rgod pa dang lus kyi dri bzang dang zhal zas stob pa dang yan lag mnyen zhing 'jam pas rim gro byed pa dang*/ de rnams kyis yid bde bar byed pa ste/ rig ma'i 'dod yon drug po de tsam gyi mchod pa ni/ theg chen mdo sngags thams cad la yod kyang bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba'i mchod par mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /nang gi zhes pa yang phyi nang gsang ba zhes pa'i nang ni ma yin te/ nang sems can gyis bsdus pa'i zhes pa'i don no/ /des ni nang gi mchod par mi 'gro ste/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi btsun mo rin po che bzhin no/ /'o na ci zhe na/ gsang ba'i mchod pa zhes bya ba rig ma'i 'dod yon dang po bzhi'i skabs kyang snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'dod chags dang rjes su 'brel ba dgos shing*/ 'dod yon gang gi skabs yin yang zhu bde'i thabs su 'gro ba dgos pa yin no/ /gsum pa la drug las/ dang po dngos grub kyi don gyi mchod pa ni/ dngos grub thob pa'i zhes sogs so/ /'dir khyad par zhes pa'i tshig ni dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir dang mchog tu mnyes pa'i phyir dang*/

tshogs rdzogs phul gzhan pas che ba'i phyir dang*/ nye bar mkho ba'i don dang*/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i don dang*/ bla ma'i rim gro la nye bar mkho ba'i don du mchod pa gzhan rnams las khyad par du gal che'o/ /zhes pa ste/ don tshan drug po rnams la rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya ste thog ma'i gsal byed do/ /sha chen sogs ni rtsa rgyud las sgrub po dngos grub gang 'dod kyang*/ dri dang me tog bdug spos dang*/ / mar me brgya ni dbul bar bya/ /zhes dang*/ sgrub po dngos grub gang 'dod kyang*/ /mar me brgya ni dbul bar bya/ /zhes phyi la zhun chen gyi mar me dang sha chen yin te/ de rnams brgya phrag brgya phrag spel ba dngos grub sgrub pa la bsngags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mchog tu dgyes pa'i don du lha mo'i mchod pa ni rig pa'i sogs te/ bcu drug ni pi waṃ ma la sogs pa'o/ /nyi shu ni sgyu ma bde mchog las 'byung ste/ bde mchog ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/ snang mdzad ma/ slob pa ma/ sangs rgyas byang chub ma/ chos 'khor ma/ rnam rgyal ma/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma/ gling bu ma/ pi waṃ ma/ cang te ma/ rdza rnga ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma rnams so/ / bde sbyin ni bde ba bskyed pa'i don te/ gsang ba'i don du 'gyur ba'i skabs kyang yod mod kyi/ gtso bor rig ma'i phyi mchod yin no/ /gsum pa ni rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa la/ /gsang 'dus las kyang*/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyi/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang la/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis dbul/ /zhes so/ rgyal srid sna bdun ni 'khor lo zhes sogs so/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun ni ral gri zhes sogs so/ /phal pa'i rin chen bdun ni pad dmar zhes sogs so/ /rin chen dman pa ni zangs lcags la sogs pa'o/ /zla shel ni chu shel te sogs kyi tshig gis bsdus pa ni/

nor bu'i khyad par gzhan dang gser la sogs pa khams kyi rim pa rnams so/ /bzhi pa nyer mkho'i mchod pa ni/ khrus kyi rdzing bu zhes sogs te/ rigs lnga'i stan zhes bya ba ni/ rnam par snang mdzad la zla ba/ rin chen rigs la rin po che/ pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma dmar po/ las kyi rigs la sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje'i rigs la nyi ma dang rdo rje'o/ /bzhon pa ni glang po/ rta/ rma bya/ mkha' lding*/ seng ge rnams so/ /phyag mtshan ni rigs lnga dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so'i phyag mtshan no/ /so so'i dam tshig ni bza' ba'i dam tshig ste/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun las/ gtso bo yab yum spyi khyab tu 'gyur zhing*/ lhag ma yab yum gnyis med du byas pa/ yum gtso bo'i dbang du byas nas/ rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug po rnams kyi rtsa ba'i dam tshig la lus kyi khams sum cu rtsa drug dang*/ 'dab chags sum cu rtsa drug dang*/ skam gnas dang*/ chur gnas kyang sum cu rtsa drug gi sha rnams te/ gzhan yang 'jig rten bdag la sha khrag gnod sbyin mo dang 'o ma klu mo dang*/ spos dang me tog lha'i na mo dang*/ zhag dang mi thod kyi 'bru mar la sogs pa srin mo dang*/ bshang gci khrag dang chang rnams mkha' 'grau ma rnams kyi bza' ba'i dam tshig tu bshad pa bzhin yin no/ /me tog bdun ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa las gsungs pa bzhin yin te/ de yang 'dus pa le'u brgyad pa las/ mkhas pas ut+pal dag dang*/ /pad+ma rnam pa lngar shes bya/ /dzā ti rnam gsum zhes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /me tog kar+ṇi ka ra dang*/ /ma li ka dang yu ti ka /me tog ka ra bī ra bsam/ /mchod pa thams cad rab tu brtag /ces pa ltar phyi mchod kyi dbang du byas na/ pad+ma/ ut+pal/ dzā ti/ kar+ṇi ka ra/ ma li ka /yu ti ka ka ra bī ra/ bdun po de dag ni byang chub yan lag bdun mtshon pa yin no/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad ni/ pad+ma can la sogs pa brgyad kyi brgya byin lha min gyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshe bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mchod pa byed pa mo rnams so/

/lnga pa dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa ni rgyal mtshan sogs so/ /mda' ni mda' dra'i bsrung ba'o/ /bum pa dgu ni/ dbang bskur ba'i don du yang dgos mod kyi/ 'dir ni mchod pa'i don no/ /drug pa bla ma la mchod pa ni khyad par sogs so/ /dpyangs pa ni dra phyed las so/ /brgyan zhing ni gnas khang la'o/ /sems dga' ba'i sgo nas rnga chen sogs rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i glu gar ro/ /'dir rgyud las/ sgrub pa po yis rnga brdung zhing*/ /ha ha zhes ni brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don gsang ba ni/ dbang bskur ba'i don du slob dpon la phyag rgya phul te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rnga chen pos mnyes par byed pa bshad do/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las kyang*/ rdo rje pad+mar yang dag brdar/ zhugs pa la sogs pa rim las byung*/ /rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /zhes rdo rje pad+ma mnyam par sbyar bas gzhom med kyi sgra 'byung ba'o/ /yon dbul ba ni/ gser ni sogs so/ /bdag nyid dbul ba ni lus ngag sogs so/ /gnyis pa rab tu gsang ba'i mchod pa la bzhi las/ dang po zhi ba'i btung ba ni/ gzhan yang zhes sogs te/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i don du/ dus ldan ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i thig le dkar dmar gyis bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams mchod par 'gyur ba yin la/ de la zla ba ni khu ba'o/ /me tog ni zla mtshan no/ /'di ni rtsa rgyud las/ sbom po mtha' dag rtse sbyar bas/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu spyad/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na/ /dngos grub rtag par thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don gyi phyogs gcig go /'di dag phyogs mthun par gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i skabs su/ bzhin bzang shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /na chung skal ba mchog ldan pa/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi gnas bsam ste/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rab tu brtag

/mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan pa'i/ khu ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ye shes zhabs lugs pa mang pos/ dngos su thig le phyung bar bzhed pa la/ bod kyi 'phags bskor ba phyi ma rnams kyis de ltar na ltung bar 'gyur bas yid kyi 'byin pa yin zhes zer/ spyir bla med kyi lam 'dir bde ba chen po gtso bor sgrub dgos pas de'i 'gal zla thig le lhung ba ni shin tu nyes pa che yang*/ dgos pa khyad par can gyi tshe bsam pa mchog gis zin pas mchod pa 'di lta bu'i dus ni nyes pa med par ma zad tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs dam pa ste/ dgos pas dgag bya zil gyis gnon pa gsang dbang bzhin no/ /gnyis pa bdud rtsi lnga la dngos grub ces bya ba ni/ rigs lnga'i dngos grub bam/ bcud len gyi dngos grub kyi dam tshig go /bcud len sogs gnas skabs so sor bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga po de dag la rnam par dbye ba mang du yod mod kyi ma spros so/ /de'i sha chen gyi dwangs ma ni/ klad pa dang*/ gzhung pa dang*/ rkang ngo*/ /sgron ma lnga ni sha lnga ste/ de rnams zos pas rigs so so'i dngos grub myur ba'i phyir rigs lnga'i dam tshig ces bya'o/ /bde ba ni byang chub kyi sems so/ /de la myos byed lnga ni/ 'bras dang bu ram dang sbrang rtsi dang me tog dang shing las byung ba lnga'am/ sdom 'byung las/ rdzas skyes de bzhin rtsa ba skyes/ /gau ṭi paṣ+ti mā dhī skyes/ /shing skyes de bzhin bu ram skyes/ /zhes pa rnams la/ rno dang kha dang tshwa ba dang*/ /mngar dang 'jam pa skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes rno ba'i ro can sogs lnga'o/ /de dag bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba ni/ kyai rdo rje las/ de la ga pur rgyu yi phyir/ /sha ni bza' ba nyid du bya/ khyad par du yang chang nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa gsang ba chen po'i mchod pa la/ mchod rdzas phyag rgya dang*/ des ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog

/rin chen sna tshogs mchog gis brgyan/ /sgrub tshe rab tu sgrub pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams kun la dbul bar bya/ /zhes dngos grub kyi don te/ de la rnam smin gyi dbye ba dang*/ rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ tshogs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /dang po la na tshod kyi dbye ba/ lus kyi dbye ba/ rgyud kyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gsum ni sku gsung thugs gsum mo/ /de'i rigs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /spyir rigs lnga/ rigs drug /rigs sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa bshad pa rnams bsdu na las kyi rigs dang pad+ma'i rigs gsung dang*/ rin chen rigs dang rnam snang gi rigs sku dang*/ mi bskyod pa ni thugs kyi rigs yin pas 'og nas 'byung ba thams cad kyang 'di gsum du mi 'du ba ni ma yin no/ /dus kyi 'khor lo las ni/ rigs gsum cu rtsa drug po thams cad kyang na tshod la sbyar ba yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni lo bcu gnyis ma thugs kyi rigs dang*/ bcu drug ma gsung gi rigs dang*/ nyi shu ma sku'i rigs so/ /bcud len gyi don du bcu gcig ma dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig gi don du bcu gnyis ma ste thugs dang*/ bde ba chen po'i don du bcu drug ma gsung dang*/ mkha' spyod kyi don du nyi shu ma/ dbang bskur ba'i don du nyer lnga ma sku'i rigs yin par bzhed de/ dgos pa'i don gyi na tshod lngar dbye ba de ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyang gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ pad+ma can sogs te/ pad+ma can ma dang*/ glang po can ma dang*/ dung can ma dang*/ ri mo can ma'o/ /ri dwags can ma ni pad+ma can ma'i nang tshan yin te/ de gnyis so sor phye na lngar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ zhal lung*/ sdom 'byung*/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim rnams las ni/ don mgrin gcig tu gsungs/ gshin rje gshed gdong drug gi rgyud dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rgyud dang*/ 'grel pa mang po dang*/ man ngag rnams las sna tshogs 'byung ste/

phyogs mthun rtsis pas mi 'gal bar mthong ngo*/ /'dir tshig 'dus che bar snang bas rnal 'byor bzhi rim ltar brjod na/ ji skad du/ pad+ma can gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /bzhin ni kun nas zlum pa ste/ /sna ni dza ba'i me tog mtshungs/ /rus sbal rgyab 'dra'i ser mo dmar/ /nu ma 'khregs shing 'jam pa dang*/ /rkang mthil mnyam gnas brang yang mdzes/ /ba spu 'khyil zhing ngang pa'i skad/ /ri mo gsum can chu skyes mchog /pad+ma'i dri ldan glang chen 'gros/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ltar reg na 'jam/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las ni/ nu ma'i rtse mo til gyi gang bu 'dra ba dang*/ rak+ta ro skyur ba dang*/ mdog dmar ba dang*/ mā ma kī dang klu'i rigs zhes bshad/ ka ra ṇa sbyor thabs kyang*/ pad+ma'i byed pa rus sbal kyi 'dug stangs kyis bsten/ glang po can zhes bya ba ni/ sna yon ba spu 'khyil ba dang*/ /'dod pa'i myos shing 'dod la sred/ /chang gi dri ldan byin pa sbom/ /lus ni sbom la srun pa dang*/ /bzhad kyi gdangs dang nga ro che/ /glu dang rol mo la dga' ba/ /zhal lung las ni/ dri ba spyod lam rtsing*/ rak+ta ro mngar/ sha mdog smug la nu ma g.yas g.yon du bgyed pa spyan ma'i rigs so/ /'ga' zhig tu ba tshwa chags pa bzhin snang ste ba lang gi rigs zhes bshad/ byed pa yang glang po lta bu dang ril bu reg pas bsten/ dung can ma zhes grags pa ni/ /ha cang skem min sbom pa min/ /skra ring sna yang cung zad ring*/ /nu ma na ra ka 'bras ltar/ /zho dang 'o ma'i tshogs la dga'/ /bya rog skad can bong bu'i dri/ /ba lang lce ltar rtsub pa ste/ /na ra ka yi 'bras bu ni/ /rtsa ba phra zhing rtse mo rgyas pa'o/ /zhal lung las/ rak+ta lan tshwa ba dang*/ mdog dkar ser dang*/ gos dkar mo'i rigs so/ /ba tshwa'i dri zhes bya ba 'byung ba ni 'gyur nyes pa 'dra ste/ ba ra bong bu dang ba tshwa gnyis char la 'jug pas 'dir bong bu'o/ /dkar ser ni 'gyur gzhan las skya bsang zhes so/

/'di la stag gam seng ge'i rigs zhes kyang bshad do/ /byed pa yang rab tu bkal ba'i sbyor bas bsten/ ri mo can yang bshad par bya/ /shin tu khro zhing ngo tsha spang*/ /rtag tu rtsod pa la dga' zhing*/ /lus thung de yi brang yang mdzes/ /pa la'i 'bras ltar nu ma zab/ /byin pa phra zhing phyis skan nyal/ /gsus pa sbom zhing mchu yang 'phyangs/ /sha'i dri ldan phug ron skad/ /zhal lung las ni/ brla sha mdzes pa dang*/ kha dog sngo bsang*/ rak+ta tsha ba dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ ri dwags kyi rigs zhes bshad/ nu ma zab pa ni zlum la chung ba'o/ /byed pa yang rdo rje sems dpa'i do li'o/ /sdom 'byung las ni/ pad+ma can nyid mkha' 'gro ma/ /lā ma glang chen ma ru 'gyur/ /dum skyes ma ni dung can ma/ /tsi tri nar 'gyur gzugs can ma/ /zhes dang*/ tsa rtsi ka ni pad+ma can/ /phag mo glang po can du bshad/ /rdo rje dbyangs can dung can ma/ /dkar mo ri mo can yin te/ /zhes slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis gshed dmar rdzogs rim du bshad pa rnams rigs kyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba mang du byung mod kyi/ rgyud sde so so'i bshad lugs yin pas mi 'gal zhing*/ bsre bar yang mi bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro las ni cung zad 'dra min du 'byung zhing*/ spyi'i byed pa bcing ba shin tu rgyas par gsungs/ 'di dag so so'i byed pa bcing ba ni rgyas par sdom 'byung las gsungs so/ /de rnams ni rigs bzhi mchog gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ thun mong gi dbang du byas na/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ yan lag phra ldan skra rnams phra zhing rkang lag 'jam la mnyen gshin dpal ldan shin tu bzang mo'o/ /zhes lus phra/ skra 'jam/ mnyen gshin pa ste snying nye ba/ sha 'jam pa gla rtsi'i dri dang ldan pa ste/ ri dwags can ma dang*/ cung zad phra ba dang ldan ring zhing mig ni g.yo ba med la skra ni 'khyogs pa pad+ma can/ zhes lus phra zhing ring ba/ mig skyes pa la ring du lta ba ste/

lta nan che ba/ skra li pa/ pad+ma'i dri dang ldan pa ni pad+ma can dang*/ ngo tsha med cing 'dod pa drag la rtsod mang la dga' skra ni shin tu chung ba dung can ma/ /zhes ngo tsha chung ba/ 'dod chags shugs drag pa/ tshig rtsub ste 'thab rtsod la dga' ba skra srab pa gci ba'i dri can ma ni dung can ma dang*/ ring zhing yan lag thams cad rdzogs la nges par yang ba'i yul dang skra ni ring ba sna tshogs ma/ /zhes lus ring zhing mtshams la sems yang bas lus skyed pa yang ba/ skra ring ba nya'i dri yod pa ni ri mo can dang*/ sbom zhing thung la yan lag brtan ldan shin tu sra ba'i yul dang skra ni sbom pa glang chen ma/ /zhes lus sbom thung*/ yan lag phra ba/ skye gnas sam 'dod chags sra ba skra bshor pa rul ba'i dri can ni/ glang chen ma'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa rnams dang*/ pho nya mo rnams dag pa'i rigs ni 'ga' zhig dag tu 'dir 'gyur dus kun tu ni 'dres pa'i rigs/ /zhes phan tshun du ci rigs pas mtshan nyid 'dres pas gnas pa shas che'o/ /gdan bzhi bshad rgyud sbyor ba'i rab byed las ni/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ pad+ma can ma mig pad 'dab 'dra ba dang*/ skra 'khyil ba/ so dang sen mo sogs phra ba/ sor mo dmar ba zhes te zhi ba'i las la bsngags pa dang*/ glang po can ma mchu dang nu ma 'phyang ba/ dpung pa mtho ba/ sen mo ring ba/ sbrang rtsi dang chang la dga' ba/ gsang ba'i 'gram rgyas pa/ rkang mthil mnyam pa/ mig phra ba rgyas pa'i las la'o/ /de gnyis glang chen myos pa'i 'gros so/ /dung can ma ni/ by-in pa dang sor mo dang mgrin pa ring*/ 'gros mgyogs/ mchu gdugs kyi dbyibs 'dra ba ste dbang gi las la'o/ /ri mo can ma byad chung ba/ sha la dga' ba drag mo'i las la'o/ /ri dwags can ma byin pa mdzes/ mig dkyus dang lus ring ba/ mchu snyung ba pags pa srab cing sems g.yo ba bzhin zlum la chung ba'o/ /de rnams kyi mtshan nyid rgyas pa dang*/ rtsa'i dbye ba dang*/

byed pa bcing pa yang sbyor ba drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ 'dod pa bcu gsum dang*/ shin tu skyang ba dang*/ 'dus pa dang*/ bteg pa dang*/ gru mo'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa rgyas par rgyud 'grel dang*/ zhal lung la sogs pa gzhung rnams las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ lhan skyes kyi pho nya mo zhes bya ba 'og min sogs dag pa'i zhing na bzhugs pa de bzhin gshegs ma dang*/ byang sems 'phags ma rnams so/ /gnas skyes ni zhing che chung rnams na grub tsam nyid na bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /rigs skyes ni gnas skyes kyi rigs su skyes pa 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gnyis char yod cing*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam du zhugs pa rnams so/ /mthar skyes ni phra men ma'i tshogs rnams yin la/ sbyang ba las byung ba ni tshe 'dir lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs pa'i rigs la'o/ /de yang kyai rdo rje las/ byang chub sa bon gdab pa dang*/ /sbyang ba yis ni bzung bar bya/ /zhes dang*/ dge ba bcu las brtsams nas ni/ /de la chos ni rab tu dbye/ /lha yi gzugs kyi sems dang ni/ /dam tshig sems kyang gcig pa nyid/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis sbyang ba'o/ /gnyis pa rigs kyi dbye ba la/ mi'i rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ lha'i rigs kyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gar ma sogs te rdo rje ma g.yung mo'o/ /de la bram ze rnam snang bshad pa ste/ rin chen tsaṇ+ḍa līr zhes bya/ /gar mkhan dpag med mgon po ste/ /chos ma don yod rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi ḍom+bhi ste/ /drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /rgyal rigs su ni shes par bya/ /bdun pa he ru ka yi ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can dmangs rigs so/ /zhes sogs rgyas par grub chen lā ba pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel par gsungs pa bzhin shes par bya la/ rdo rjai sems dpa' dang he ru ka gnyis spyi khyab tu btang bas rigs lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la rigs drug las byung ba'i phyag rgya dang*/

bsdud byed rigs bdun gyi dbye ba dang*/ khyad par rigs gnyis kyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu drug pa las/ bud med pad rtsa ltar dkar zhing*/ pad+ma'i 'dab ltar dkyus ring migartag tu pad+ma'i rtsa ba'i dri/ bde gshegs 'dus pa nyid la dga'/ /rigs rgyud las byung shes par bya/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa kha dog dang dri dang gang la dga' ba'i yul dang lus sam sems kyi 'byung tshul yang ci rigs pa dang rigs kyi dag tshul te/ don tshan bzhi'am lnga lngas gsungs so/ /'di rnams kyi lung rdzogs par drangs na mangs par 'gyur bas mdor bsdus su brjod na/ so so'i mtshan nyid ni mdog dkar/ mig dkyus ring*/ gos dkar po dang*/ lha khang la dga' ba/ tsan+dan gyi dri dang ldan pa ni/ /rigs rgyud las byung zhes par bya/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs so/ /sha rtsa ser/ gos dmar ser gnyis la dga'/ dza ti'am me tog tsam pa'i dri dang ldan pa/ de yang dpa' bo'i rjes 'gro 'gyur/ /zhes rin 'byung dang*/ mdog nag mo gos sngo ba la dga'/ ut+pal sngon po'i dri can/ de ni dpa' bo bzang rjes 'gro/ /zhes mi bskyod pa dang*/ mdog dkar pad+ma'i dri can ni 'od dpag med dang*/ mdog dkar dmar gos dmar ba/ ma li ka'i dri can ni/ de ni rdo rje'i rigs byung ba/ zhes he ru ka dang*/ sngo bsang*/ sha rtsa ser ba/ gos dkar/ shing shri sha'i me tog gi dri can ni/ de bzhin gshegs rigs rjes 'gro yin/ /zhes don grub dang*/ mdog dang gos dmar/ ga bur gi gyi dri can ni/ rnam snang rigs kyi rjes 'gro yin/ /zhes rnam snang ngo*/ /he ru ka dang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis rgyu 'bras kyi dbang du byas nas drug go /spyi'i mtshan nyid g.yon pa'i kun spyod la dga' ba/ rang rigs kyi sngags kyi cha shas smra ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ya mi nī dang skrag byed ma/ /'dod ldan ma dang 'jigs gzugs ma/

/kun spyod ma dang mdzes ma dang*/ /bha su ra dang rnam pa bdun/ /bsdud pa mor ni 'dir bshad bya/ /zhes bsdud byed lha mo brgyad dang*/ de'i rigs su gyur pa bsdu bya 'jig rten pa'i lha mo bdun ni/ gzugs can ma dang tsum+pa ki /lā ma yongs gyur byis bcas ma/ /mi ldog e hi ka lha mo/ / mkha' 'gro ma ni bdun du bshad/ /phyi ma bdun po 'di dag gi rigs su gtogs pa'i dbang du byas nas mtshan nyid mdor bsdus su brjod na/ yun ring du lta ba dang*/ skyes pa mthong na smin ma g.yas pa 'degs pa dang*/ chags sems kyi bzhin 'gyur ba dang*/ gzugs gzhan du bsgyur ba mthong na gzugs can ma'i rigs so/ /byis pa mthong ba thams cad la 'khyud cing tsum+pas dga' bar byed pa ni/ tsum+pi ka ste 'o byed ma'i rigs so/ /de gnyis bsten bya'o/ /zas za ba na 'phro gcod cing lta ba dang*/ gdong dang smin ma bsgyur zhing sdig mdzub byed pa dang*/ bzhin mi 'gyur zhing yid 'jigs par byed pa ni lā ma'i rigs so/ /phag dang seng ge dang byi la dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ ra dang*/ rta rnams 'jigs par byed pa ni yongs gyur ma'i rigs so/ /dus rgyun dang*/ khyad par du rjes chags kyi tshe shin tu rgod pa dang*/ gar song sar yun ring du sdod pa ni/ byis bcas ma'am/ khan+ṭa ro ha'i rigs so/ /mthong ba tsam gyis yid skyo ba dang*/ yan lag dang bong ba dang gos sam shing thogs nas gsod sems kyi reg pa tsam gyis pha rol 'chi ba ni mi ldog ma'i rigs so/ /rgyu med par rgod pa dang*/ khro ba dang*/ ngu bar byed pa ni phra men ma rnams dang rtag tu gsong por smra ba yin te/ e he ka'i rigs so/ /sangs rgyas pa ste lam 'di'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi drung du rtag tu 'ong zhing yun ring du smra bar byed pa de ni bsdud byed rdo rje phag mo'i rigs yin zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ngo*/ /de la mkha' 'gro ma thams cad bdun po'i rigs su 'du la/

spyir bud med bdun tshogs pa'i nang na nges par mkha' 'gro ma re yod de/ de dngos ni yin pa'i nges pa med mod/ sgrub pa po la phan gnod byed pa'i mthu can no/ /gzhan yang pad+ma can sogs brgyad ya ma nī sogs brgyad kyi rigs yin la/ rigs brgyad kyi phyogs mthun du bud med thams cad 'du ste/ de dag gi mtshan nyid lā ba pa'i 'grel par shes so/ /'dir de rnams kyi srin lag g.yon la rim pa bzhin 'og nas 'chad pa'i thod pa la sogs pa'i ri mo 'byung ba'o/ /'di rnams mkha' 'gro ma dngos kyi dbang du byas te/ gzhan rnams ni phyogs res shes par bya dgos so/ /'dir bsdud bya dang sdud byed kyi don cung zad bshad na/ sgrub pa po rnams la mchog tu dngos grub stsol ba la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor ma stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig yod de/ de yang ji skad du/ stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig yin/ /de las lhag pa ji snyed pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i de las lhag pa ni/ mngon brjod las bsdud byed mkha' 'gro ma bdun la 'khor bye ba re'i dbang du byas nas bye ba bdun dang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid las/ mkha' 'gro ma ni re re yang*/ 'khor ni bye ba dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun po re re la yang 'khor bye ba bye bar gsungs/ 'ga' zhig tu mkha' 'gro ma stong phrag nyer gcig gi mkha' 'gro ma re re la yang 'khor bye ba bye bar bshad pas/ gang ltar yang spyir sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'khor gyi tshad gzung bar mi nus kyang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i zhing rnams su spyod pa lam 'di'i sgrub pa po rnams la dngos grub ster ba la shin tu mthu myur ba'i zhing skyes ma rnams kyi gtso bo bsdus pa'i grangs de tsam du gsungs so/ /lam 'di gzhan pa'i byin rlabs myur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang phyogs gcig de'o/ /de ltar na bsdud bya sdud byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i dbye bsdu dang*/

de rnams kyi mchod pa bya tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor ma grangs med pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma phrag khrig chen po nyer gcig gam/ bye ba sum cu rtsa drug gam/ bye ba bdun du 'du ba yin la/ bsdud bya de rnams sdud byed mkha' 'gro ma nas/ gshin rjes 'joms ma'i bar rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug du 'du/ de rnams gong du bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bdun phag mo dang bcas par 'du/ de rnams kyang rdo rje phag mo gcig pur 'du'o/ /de la rnal 'byor ma so drug mkha' 'gro ma bdun nam brgyad kyi bsdus tshul ni/ bla ma dam pa 'ga' zhig rdo rje phag mo dang kun spyod ma gnyis bor ba'i lhag ma drug po des brtson 'grus chen mo nas brtsams te/ rab gtum ma'i bar du bzhi bzhi bsdus la/ kun spyod mas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ phag mo ste bsdud byed mas sgo mtshams ma brgyad bsdus par bzhed de pham ting pa'i man ngag yin gsung*/ yang lo tsā ba kha cigaku lu ta sogs bzhi lā mas bsdus/ gser gling sogs gsum gzugs can mas bsdus/ hi ma la/ kañtsi/ lam+pa ka ka liṅka rnams byis bcas mas bsdus/ ko sa la/ pre ta pu ri/ kā ma ru pa/ tre sha ku ne rnams khaṇ+ḍa ru his bsdus/ pu li ra ma la ya/ o rgyan/ arbu ta/ dzā lan+dha ra rnams e hi kas bsdus/ go dā ba ri/ rasmi shwa ra/ de bi ko ṭa/ mā la ba rnams mi ldog mas bsdus/ lhag ma bcu gnyis rdo rje phag mos bsdus gsung*/ gzhan yang slob dpon rak+ṣi ta dang*/ ka na ka shrī dang*/ bha dan+ta pa so so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba dang*/ rgya 'grel so so na yang mi 'dra ba mang du bshad mod kyi/ thams cad la spyir 'gal ba chen po yod pa dka' na'ang*/ bshad rgyud la brten nas cung zad zhus dag bya dgos shing*/ re zhig rang lugs la snga ma de khas blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshes bcu la sogs pa khyad par gyi dus la/ thod pa dgra sta mche ba dang*/ /'khor lo rgyal mtshan ral gri dang*/

/skrag byed brgyad pa dung du bshad/ /ces pa ltar phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor bris la mchod pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams gnyis nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub myur du stsol ba yin no/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma 'di dag dud 'gro mo'i tshul du'ang rigs kyis khyab pa'i phyir/ rdo rje a ral+li las/ lo ni bcu gsum de bzhin du/ /lo ni bcu drug bu mo dang*/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga ma mchod bya/ /ba dang de bzhin ma he mo/ /spre'u mo dang ni khyi mo dang*/ /bong mo de bzhin rnga mo dang*/ /sha ba mo dang ra mo nyid/ /phag dang ba men las byung ba/ /gzhan yang he ru ka mchod na/ /'grub pa nyid du the tshom med/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di ni gzhon nu mo mchod pa'i yan lag go / 'dir smras pa/ pho nya 'di dag lam 'di yi/ /dam tshig can la mngon par mos/ /bcud len mchog bzhin rnyed dka' yang*/ /rnyed na yud kyis dngos grub stsol/ /gsum pa khyad par gyi rigs la/ khyad par zhes pa'i tshig gis mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma'i rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ rjes chags kyi mtshan nyid kyi rnal 'byor ma yang bstan pa yin no/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs la nang tshan du dbye na/ pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs la sogs pa bdun yod cing*/ lā ma'i rigs la phye na lnga yod la/ de dag gi mtshan nyid dang*/ mchod pa'i dus dang*/ phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan rnams zhib tu shes par bya ste lam 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /rig ma bzhi'am brgyad do/ /de la ma zhes bya ba ni/ gsang dbang gi don du rang gi slob dpon la phul zhing de las gsang dbang thob pa de'o/ /sring mo ni slob dpon gcig las dbang bskur ba thob pa'o/ /bu mo ni rang gi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma mo'o/ /chung ma ni shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba'i tshe slob dpon gyis byin pa'o/ /gang du ma la sogs pa gsungs pa rnams las kyi phyag rgya'i skabs ni/

'dir bshad ma thag pa 'di rnams gtso che ba yin la/ bram ze mo ni ma yin te/ zhes pa la sogs pa/ phyag rgya chen po thig le dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud rnams las ni/ phyi nang gi bshad pa mi 'dra ba mang du mdzad cing*/ dus kyi 'khor lor yang gzhan du gsungs la/ /'khor lo bde mchog rtsa rgyud 'di las/ ma dang sring mo bu mo dang*/ /chung ma pho nya ma kun gnas/ /gang zhig rtag tu sngags sbyin pa/ /de nyid de yi cho gar bshad/ /ces sngags sbyin pa ste dbang bskur ba sogs la ltos pa'i ma sogs su gsungs so/ /'di dag sgra ji bzhin pa yang rung ngam mi rung zhe na/ /sgrub pa po rang nyid bde ba chen po'i ye shes sgrub pa'i don du ma dang sring mo dang bu mo ni/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod nus na ma gtogs bkag go /slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i don du ni/ phyag rgya de dag mtshan nyid tshang na thams cad kyang dbul bar bya ba yin no/ /'dir ma ni slob dpon gyi rig ma'o zhes zer ba ni shin tu khyab ches pas nyes par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ 'jigs rung dmyal ba sdig can du/ bla ma'i shes rab ma bsgrod 'gro/ /nyes pa dang*/ bla ma'i rdzas ni srog ji bzhin/ /de'i sdug pa'ang bla ma bzhin/ zhes dang*/ mchod rten bshig 'dra'i sdig 'jigs pas/ /grib ma'ang 'gom par mi bya na/ /mal cha stan dang bzhon pa sogs/ / 'gom mi bya ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes grib mar 'gom pa yang de tsam du nyes pa che bar gsungs na/ phyag rgya la 'gom pa lta ci smos/ 'o na slob mar gyur pa'i mchog tu dga' ma ni/ /slob dpon dang lhan cig spyod par mi 'os sam zhe na/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi man ngag snye mar/ the tshom yongs su spangs nas ni/ /rgod nang de bzhin bteg pa dang*/ /bla mas lha mo rab dga' ba'i/ /rol pa'i gtso bo sba mi bya/ /bla ma 'bras bu kun ster ba/

/skyes bu 'dod na dga' bar bya/ /bla ma'i staing du nges bltas te/ rtag tu chags bcas bla ma la'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa yis/ /bla ma'i rtags ni bzung byas te/ /bha gar bla ma'i las son byas/ /rig pa gsang sngags rjes dran bya/ /de yi ro ni rtag bzung ste/ /tsa ru byas te bza' bar bya/ /rgyud dang rgyud du ngas bshad pa'i/ /dngos grub rnams ni bzhin pa'am/ /bla ma mnyes pa thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir bla ma rtag mnyes bya/ /zhes pa'i lung drangs te rung bar bshad pa ltar yin no/ /lung de yang rdo rje a ral+li'i rgyud yin zhes gsungs pas bod kyi da lta'i rdo rje a ral+li'i rgyud 'di la 'gyur tshad gcig yod dam brtag go rig ma brgyad ni/ ji skad du/ kyai rdo rje las dbang gi skabs su/ bcu gnyis brgyad gnyis lon pa ni/ /rig ma bde chen brgyad po nyid/ /do shal rkang gdub kyis brgyan pa/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab tu gzhug/ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang*/ /bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang*/ /de bzhin zhang po'i chung ma dang*/ /ma yi spun dang sgyug mo dang*/ /de bzhin pha yi sring mo nyid/ /rig ma brgyad du rab tu grags/ /des gsungs pa ltar te/ /snga mas rigs bsgres pas go sla zhing*/ /sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa rgyud sde gzhan nas gsungs pa rnams ni yi ges 'jigs pas ma bris so/ /gang ltar yang de dag thams cad dpal saṃ pu ṭi las/ dbang na ri dwags kyi mig ma dang*/ sked pa phra ba dang*/ ro smad rgyas pa dang*/ nu ma mtho ba dang*/ bha ga bzang ba dang*/ dam tshig gi spyod pa la shin tu dam pa dang*/ de kho na la gnas pa dang*/ sngags dang rgyud shes pa dang*/ sgrub pa po'i dbang po la gnas gsum du phye ba'i bu mo 'di dag bshad do zhes dang*/ ma rnyed ji ltar gang rnyed de/ /de bzhin cu drug lon pa nyid/ /dang po lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /mi mdzes phyag rgya rnyed nas ni/ /zhes pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las kyang*/

dbang gi skabs su/ /bcu gnyis yang na bcu drug gam/ /ma rnyed nyi shu lon pa'ang rung*/ /nyi shu yan chad phyag rgya gzhan/ /des ni dngos grub thag ring byed/ /sring mo yang na bu mo 'am/ /chung ma bla ma la dbul bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid spyi dang*/ khyad par dbang gi don du dbul ba la/ bla ma'i bka' bcog pa dang*/ lus ngag dang khams ma mthun pa'i g.yo sgyu can dang*/ bla ma mi gtsang bar sems pa dang*/ gzhan yang ji skad du/ bla ma'i yon tan shes gyur kyang*/ /gzhan du de las cung zad bsnyad/ /bla ma ma mthong ltar byed cing*/ /'ong kyang de la phyag mi 'tshal/ /rje btsun de dang mi mthun pa'i/ /mi gzhan de dang rtse dga' byed/ /ces pa'i skyon spangs shing*/ mig gi rtse dang mig rtsa rgod/ /glal zhing skad cig bsam pa dang*/ /skad cig rgod pa'i 'phro bzhag nas/ /bsam zhing yang na smra'am 'dzum/ /rje btsun bla ma mthong gyur na/ /dga' zhing mdzes lta 'dzum par byed/ /de yi bka' stsal nyan zhing mos/ /bteg pa'i tshul gyis zhe sar ldan/ /gzhan du de la snyan par brjod/ /ces dang*/ rdo rje phreng bar/ ji ltar de nyid rdo rje 'chang*/ /bu mo skal ldan mig yangs ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan/ /rkam chags med cing chags sems ldan/ /sgeg pas myos shing bsgyings dang bcas/ /nu rgyas sngo bsang nyams dga' ba/ /rnam rtog med cing mang du thos/ /sgrub pos de srid 'dod pa bya/ /zhes sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan zhing*/ gong du drangs pa ltar bha ga bzang ba zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ ba spu med pa dang*/ sha che ba dang*/ rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba dang*/ glang po che'i ze ba ltar 'khrang pa dang*/ skye gnas yangs pa dang*/ khrag dang khu ba rtag tu 'dzag pa ste/ drug po de dag ni skal bzang ma ste su bha ga yin la/ de dag ni sgrub pa po la mchog ster bar byed ces sogs dang*/ zhal lung sogs las gsungs pa bzhin skye gnas kyi skyon rnams spangs shing yon tan rnams dang ldan pa dgos so/

/'o na rig ma brgyad po 'di gau rī la sogs pa lha mo brgyad kyi rigs yin pas na/ rgyud de'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa la ni 'os kyis/ 'khor lo bde mchog la ci ltar 'gre zhe na/ spyir ni thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig las/ phal che ba ni rgyud gcig nas gcig tu kha skongs dgos so/ /de lta ma yin par rang gi rgyud las mi gsal ba'i cho ga gtan nas mi rung na/ rgyud sde 'ga' zhig gi dkyil 'khor la mchod yon tsam yang dbul du mi rung bar 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad po yang rgyud 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la gtan nas med pa ni ma yin te/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang rgyud gcig pa yang grags shing*/ der ma zad mngon brjod dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor dngos su dkyil 'khor la yang bkod pas 'dir de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de yang khwa gdong la sogs pa bzhi gau rī dang tsau rī be tā lī puk+ka sī bzhi ste/ gdong gnyan bzhi ni khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ rta mgrin dang*/ gshin rje gshed de yab bzhi sbas pa'i tshul dang*/ gshin rjes brtan ma sogs bzhi/ ghasma rī/ shā ba rī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ ḍom+bhi nī ste/ phyed gzugs kyi g.yas pa rnams ni dbyig sngon can/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ mi g.yo ba/ stobs po che ste yab rnams sbas pa yin no/ / khro bo chen po mngon grub pa/ khro mo dang bcas gdug pa gnon/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang*/ khro bo rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du mang du gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa ni rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa gtso bor tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya'am/ mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su gsungs pa mang ngo*/ /sum cu rtsa drug po de dag ni mi rigs kyis phye ba yin te/ de dag kyang dmangs rigs mo/ rje rigs mo/ rgyal rigs mo/ bram ze mo/ mkhar ba mkhan mo/

chang 'tshong ma/ gser mkhan ma/ phreng mkhan ma/ thag mkhan ma/ nor bu mkhan ma/ sha 'tshong ma/ rdza mkhan ma/ 'khur ba mkhan ma/ smad 'tshong ma/ tshim bu ma/ nya ba mo/ gar mkhan mo/ tshos mkhan ma/ rgya skyegs mkhan mo/ srin bal mkhan mo/ til mar mkhan mo/ lcags mgar mo/ ko lpags mkhan mo/ shing bzo mo/ 'dreg mkhan mo/ smin ma mkhan mo/ khron pa mkhan mo/ 'od ma'i gar mkhan ma/ kla klo ma/ phyag dar ma/ gdol pa mo/ stag gzig mo/ smyon thabs mo/ ro bsreg mo/ bhil+li mo/ ro khrod mo rnams so/ /rigs brgya zhes bya ba ni/ rigs chung nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams la nang tshan du lha mo bzhi'i rigs kyi phyag rgyas phye bas brgya'o/ /'di nyid ni mtshon par bya ba ste/ mtha' yas pa'i rigs kyi bar du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul la/ thabs bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang shes rab ma rnams mnyam par sbyar bas ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa las ma g.yos kyang*/ rkyen des byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i tshe snang ba dang*/ mched pa dang*/ nyer thob ste ye shes gsum mam/ dga' ba dang po gsum gsal bar mtshon pa ste mngon du gyur zhing*/ bzhi pa lhan skyes kyi dga' ba dang*/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba ni/ dam pa'i bde ba ste des mnyes par bgyi'o/ /yul lnga'i zhes sogs ni de nyid rgyas par bshad pa ste/ yul lnga ni gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste/ de rnams kyi dbye ba rnam pa gsum ni sdug par dang mi sdug pa dang bar ma'o/ /de rnams thams cad mchod pa'i tshul du bsten pa ni/ /de las lus sems bde ba chen po'i rgyud 'gyur ba ste/ spyir 'dod yon tsam gyis mnyes tshul dang*/ khyad par rig ma'i bde chen gyis mnyes tshul ni/ rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs/ /de bzhin gzugs la dbye ba gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ rig ma'i gzugs spyi dang*/ khyad par gyi gnas nu ma dang*/ bha ga sogs rnams mthaung bas bde ba dam pa bskyed pa ste/

de yang mthong ba la brten te 'dod chags chen pos yongs su bskul te/ dbu ma cung zad rgyas pa las gtum mo 'bar ba'i zhu bde khyad par can skyes bas dga' ba bzhi'am snang ba gsum gyi ye shes khyad par can skye/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags rnams 'od gsal du thim pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid du nye bar song ste/ spang bya'i bag chags de lta bus 'joms par byed do/ /de yang yul sdug pas ni/ chags pa'i ming can dga' ba dang po dang*/ mi sdug pas ni chags bral gyi ming can dga' ba gnyis pa dang*/ bar mas ni dga' ba bar ma bstan pa yin no/ /de bzhin du/ yang dag glu dang brjod bral dbyangs/ /de bzhin sgra la dbye ba gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ dga' ba'i sgra dang glu dbyangs dang*/ /'dod pa'i gtam gyi sgra'i rkyen dang*/ /ga pur a kar dza ti sogs/ /de bzhin dri la dbye ba gsum/ /zhes dri bzang gis gsar du bgos pa'am/ bha ga dang lus kyi dri tshor ba'i rkyen dang*/ 'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang*/ de bzhin ro la dbye ba gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ ro 'dzin dang ma mchu'i ro myang ba'i rkyen dang*/ rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyor/ /gos dang 'khyud sogs dbye ba gsum/ /zhes 'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pa phyi'i reg bya dang*/ dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyar ba phyi nang gnyis ka'i reg byas rkyen byed de/ de thams cad la dbye ba gsum zhes bya ba ni ye shes gsum po de nyid do/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa rgyud las kyang*/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /zhes sogs 'dod yon lnga char la gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yang de nyid yin no/ /bzhi pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa la/ nyer spyod lnga'i nges don/ 'dod yon lnga'i nges don/ zhi ba'i btung ba'i nges don du bshad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ me tog gi mchod pa ni de kho na nyid du bshad pa/ ji skad du/ rdo rje phreng ba las/

yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar phyung*/ /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pas/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir rdo rje nyi ma zhes pa ni shes rab ma'i rak+ta'o/ /de la thabs shes mnyam par sbyar te rak+ta'i dwangs ma thabs kyi dbu ma'i nang du drangs te/ spyi bor thim par byed pa ni/ me tog bdag nyid mchod pas/ /zhes pa'i don te/ de yang mthong lam gyi snga logs su de lta bu byung ba na/ de ltar thim pa'i rkyen gyis bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes byang chub kyi lam yan lag bdun gyi rnam par 'byung ba ni me tog gi mchod pa'i nges don no/ /'dis ni phyag rgya'i dmar cha 'dren pa la khungs med ces dgag pa byed pa rnams kyang bsal ba yin no/ /gtum mo sogs ni bdug spos kyi nges don no/ / ji skad du/ rnam rtog tshogs kyisayul min zhing*/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /nges par bsreg pa de yi spos/ /zhes te/ lte ba'i gtum mo rab tu 'bar bas rnam rtog mtha' dag bsregs pas/ gsal stong gi ye shes skye ba ni bdug spos dang 'dra'o/ /mar me'i nges don ni/ yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung*/ /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /zhes pa ltar snying kha'i mi shigs pa'i thig le hūṃ gi dbyangs dang ldan pa rlung 'od zer lnga pa 'phro ba ni mar me ste/ der rlung sems thim pas 'od gsal 'char ba ni 'bar ba'i don no/ /zla bas zhes sogs ni dri'i byug pa'i nges don te/ zla ba ni byang chub kyi sems te/ ji skad du/ bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*/ /de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ /zhes gsungs/ de la nam mkha' ste gsang ba'i pad+mar rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i sna rtser thabs kyi kun+da byang chub kyi sems sad pa ste zhu zhing bskul/ de nyid slar drangs te rtsa'i gnas thams cad du zhugs pa ste khyab par byed pa'i ye shes lhan cig skyes pa'o/

/stong nyid rnam pa ni rnam kun mchog ldan kyi stong gzugs te stong nyid rnam pa dang bcas pa'o/ /ji skad du/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag bsten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i phyir ni mchod par bya/ /zhes pa ste dbang po lnga'i yul du gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i snang ba stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin 'gag pa med pa la brten nas ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel ba ni/ yul lnga zas su za ba'i phyir/ zhal zas dang 'dra ba'o/ /de ltar na/ lte ba'i gtum mo rab tu 'bar bas mi rtog pa'i ye shes khyad par can skye ba yin zhing*/ khams dkar dmar gyi bgrod pa thim pa'i bde stong dang*/ rlung snying gar thim pa'i 'od gsal rtags snang khyad par can gyi ye shes rnams de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnam pa lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos thams cad gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par rtogs pa gzugs kyi mchod pa dang*/ sgra grag stong rang bzhin med par shes pas/ sems can so so'i skad dang bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa'i gsung sgra dbyangs thams cad pa yin yang mngon zhen med pa sgra dang*/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pa ston pas 'jig rten gsum du snyan grags kyi dri bzang gis khyab pa ni dri dang*/ zhu ba'i bde ba chen po ro mngar po myong ba lta bus tshim pa ni ro dang*/ zung 'jug rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde ba mchog reg bya phun sum tshogs pa lta bu thob pa ni/ reg bya'i 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ste/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur nas sprul pa sna tshogs pas dad par byed cing chos ston pa ni 'dod yon lnga'i nges don gyi mchod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni khyad par sogs te/ de la khyad par zhes pa'i tshig gis snga ma rnams kyi nang nas logs su do gal che bar ston pa ste/ sngar bshad pa gang gi nang du 'dus zhe na/ dri dang me tog gi nges don du'o/

/nang gi lus so/ /bdag nyid ni de'i ngo bo las byung ba'o/ /sbrang rtsi ste dri chu dang*/ mtshal te rdul dang*/ ga bur te khu ba dang bcas pa/ tsan dan dmar po ni sha chen te de'i dwangs ma dang*/ sbyar ba zhes pas gzhi mnyam yang shug la 'phangs pa yin no/ /rdo rje kun mtshan ni hūṃ yig la sogs pa'i mtshan mas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /thabs kyi sbom po ste rdo rje shes rab kyi mtha' ltag ste pad+ma mnyam par sbyar ba las zhi ba ste/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje bu gas 'thung zhing myangs pas/ rang gi lus kyi rdzas thig le des sangs rgyas te phung po lnga dang*/ byang sems te dbang po drug po thams cad bde bas mchod par bya zhes te/ bdag dang phyag rgya'i bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs mas bde ba chen po khyad par can sgrub ste/ zhi ba'i btung ba'i nges don no/ /'dis dngos bstan gyis nang mchod byin rlabs bsten tshul phan yon dang bcas pa ston pa yin no/ /sbas don ni thabs shes kyi dwangs ma lnga po dbu mar drangs te spyi bor thim pa las byung ba'i ye shes de kho na nyid des bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi lha la mchod pa yin no/ /gsum pa don bsdu ni/ mdor na zhes sogs te 'jig rten khams kun zhes pa ni/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad do/ /gsum pa bshags pa la/ spyi don dang yan lag gi don gnyis kyi dang po la/ stobs bzhi'i ngos bzung*/ de'i sgo nas bshags tshul/ bshags pas 'dag tshul lo/ /dang po la sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas la drag tu 'gyod pa'o/ /gnyen po kun spyod kyi stobs ni/ sdig pa zad pa'i don tu dge ba'i dpung tshol ba'o/ /'di la mdo rgyud zab mo la brten pa dang*/ stong nyid la mos pas thos sgom byed pa dang*/ gzungs sngags bzlas pa dang*/ sku gzugs bzheng pa dang*/ mtshan 'dzin pa dang*/ mchod pa byed pa ste drug po rnam gal che'o/ /slar ldog pa'i stobs ni/

phyin chad sdom sems so/ /rten gyi stobs ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sgom pa'o/ /'o na stobs bzhi ma tshangs na bshags par mi nus sam zhe na/ re res kyang cung zad nus mod/ las sdig pa'i stobs chen po 'dag pa la bzhi tshang dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni yan lag gi don gyi skabs su 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ las stobs che ba rnams thag bsrings/ 'bring po rnams rnam smin chen po chung ngur 'bring bar byed/ chung ngu rnams 'bras bu 'byin mi nus su byed do/ /sa bon ni bden pa mthong na ma gtogs mi ldog go /gnyis pa la/ spyir sdig pa thams cad bshags pa dang*/ khyad par du sngags kyi ltung ba bshags pa'o/ /dang po la dus kyi khyad par/ kun slong gi khyad par/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ ji ltar bshags tshul/ bshags bya'i dbye ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni 'khor ba sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni dug gsum sogs te nyon mongs mang ba ltung ba'i rgyud bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni lus ngag sogs so/ / bzhi pa ni thams cad sogs so/ /lnga pa la gnyis las dang po nyes pa'i rgyu'i dbye ba ni mi shes sogs te de la mi shes pa ni ltung ba dang ltung ba ma yin pa'i gnas mi shes pa/ ma gus pa ni las 'bras la yid ches shas chung ba'i skyon gyis nyes pa'am ltung ba khyad du sod pa'i las 'bras sogs chos la ma gus pa dang*/ lam ston pa po la ma gus pas des gdams pa la mi nyan pa'o/ / bag med pa ni dran pa dang shes bzhin chung bas yul rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe rang dbang med par bya ba ma yin pa la 'jug pa te ma bsdams pa'o/ /de ltar gsum dang*/ gong du nyon mongs pa mang ba yang bshad zin pas rgyu bzhi ste/ de la nyon mongs pa mang ba ni/ nyon mongs pa shin tu shugs drag pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bshags par bya rgyu'i nyes pa'i dbye ba ni gnyis te/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ste/ sems can gang gis spyad kyang nyes par 'gyur ba mi dge ba bcu lta bu'o/

/bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya kho nar rgyal bas gsungs pa rnams la/ sdom pa gsum thob pa so sos 'das na bcas pa las 'gal ba'i nyes par 'gyur ro/ / des na sdom pa gsum char mnos pa'i dbang du byas nas so sor thar pa'i bslab bya phra rags rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung dang*/ sbom po dang nyes bcas rnams dang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyi bslab bya rnams las bdag nyid kyis 'das pa'am/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong ba'i khyad par yin pas na/ sems can gzhan gyis kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa thams cad kyang yid kyis bshags par bya ba kho na'o/ /gnyis pa la spang bya'i dam tshig ma spangs pa'i ltung ba dang*/ bsgrub bya ma bsgrubs pa'i ltung ba bshad pa dang*/ ma tshang ba rgyud la kha 'phangs pa'o/ /dang po la spyi don ni ltung ba rnams kyi yan lag ltung ba'i dbye bsdu/ go rim/ srung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ mi 'byung ba'i thabs/ byung na phyir bcos pa/ rgyud gang las bshad pa ste bdun las/ dang po la yan lag lnga tshang dgos te/ de la yan lag lnga ni/ rten gyi yan lag yul gyi yan lag bsam pa'i yan lag sbyor ba'i yan lag mthar thug gi yan lag go /dang po ni/ gsang sngags nang gi dam tshig thob la ma nyams pa shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa cig dgos te/ sngags kyi sdom pa ma thob pa la'ang nyes pa tsam du 'gyur ba srid mod/ de la bcas pa ma mdzad cing*/ dam tshig nyams pa la ni slar 'di dag byas pas sdig pa ni shin tu che mod kyi/ sdom pa nyams zin pa'i phyir de gnyis la rtsa ltung du mi 'gyur ro/ /shes pa rang bzhin du mi gnas pa la'ang 'du shes ma 'khrul ba 'byung dkon zhing*/ bsam bzhin pa med pa'i phyir ltung ba dngos gzhi rnams mi rdzogs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon nas bu med kyi bar dang*/ ma sbyangs pa'i rig ma nas dkyil 'khor kyi las kyi bar so sor sbyar ro/

/gsum pa la kun slong dang 'du shes gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la gnyis las/ ngo bo ni gong du bshad pa'i ltung ba'i rgyu bzhi po gang rung ngo*/ khyad par gyi ltung ba so so'i sbyor ba'i dus su ngo tsha med pa/ dngos gzhi'i dus su gnyen pos ma sleb pa/ rjes kyi dus su 'gyod pa med pa ste gsum mam yang dang yang du byed par 'dod pa dang dga' bar byed pa dang*/ mi 'gyod pa dang*/ phyir mi 'chos pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan no/ /des na ched du bsam pa mtshan nyid bzhi ldan nam/ gsum ldan ni rtsa ltung kun nas slong ba'i khyad par ro zhes grub bo/ /de la ngo tsha med pa ni 'di la brten te nyes pa 'ong snyam pa med pa'o/ /gnyen pos ma sleb pa ni byed 'dod kyi rgyun ma chad pa'o/ /'gyod pa med pa ni byas zin ma thag pa'i skad cig ma la las byas pa de la 'gyod pa ma skyes pa ste/ 'di byung na ltung ba snga dro byas nas dgongs mo 'gyod pa skyes pa lta bus ni rtsa ltung mi khegs so/ /yang dang yang du byed pa'i don ni byed 'dod yang yang skyes pa ste/ ma byas bar du byed 'dod ma log pa'o/ /dga' bar byed pa ni byed thub pa na sems mgu ba'o/ /mi 'gyod pa ni ltung ba de la skyon du mi blta ba'o/ /phyir mi 'chos pa ni byas ma thag pa'i dus der/ phyir bcos byed 'dod med pa'i 'dzems bag med pa yin no/ /spyir khyad par 'di rnams 'dir bstan ltung ba thams cad la 'jug kyang*/ rtsa ltung du 'gro ba la de dag thams cad tshang dgos pa'i nges pa ni med de/ 'gyod pa med pa dang*/ phyir mi 'chos pa lta bu ma tshang yang*/ rdo rje spun dang slob dpon bkrongs pa lta bu ste/ gzhan yang lus ngag gi las 'ga' zhig la yang de lta bu'i gnas skabs yod do/ /de dag shin tu sdig che yang yan lag ma tshang ba'i phyir rtsa ltung dngos kyi ming mi thob bam snyam na/ 'dir ni yid kyi bslab bya gtso che ba'i phyir yan lag phra mo re tsam tshang ma tshang la rag ma lus te gtso bo'i don thams cad tshang bas so/

/des na khyad par thams cad tshang dgos pa dang*/ re res kyang chog pa'i dbye ba zhib mo shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa 'du shes ni de la der shes ma 'khrul pa'o/ /bzhi pa sbyor ba'i yan lag ni de dang de byed pa ste/ brnyas shing smod pa nas dkyil 'khor gyi las la 'jug pa'i bar ro/ /lnga pa mthar thug ni 'di dang 'di zin pa na rtsa ltung du 'gyur zhes pa'i dus skabs rnams te brnyas pa gzhan gyi go ba lta bu dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi las sna gcig grub pa'i bar du'o/ /gnyis pa la dbye ba dang*/ bsdu ba dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje'i theg pa 'dir dam tshig gi bsrung bya shin tu mang na yang*/ ltung ba la dbye na rtsa ltung dang*/ sbom po'i ltung ba gnyis kyi dbye ba mdzad pa sha stag yod pas/ rtsa ltung dang*/ sbom po phyogs mthun dang bcas pa gnyis su dbye ba ste/ sbom po rnams kyang don gyi rtsa ltung gi yan lag yin no/ /de la rtsa ltung gi sgra don/ bsrungs na dngos grub kyi rtsa ba dang*/ ma bsrung na nyes pa'i rtsa ba zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs pa la/ /phyis kyi shing rta chen po ni/ /kun mkhyen pad ma dkar po la gnas su mchis so/ /phyis kyi shing rta chen po'i zhal nas/ 'o na dngos grub kyi rtsa bar 'gro ba srid pa'i skabs 'dug pas ltung ba yin pa mi 'thad/ des na sdom pa'i rtsa ba 'jig par byed pas rtsa ltung yin gsung*/ dgag pa 'di ni rang nyid rtsod pa la mnyes pa tsam zhig ston par byed kyi snying po ni med de/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ dper na rdo rje slob dpon de yul du byas nas brnyas na nyes pa dang*/ ma brnyas shing gus par bsten na dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yin te/ rtsa ba ste slob dpon la brten pa'i ltung ba zhes bya/ de'i rig pas gzhan thams cad shes te/ de yang slob dpon la brnyas pa'i ngo bo tha dad pa'i rtsa ltung dang po ma bsrungs ba dang slob dpon la brnyas pa'i ltung ba yang ngo bo tha dad pa zhig dang*/

mi brnyas pa'i bsam sbyor las gzhan pa'i rtsa ltung dang po bsrung ba'i ngo bo rdzas grub cig nam yang mi srid do/ /de la khyed kyis ni bsrungs ba dang mi bsrungs pa gnyis ka ma yin pa'i lhung ba zhig yod par byas nas/ de bsrungs ma bsrung la rtsa bar 'jog pa gong ma'i bzhed par bzung 'dug pa'i phyir phyogs snga ma longs shing*/ rig pa de yang rdzas spyi tsam gyi tshig la 'khri ba yin pa'i phyir/ sdom pa'i rtsa ba gcod ces pa yang*/ dper na so so thar pa'i sdom pa la/ mngon pa mdzod las/ kha che rnams ni byung ba la/ /bu lon nor bzhin gnyis su 'dod/ /ces pa ltar 'dir yang yin te/ khyed kyi lugs la sdom pa rtsa ba nas bcad na/ sdom pa gtan med du 'gro dgos pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lor/ gsang dbang thob pa tshun chad la rtsa ltung byung ba/ chad las kyi brtul zhugs drag pos slar sor chud par bshad pa'i phyir/ sdom pa rtsa ba nas med pa chad las tsam gyis gsar du skye ba ngo mtshar che/ slar yang dbang bskur zhu bar bshad pas sdom pa des thob pa yin snyam na/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba gang zhig dag pa'i slad du slar yang dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug bya ste/ zhes dang*/ gal te bla ma dmod de bzhin/ /dam tshig bag med gyur pa na/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor des bris la/ /bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags zhes ltung ba dag byed du bshad kyi/ sdom pa len byed du ma bshad/ de thob pas ltung ba 'dag pa yin snyam na/ chad las sogs kyi dgos pa yang ci/ 'dir smras pa/ mkhas par mngon par khengs pa yis/ /grags pa'i don du gang smra ba/ /bdag nyid skyon can gzhan dag gi /lugs bzang dag la 'bad nas smad/ /'di ni pad+ma dkar po la bskur pa 'debs pa yin no/ /zhes pa yang smras so/ /des na rtsa ltung gi sdom pa shin tu skyon can du byas nas/ yon tan gyi rten gtan mi byed pa dang*/ yan lag gi ltung bas kyang gong ma'i yon tan thob pa'i gegs shin tu che ba dang*/

gnyis kas kyang dmyal bar 'phen zhing*/ sngags kyi bya ba dang cho ga thams cad la mi dbang bar byed pa yin no/ /yan lag gi ltung ba zhais pa'i yan lag ni/ rtsa ltung gi yan lag go /gnyis pa bsdu ba ni spyir mang du grags na yang 'thad pa'i phyogs ni lam la bltos pa dang*/ dbang la bltos pa dang*/ dam tshig la bltos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yul chos ston pa po dang*/ grogs dang*/ nyams su blang bya'i chos so/ /dang po la brten pa'i ltung ba ni rtsa ltung dang po'o/ /grogs la gnyis te/ yang dag pa'i grogs dang*/ phyin ci log gnyis las/ dang po la log sgrub ni/ gsum pa dang bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa la brten pa ni bcu pa'o/ /chos la gnyis te/ lung dang sgrub pa'o/ /lung gi chos la skur ba 'debs pa ni drug pa dang*/ ston pa'i yul ma yin pa la ston pa bdun pa'o/ /sgrub pa'i chos la gsum/ lam gyi rten sems bskyed rgyu 'bras la brten pa bzhi pa dang lnga pa gnyis so/ /'jug sems kyi bslab pa spyi las 'das pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /lam gyi ngo bo la lha'i rnal 'byor la brten pa brgyad pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la brten pa dgu pa dang bcu gcig pa rnams so/ /'di gnyis bskyed rdzogs kyi bsdu bar sbyor ba ni rang gis rnal 'byor rgyud dang thun mong bar bshad pa dang nang 'gal ba'o/ /lam gyi yan lag la gnyis bza' ba'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba bcu gsum pa dang*/ lam gyi grogs dang 'gal ba bcu bzhi pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang po bdun dang bcu gnyis pa dbang spyi dang*/ brgyad pa dang bcu pa ni du ma dbang gi dang*/ dgu pa dang bcu gcig pa gnyis bzhi pa'i dang*/ bcu gsum pa gsang dbang gi dang*/ bcu bzhi pa shes rab ye shes kyi dam tshig nyams pa'o zhes pa shas che ba'i dbang du byas te/ cha shas ni dbang bzhi ka la bcu bzhi po thams cad kyi cha shas yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig gi nang tshan rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba ni rtsa ltung dang po dang*/
