phyag rgya bsten pa'i nus pa med pa rnams ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten zhes tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dmigs pa bsal lo/ /rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas dbye na/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag dkyil 'khor ltar bkod cing bsgoms nas mchod pa ni tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya/ bdag bskyed bsdus shing mdun bskyed rgyas pa mchod pa ni/ mdun bskyed gtso bor mchod pa zhes bya/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba du ma so sor bsgom pa ni/ mdza' ba 'dus pa'i ston mo zhes bya/ so sor dkyil 'khor rigs mthun sgom pa ni/ bdag bskyed gtso bor gyur pa zhes bya kha cig gzhon nu ma mchod pa dang*/ rigs ldan ma mchod pa yang tshogs 'khor gyi dbye bar byed pa ni bzhad gad kyi gnas te/ 'dir bstan gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo'i ston mo tshogs 'khor gsum gang yang yin pa gnyis kyis tshogs 'khor la khyab par khas blangs te/ de la dbye na de gnyis yod ces byas pa'i phyir ro/ /de gnyis tshogs 'khor yin na/ ce spyang bya rog la mchod pa la sogs pa yang ci'i phyir tshogs 'khor ma yin/ gsum pa ni/ kha cig dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa cho ga shes pa'i tshogs dang*/ de nyid bcu shes pa'i rdo rje slob dpon te/ zhes 'bri zhing ḍom+bi he ru ka'i lung 'dren par byed do/ /'di ni cung zad rtsings te mtshan nyid de tsam tshang ba rnal 'byor phyi'i rgyud 'ba' zhig sgom pa la yang yod pa'i phyir/ slob dpon ni des na bla med 'di'i lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig dang*/ tshogs pa thams cad kyang bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du dam tshig thob la ma nyams pa/ 'di'i cho ga dang bslab bya shes pa/ bla ma la gus pa/ rtog pa chung ba/ nad dang bcas pa ma yin pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ ḍom+bi he ru ka'i 'du ba bsgrags pa las/ 'khor lo dam pa 'di dag kyang phal pa'i gnas su bskor bar mi bya ste tshong 'dus su spang bar bya'o/

/g.yeng pa'i grong dang*/ bram ze'i khyim dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang*/ rje rigs kyi khyim dang*/ dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang*/ kla klo bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ mu stegs kyi grong dang*/ 'brog dgon gcan gzan rgyu ba'i gnas dag kyang spang bar bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma rgyu ba'i gnas dang*/ grong zad pa'i mtha' dang*/ dgon pa dang*/ lha khang dang*/ dur khrod dang*/ phug stong dang*/ shing drung dang*/ nags tshal gyi mthongs de dag tu tshogs kyi khang pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa brtsigs te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa ni yar ngo dang mar ngo'i tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ bcu la sogs pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ so so'i gdan dang*/ zas kyi snod spyad kyi khyad par dang*/ gral gyi tshul la sogs pa bde mchog nyid kyi rim pa phyag rdor stod 'grail las 'byung ba bzhin rgyas par 'grub na bya/ ma grub na mi ro'i gzugs brnyan nam/ stag lpags sam/ sna tshogs pad+ma bris pa'i gdan so sor bshams te tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'am/ rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa lta bu'i sangs rgyas gar gyi don du tshogs dkyil bsdus pa yin na/ spyod pa'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar tshogs khang rim pa gsum pa chu tshon gyis dkyil 'khor yang bris/ lha'i chas su 'jug pa'i yo byad rnams kyang dgos so/ /thams cad la yang mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad dang*/ sha chang gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' btung sna tshogs pa'o/ kha cig dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dang*/ gang zag mchod pa'i yo byad ces tha dad du 'byed cing*/ ji skad du/ gang zhig nyi ma so sor dam tshig gi bya ba de ni kha na ma tho ba med pa'i go ku la sogs pa lnga dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa lnga'i ril bu yungs kar tshad tsam nyi ma so sor dam tshig gi don du bsten par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so snyam pa dang*/ za ba po med na gsod pa po yang mi 'byung ngo zhes sogs kyi tshig la 'khrul nas/

rang byung gi tshogs 'khor la sha mi bza' 'o/ /zhes smra ba ni/ de lta na lung de'i 'phros la rtag par kha na ma tho ba med pa'i chang dang*/ bud med ni sgom pa'i slad du rmongs pa med pa'i chos kyis gsungs so/ /zhes pas rab byung gis tshogs 'khor la chang dang bud med bsten rung bar 'gyur na kho bo cag ni de yang 'dod mod/ khyed la ni drod thob pa ma gtogs nam yang khas len pa'i gnas med do/ /dug bdud rtsir sgyur ba la sogs pa nus pa ma thob par dam rdzas thigs re tsam lce la 'jog pa ma gtogs bsten du mi rung zhes pa dang*/ khyim pa dang rnal 'byor pa sngags pas sha chang la longs spyod ces pa ni/ bdag bskyed dang lus dkyil gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gyi go mi chod par byas shing khyim pa'i sngags pa kun nus ldan du khas blangs pas shin tu nongs shing*/ chang la sreg pa ngu 'bod du skye bar gsungs pa'i lung yang rab byung rkyang pa la bcas par mi 'dug cing*/ 'thung na srid pas kyang ma khyab la/ skabs 'dir zas la tha mal pa'i sred pa byung na/ zas gang la sred kyang nyes dmigs che bar bshad cing*/ bslab byar yang zas la sred pa mi byed par bshad pas/ khyed nyid kyi lugs la ni tshogs 'khor gyi bslab bya phra mo re dang 'gal yang dmyal ba mnar med du skye zer 'jigs 'jigs mo byed par snang bas/ bu ram dang zhun mar la sogs pa yang za don med/ thogs med sku mched kyis gsungs zer kyang thogs med sku mched dngos slob dang bcas pas mdzad pa'i gsang sngags nang gi bstan bcos sna gcig kyang rgya bod gnyis char na ston rgyu med pas brdzun de la su zhig yid ches/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung ni/ spyod bsdus sgron me'i spros bcas kyi spyod pa'i skabs kyi tshogs 'khor dang*/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong sogs ni/ khyed kyi lugs de la gnod byed kho nar 'bab pas lung rnams bris na mangs par 'gyur te/

nus pa yod pa dang*/ sgom byung gi lta ba mthar thug gis zin pa sogs gtan nas med kyang bsam pa'i khyad par gyis rang gi rtsom pas/ pha dang dgra bcom pa shi ba la yang nyes pa ma byung ba sogs du ma bsgrubs na mchod pa'i don du lta/ dam rdzas 'gog pa ga la zhig/des na chags sdang gis kun nas bslangs te dam pa rnams la sdig gsog cing*/ chos min gyi spyod pa la tshe gang bskyal nas/ mchod pa'i skabs su dam rdzas mi bza' ba tsam gyis grol bar lta ba kye ma mtshar gyi mod/ smras pa/ sha chang bud med la dga' ba'i/ /ngan spyod thams cad je 'phel la/ /mchod pa'i dam tshig bkag tsam gyis/ khyod la legs spyod ci zhig 'byung*/ bdun pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po la gnas khang brgyan pa/ yo byad bshams pa/ slob dpon spyan drangs shing gsol ba 'debs pa/ tshogs pa gzhug pa/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ zhu 'bul rnams so/ /de'i tshogs pa gzhug pa ni/ las kyi rdo rje khro bo dbyug sngon gyi chas su zhugs shing*/ nga rgyal dang ldan pa la/ khro bo sngon po mdzes pa ste/ zhes sogs kyis nang du 'jug par gsol ba btab/ re re bzhin du ngag dang lus kyi bar bya/ mi shes pa rnams phyir bskrad/ gzhan rnams nang du 'jug pa'i tshig bcad brjod cing*/ rang rang so so'i gnas su 'god pa'o/ /dngos gzhi la drug ste/ ting nge 'dzin kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi myang bas tshim pa/ 'byung po'i tshogs gtor mas tshim pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa kha zas kyis tshim pa/ skye mched kyi lha rnams glu gar gyis tshim pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor lhan skyes kyi bde bas tshim pa ste/ tshim pa drug ldan zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa ni shin tu legs so/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi byin gyis brlabs la/

mdun bskyed mchod gtor dang bcas pa bya ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlabs nas/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /zhes sogs kyis drangs shing*/ tshig bcad kyis blangs la/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi dmigs pa gsal btab ste tshim par bza' ba yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ rdo rje'i glu dang gar la sogs pa lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bya ste/ skyes pa glu len na 'od dpag med/ gar byed na rnam snang*/ bu med glu len na gos dkar mo/ gar byed na sangs rgyas spyan ma'i nga rgyal byed/ drug pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi 'dod yon lngas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par bskyed nas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde stong yun ring du bsgom par bya'o/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ ma ma sring mo bu mo'am/ gal te mchod pa 'dod pa na/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis/ /rtog pa med pas bstab par bya/ /rab mchog de yi dngos grub ni/ /thob par 'di la the tshom med/ /ces sogs tshogs 'khor gyi le'ur gsungs te/ kyai rdor las kyang de dang 'dra'o/ / gal te de ltar mi nus na/ snying gar chang gis thig le byas te/ yi dam yab yum dang spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor du shes par byas te/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rjes chags rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /der tshogags byin gyis brlobs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus pa'i rtags su/ sgom pa'i dri dang*/ bya rgod kyi dri dang*/ ga bur dang tsan dan gyi dri 'byung zhing*/ ngang pa dang*/ ngur ba dang*/ ce spyang gi sgra 'byung stai/ rim pa bzhin sngags skyes dang*/ zhing skyes dang*/ lhan skyes kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags su bzhed do/ /rjes la lhag gtor btang ba/ mchod bstod bya ba/

bkra shis brjod pa/ lhag chad bskang ba/ smon lam btab pa/ mgron gshegs su gsol ba/ bla mas slar yang bsngo ba dang bkra shis brjod de rjes bsdu ba ste bdun no/ /cho ga dang lag len ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes drangs pa ma gtogs rang gis blang nas longs mi spyod/ chang dpa' mo dang*/ sha dpa' bos thog mar bza'/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtong len gnyis ka lag pa gnyis kas bya/ khyad par tshogs kyi gtso bo dang*/ de'i phyag rgya la pad+ma'i bskor bas 'bul zhing*/ des kyang de bzhin du len/ dam tshig lnga pa las/ hub sgra med cing ma yengs pas/ /cung zad 'thung zhing legs bskang te/ /zhes pa dang*/ snod ni sa la bzhag pa'am/ gzhan la byin par gyur pa'am/ /lag nas bo na chad pas bcad/ /rang gis thams cad mi btung ngo*/ /zhes kyang gsungs shing*/ ngag byin gyis brlob la/ mkha' 'gro rnams mnyes shing*/ skal med rnams mgo rmongs par bya ba phyogs kyi dgos pa'ang yod pas brda'i skad kyis smra bar bya/ mchod pa dang longs spyod thams cad tshim par longs spyod pa'i mos pa bya/ bza' btung la lces mi bldags/ zas sa rjen la mi bzhag thams cad snod gcig tu longs spyad pa'i mos pa bya/ mu dang khad bcad du mi dgang*/ tshogs kyi gtso bo la 'dren pa'i thog mthar phyag bya/ tshogs nas 'gro 'ong byed na phyag bya/ bya ba thams cad slob dpon la zhu/ rung ba la des kyang gnang ba mdzad/ gnang ba'i bya ba de'i 'phro la gzhan byed dgos byung na'ang tshogs su bsgrags/ bzod par gsol/ gnang ba zhus te 'gro/ rtsod pa byed pa byung na tshogs nas 'don/ 'don mi nus na rang gzhan du 'gro/ slob dpon gyi bka' ma byung bar glu gar dang*/ rol mo dang*/ dri lan dang*/ stan la 'dug pa mi bya/ rkang pa brkyang nas mi 'dug snabs dang mchil ma mi 'dor/ ma bsdams pa'i lus kyi kun spyod mi bya/ bza' btung dang rnal 'byor pho mo la chags par mi bya/

'jigs pa dang*/ dogs pa dang*/ ngo tsha ba dang*/ gtsang mi gtsang dang*/ bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog dang 'dzem bag mi bya/ der tshogs pa la ma gus pa dang skur pa mi gdab/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la skrag par mi bya/ zas la rkam pa dang*/ chags pa dang*/ 'tshag phyir mi za/ 'du 'dzi dang*/ nyan thos kyi bslab bya dang*/ rigs ngan dang*/ smad 'tshong dang*/ tshong dang*/ dmag dang*/ rgyal po la sogs pa'i gtam mi bya/ nyon mongs pa'i sems mi bskyed/ las dang po pas kyang dran shes kyis spyod pa dag par bya/ zas kyi lus ma 'byongs pa dang*/ lhag gtor ma btang bar phyir mi 'gro/ ma zhus pa dang bsngo ba smon lam ma byas par mi nyal/ yon bdag gis kyang tshim par mi nus pa'i mgron spyan mi 'dren/ spyan drangs pa rnams zad kyis tshim par bya/ phan tshul rtsod pa dang bshags mi bya/ nang du zhugs pa rnams kyis gsang ba thub par bya'o/ khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog 'dir gtsang sbra gsum dang ldan par spyod dgos te/ de gang zhe na/ rtsa rgyud las/ rigs dang rigs min ngor mi lta/ spyi gtsug la sogs bcing ba spang*/ pho nya gtsang sbra dang po yin/ /gnyis pa zla ba yin par 'dod/ /zas gcig tu ni za ba nyid/ /gtsang sbra gsum pa yin par 'dod/ ces gsungs te/ rigs kyi rnam par rtog pa spangs shing skra grol bar byas te/ pho nya mo bsten pa gtsang sbra dang po dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga sogs bza' ba ni zla ba ste gtsang sbra gnyis pa dang*/ thams cad snod gcig tu bsre ba ni gtsang sbra gsum pa'o/ /nang du sbyar na/ kun+da shes rab kyi sna rtser dbab pa zla ba dang*/ thabs shes kyi byang chub kyi sems nyis 'gyur du 'phel ba phyed phyed du byas te phan tshun du drangs te lus la khyab par byed pa ni snod gcig tu za ba'o/ /tshogs 'khor gyi skabs bslab bya las 'das na ngu 'bod sogs ngan song gsum gyi gnas ci rigs par 'phen pa nas tshe 'dir dbul ba dang nad bskyed pa sogs kyi bar 'byung ste/

sdang bas rtsod pa byas na ngu 'bod du skye ba dang*/ snod stong par bzhag na tshe 'dir 'byor pa la gnod pa lta bu'o/ /'on kyang 'di dag sgrub par nus pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ sgrub par mi nus pa la sems dag pa kho nas snang ba nyes med du 'gyur ba'ang mang du yod do/ /dgu pa la gnyis las/ phan yon gyi gtso bo'am dgos pa ni/ bde stong gi ye shes spel ba dang*/ lha mnyes pas dngos grub gnang zhing tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las kyang*/ 'dis ni rdo rje mnyes par 'gyur/ /ye shes me yis rab dgyes bya/ /rgyal ba rtag pa mnyes pa dang*/ /gser gyi mnga' bdag mnyes pa dang*/ /pad+ma gar dbang mnyes pa dang*/ /lcags mchog bdag po mnyes pa dang*/ /zhes pa la sogs pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams mnyes pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ sa bcu mngon du byed pa dang*/ 'phags pa gsum dang rigs drug thams cad tshim par byas par gsungs te/ bar pa gnyis spyod pa'i skabs kyi tshogs 'khor la dgongs so/ /spyir bza' ba'i ston mo dang sha chang dang phyag rgya'i mchod pa la/ bza' bya'i yon tan brgya 'gyur mar mes 'bras bu ster/ mar me brgya 'gyur shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chang*/ /chang gi brgya 'gyur na chung cha la rab sbyor te/ /de phyir 'dod pa'i sbyin pa nges par khyad par 'phags/ zhes tshogs kyi gtso bo'i mchod pa'i skabs su don dam bsnyen par spyan ras gzigs kyis bshad la/ gzhan yang gnas skabs kyi phan yon ni/ nyams chags zhi ba dang*/ rims dang*/ mu ge la sogs pa bzlog pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin gyis 'tshe ba zhi ba dang*/ 'chi ba bslu zhing longs spyod dbang thang rgyas pa la sogs pa 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ gang du zos pas 'dod don kun/ /sgrub pa pos ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcu pa ni/ 'dod yon la longs spyad pas ci'i phyir sgrib par mi 'gyur zhes sogs kyi rtsod pa spong ba ste/

zhib mo rnam par 'byed par bshad zin to/ /des na rdo shing las byas pa'i sku gzugs la mchod pa'ang bsod nams che na/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes shes par bya'o/ /drug pa slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ de nyid bcu yin te/ dkyil 'khor sogs so/ /de la phyi'i de nyid bcu ni/ dkyil 'khor sogs bcu ste/ bri ba dang*/ bskrad pa

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ bslang ba £© dang*/ sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag ni dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang*/ dang po sbyor ba sogs lha'i rnal 'byor ni ting nge 'dzin dang*/ lha la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs sogs phyag rgya dang*/ g.yas brkyang la sogs pa stangs stabs dang*/ skyil krung la sogs pa 'dug stangs dang £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ bzlas pa'i de nyid dang £© sbyin sreg gi las thams cad dang*/ lha so so'i mchod bstod dang*/ dngos grub dang las tshogs che chung gi las sbyor dang*/ bsrung zhing spyan 'dren mchod pa sogs sngon du 'gro bas gshegs su gsol ba ni slar bsdu ba'i de nyid do/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bcu ni/ phyir bzlog sogs te/ phyir bzlog gnyis ni/ khro bo bcu lta bu bsgoms nas phyir bzlog byed pa dang*/ 'khor lo bris pa'i phyir bzlog gnyis so/ /gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba gnyis dang*/ srung ma dang phral nas mngon spyod byed pa ni kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor chog dang*/ yid dang ngag gi rdor bzlas dang*/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ji lta ba bzhin sngon du song nas rim gnyis kyi lam bsgoms pa'i mthar grub pa lan gsum brtsams pa sogs byas kyang ma 'grub na rdo rje sems dpa' bsad pa'i cho ga byed pa ni drag shul sgrub pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ mchod pa dang dbang bskur ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pas yan lag dang bcas pa ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i de nyid de/ 'di dag ni rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin te/ spyir 'dra min du bshad pa mang du yod mod/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bdun pa gsang ste sgrub pa ni/ dpa' bo'i sogs te mi bri zhes pa ni bris sku sbed pa'o/ /mi gdon zhes pa ni rgyud la sogs pa gsang ba'i tshig rnams so/ /g.yon pa'i kun spyod sba zhes pa ni/ mtshon pa tsam ste gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad sba ba'o/

/brgyad pa bla ma mchod pa ni/ he ru ka dpal sogs te/ 'di la gnyis rkyen gyi slob dpon dang rdo rje'i slob dpon mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni he ru ka dpal gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyi slob dpon ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i mthar thug pa zhing skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams te/ 'dis nye bar mtshon pa las kyi phyag rgya thams cad do/ /de rnams rtsa rgyud kyi bza' ba'i le'u nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gyi tsā rus mchod pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon nam de dang 'brel ba gang mthong yang rab tu dang bas dga' ste/ rtsa sngags lan bdun bzlas zhing*/ hūṃ glur len pas phyag bya'o/ /des na sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos la mchod pa thams cad bya/ 'di da lta yang bsgrub pa bya zhing spyod pa'i dus kyi dam tshig kyang yin no/ /dgu pa ni/ rdo rje theg par sogs sho lo ka gcig ste/ rgyud sde bzhi po gang nas gsungs kyang rung ste mi bya bar gsungs pa rnams byas pa dang*/ sgrub par gsungs pa rnams mi byed pa ni/ 'di las gzhan du byed pa ste/ de ltar mi bgyid par dam 'cha' zhing*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dam tshig thams cad bsten pa dang*/ mdo sngags kyi lam thams cad bsten zhing bsgom par bgyi'o zhes dam 'cha' ba ste lam bsten pa'i don bsdu'o/ /bcu pa yongs su bsngo ba la/ bsngo bya'i dge ba/ ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul/ bsngo ba'i yul/ gang du bsngo ba rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin sogs tshig rkang pa lnga ste go sla'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan yang zhes pa la sogs pa rkang pa gnyis te/ dus gsum gyi dge ba ni/ rang gis byas pa gcig pur ma zad gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang yang lhan cig pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yul su zhig la bsngo ba yin na/ sems can thams cad la ste de rnams kyi byang chub kyi phyir du'o/ /bzhi pa la/ don gyi gtso bo mdor bstan pa dang de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/dang po ni/ sems can thams cad rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur te/ de'i lam du zhugs nas tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa la spyi'i don dang*/ yan lag gi don gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong gi lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag thun mong ma yin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la phung khams skye mched/ bden pa bzhi/ mtshan nyid gsum la sogs pa'i rnam par gzhag pa ni/ shin tu mangs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzhi'i dus kyi rnam gzhag de rnams bzhag ste/ sngags kho na la zhugs pa rnams kyis kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam la go bar rags pa tsam bskyed pa'i phyir tu yang snying mdor bsdus su brjod na/ lam dang 'bras bu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir sa dang lam zhes bya ba ni ming gi rnam grangs te/ gnas skabs yon tan so so'i rten byed cing gong ma'i yon tan 'phel ba'i gzhi yin pa dang*/ lam zhugs kyi sems can rnams gong nas gong du 'gro ba'i gzhi'am rten yin pa'i phyir sa zhes bya/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis byon pa'i shul/ ma byon pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi 'byon pa'i srol dod pas lam zhes bya/ 'dir theg dman nyan rang gi lam rim mi ston gyi theg chen nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ de la tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam ste lnga'i dang po ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam yang tshogs lam 'dir rim can du 'byung*/ gong ma rnams su ni skyes bu chen po'i lam 'ba' zhig go /sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ 'og tu rgyu'i rgyud kyi skabs su 'chad pa ltar gyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i de bzhin nyid/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa/ gser bzang po lta bu khams de'i nus pa theg pa gsum gyi rigs gsum du 'byed pa las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi nus pa de theg pa chen po'i dge bshes dang 'phrad pa dang*/

chos thos pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thos pa dang*/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal mthong ba la sogs pa'i rkyen bzang pos bag chags sad de/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod 'byung ba yin no/ /de nyid theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bzung nas/ thog mar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byed/ de nas nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims blangs la bsrung zhing*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi mgon skyabs bya dgos par mthong nas smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya mtha' dag la slob 'dod drag po skyes pa'i tshe/ 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed/ las dang po pa'i sa sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod la thos bsam bya/ zas gos gnas mal nye 'khor la sogs pa'i zhen pa spang pa'i phyir tu sbyang pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la bslab cing*/ zas kyi tshod rig pa dang*/ nam srod dang tho rangs mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam sbyor dang*/ phyag mchod/ bskor ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas la chos gsungs par bskul ma 'debs shing myur du 'tshang rgya bar yang bskul/ sprul pa'i sku rnams myang ngan las mi 'da' bar yang gsol ba 'debs/ dge ba thams cad gzhan don du rdzogs byang du bsngo ba rnams dus drug tu byed nam gyi gung thun la dge ba'i sems kyis zin par byas te nyal ba 'dis lus brtas par bya la/ slad kyi dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad par bya'o snyam ste dran shes dang ldan pas nyal/ nyin mtshan dge bas dus 'da' bar byed pa yang*/ khyad chos 'di rnams tshang dgos te/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes shing*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pa'i skyo shas kyis bskul te dkon mchog la sems rnyog pa med pa'i dad pa dang*/

las rgyu 'bras la mi bslu bar yid ches pa dang*/ gzhan don du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob 'dod de dad pa gsum tshang ba de ltar dgos shing*/ sems kyis go cha gyon te/ sbyor bas dge ba la 'bad rtsol drag po'i rtson 'grus dang*/ dge ba'i sems kyi dmigs yul dang*/ sgo gsum gyi blang dor gyi bya ba ma brjed pa'i dran pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i yul las gzhan du ma g.yengs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad bden med sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i shes rab rnams tshang bar nyams su len zhing*/ de ltar longs pa na tshogs lam gyi sne zin pa yin no/ / sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gyur ba'i dge ba rnams 'gal rkyen gyis mi nyams par byed cing*/ sems can thams cad la phan bde sgrub 'dod pas sangs rgyas myur du thob par smon lam 'debs shing*/ bsam pa khyad par can de stobs dang ldan pas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa shin tu brtan par song zhing*/ bdud dang sdig pa'i grogs pos bslu bar mi nus pa'i sems brtan po dang*/ dge ba thams cad phyi nur du mi 'gro bar gong nas gong du khyad zhugs par 'gro ba ste/ bzhi po 'di tshang nas bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog pa'i mgo tshugs pa yin no/ /de ltar na gang zag thar 'dod rnams kyis shin tu rnyed dka' zhing dkon pa'i mi lus thob pa 'di la de tsam gyi lam sna zin pa'i zhig e yong zhes kyang blta bar bya'o/ /mgo'am gos la glo bur me shor kyang*/ /de dag phyir bzlog bgyi ba btang nas kyang*/ /yang srid med par bgyid slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /de bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bad pa 'don dgos so/ /'dir smras pa/ rnam dpyod 'khyogs pos bris pa'i glegs bam dag /don gyi mthu chung tshig kyang go dka' bas/ /drang po'i blo yis ma nor don che ba/ /mchog tu go bde'i ngag gis bshad pa yin/ /de nas thog mar tshogs lam chung ngu'i skabs su lus longs spyod 'khor ba'i bde 'bras rnams la zhen pa che zhing spang dka' ba yin pas/

de'i gnyen por dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi sgom pa yin no/ /de nas tshogs lam 'bring por sleb pa na/ las rgyu 'bras la blang dor legs par byas pas sems rgyud la yon tan skye ba'i 'gal rkyen spangs shing*/ mthun rkyen tshang dgos pas yang dag spong ba bzhi bsgom/ tshogs lam chen por de gnyis legs par 'byongs zin pas 'phags pa mchod pa dang*/ sems can smin par byed pa la rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa dgos pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom pa yin no/ /des rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes thob pas 'gro ba'i don snga ma las khyad zhugs par spyod de/ 'das ma 'ongs shes pa dang rdzu 'phrul gyis gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mang por 'gro zhing*/ sems can ma dad pa rnams dad par byed/ dad pa phyir spel ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa du ma ston/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku mang po la chos nyan/ mchod pa 'bul ba sogs byed do/ /de ltar tshogs lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin nas sbyor lam du 'pho ba yin pas/ gnyis pa sbyor lam ni bden bzhi'i chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i don la gsal bar snang ba'i sgom byung gi ye shes so so rang gis rig pa'i bdag nyid rgyud la skyes nas sbyor lam gyi mgo 'dzugs pa yin no/ / 'di la dang por sbyor lam drod ces bya ba stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes la rtse gcig tu gnas shing*/ rnam rtog mngon gyur rnams 'gags pa'i ngo bo shin tu gsal ba 'byung ba ni/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i lam me lta bu skye ba'i snga ltas yin pas drod ces bya ba'am/ nyi ma 'char ba'i snga ltas skya rengs dang po 'char ba lta bu ye shes kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa yin pas snang ba thob pa zhes bya'o/ /'dir phyi nang gi chos ming du btags pa'i ming thams cad sgyu ma tsam du shes pa'i shes rab skye zhing*/ gzung ba'i chos kun nas nyon mongs pas bsdus pa thams cad bden med du rtogs shing*/

bden med der 'dzin pa phra mo dang bcas pa'i sgom byung gi ye shes yod de/ de ltar bsgom pas gong gi snang ba de nyid 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i ye shes la sbyor lam rtse mo zhes bya ste/ ljon shing rgyas pa'i rtse ltar rnam g.yengs kyi rlung chen pos bskyod na g.yo bas brtan pa ma thob pa yin no/ /skya rengs dang po las snang ba rgya cher mched na/ kha dog ser por snang ba'i skya rengs gnyis pa 'char ba lta bu ste/ ye shes kyi snang ba mched pas snang ba mched pa zhes bya/ 'dir ming gi brjod pa'i don gyi dngos po la sgyu ma tsam du shes pa'i shes rab skye/ gzung yul rnam byang gi chos rnams bden med du rtogs kyang bden med du 'dzin pa de'i dri ma dang bcas pa'o/ /de ltar drod dang rtse mo gnyis su dad sogs dbang po lnga nyams su len zh-ing*/ lam sgom pa la dbang thob pa yin no/ /lam de nyid rgyun bsrings te bsgoms pas chos zab mo skye ba med pa'i don la bzod pa rjes mthun pa 'thob pas sbyor lam bzod pa zhes bya ste/ skya rengs gsum pa dmar 'od shar ba lta bu'o/ /chos rnams kyi ming stong pa nyid du shes pa'i shes rab skye bas de kho na nyid kyi don la phyogs gcig pa zhes bya/ 'dir so so skye bo'i sems kyi 'dzin stangs snang ba la bden 'dzin gyi shes pa thams cad bden med du rtogs kyang der 'dzin phra mo dang bcas pa'o/ /de nyid bsgoms pas dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mang po 'char zhing*/ 'jig rten pa'i lam rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pas sbyor lam chos mchog ces bya'o/ /don gyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i shes rab skyes pa ste/ stan de las ma langs par 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mthong lam bskyed nus pas bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya/ nyi ma 'char la thug pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dir 'phags pa'i thugs kyi 'dzin stangs chos thams cad bden med sgro btags su rtogs pa'i blo de yang rang bzhin med par rtogs shing*/

der 'dzin phra mo dang bcas pa'i sgom byung gi ye shes yod do/ /de ltar bzod pa dang chos mchog gnyis su dad pa la sogs pa stobs lnga nyams su len zhing*/ mi mthun phyogs kyis tshur mi tshugs la phar 'joms pa'i stobs dang ldan pa yin no/ /'di man chad tshogs sbyor gnyis su chos nyid mngon sum du ma mthong zhing*/ mos pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pas na mos pas spyod pa'i sa zhes bya/ tshogs lam yang mos spyod kyi sar rnam snang mngon byang nas bshad de/ bla med kyi skabs su yang de ltar go bar bya'o/ /des bskal pa grangs med dang po'i tshogs rdzogs par byas so/ /de ltar so so skye bo'i lam rdzogs nas/ gsum pa mthong lam ni/ chos mchog gi rjes su sems gzhan gyis bar ma chod par chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon sum sgrib med du mthong ba'i mthong lam skye/ kun brtags glo bur gyis sgrib pa'i mun pa thams cad 'joms pa ni lo du mar bsags pa'i mun khung du sgron me'i snang ba byung ba na mun pa sangs pa bzhin no/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyi thog ma 'di yin zhing*/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba chos nyid gsar du mthong ba dang*/ byang chub la nye ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrub nus par shes te dga' ba khyad par can skye bas so/ /sa 'di'i yon tan ni/ rtogs pa'i khyad par chos dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don thob ste/ chos dbyings la tha dad med pas bdag gzhan mnyam nyid du mthong ba'o/ /spangs pa'i khyad par nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa'i sgrib pa che chung bcur bzhag pa'i chen po'i chen po'am/ sgrib gnyis kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i gnas ngan len dang po spong ba yin no/ /ngan song pa'i nyon mongs kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad spong*/ mngon gyur kun spyod ni/ nyon mongs phyogs mthun che 'bring thams cad spong*/ 'jig lta dang*/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang*/

the tshom ste mthong spangs kun sbyor gsum spangs zhes pa mtshon pa tsam ste/ mthong spangs nyon mongs bcu'am brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sa bon spangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes zhes bya/ byang chub sems dpa' sa 'di la gnas pa nas lta ba rnam par dag pa zhes bya/ shes sgrib shun pa la gnas pa lta bu rnams sbyong*/ sa 'di thob ma thag tu 'jigs pa lnga dang bral ba yin te/ 'tsho ba med pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa med pa ste gzhan gyi kha ngan zer ba dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ ngan 'gro dang*/ 'khor gyi nang du bag tsha ba'i 'jigs pa med pa yin no/ /de'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ 'dzam gling la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de brtson 'grus rtsom par 'dod de rab tu byung nas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mngon par bsgrubs na/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu'am bcu gnyis mngon par thob ste/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ de 'dod na brtson 'grus ji lta bus khyim dang*/ chung ma dang*/ longs spyod thams cad spang te rab tu byung ba dang*/ rab tu byung nas kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam la ting nge 'dzin brgya thob cing*/ zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /de la brgya phrag bcu gnyis ni/ zhing brgyar 'gro/ sangs rgyas brgya mthong*/ 'jig rten khams brgya g.yo/ sprul pa brgya 'gyed/ ting nge 'dzin brgya la 'jugabargya las ldang*/ 'khor brgya la chos ston/ sems can brgya smin grol la 'god/ 'od zer brgya 'gyed/ sangs rgyas brgyas byin gyis brlabs/ bskal pa brgyar gnas pa byed/ bskal pa brgya'i sngon dang phyi mthar mngon shes 'jugachos kyi sgo brgya 'byed do/ /'dir mtshan dpe rjes mthun thob nas sa gong ma rnams su gong nas gong du 'gro'o/ /sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des gtso bor byang chub yan lag bdun nyams su len zhing*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gtso bor spyod pa yin no/

/ji srid du ltung ba'i 'khrul pa phra mo rnams la'ang shes bzhin du gnas mi nus pa de srid du sa dang po yin no/ /sa 'di yan chad 'phags lam yan lag brgyad sgom zhes bya ba/ byang phyogs thams cad cha mnyam pa yin te/ yon tan yar ldan du yod pas so/ /de la spyir sa bcu bar du phar phyin bcu la spyod mod kyi/ sa re re la phar phyin re re sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sa dang por mgo dang rkang lag sbyin par gtong ba la yang shin tu dga' mgu gus pa dang bcas pa yod pas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i tha snyad kyang thob cing*/ de yang shin tu brtan pa thob pa la btags kyi/ de las phul du phyin par 'gro rgyu med pa ni ma yin te/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa de nyid kyang sa gong nas gong du je lhag tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir tshul khrims la sogs gzhan rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs 'chal tshul la sogs pa'i cha shas/ dper na rmi lam du rang don yid byed kyi tshul khrims la 'dun pa lta bu ci rigs pa 'byung ba yod pas/ sbyin pa la spyod nus pa bzhin tshul khrims la sogs pa la spyod mi nus pas sbyin pa la gtso bor spyod ces gsungs so/ /sa gnyis pa la ni/ sbyin pa la dang po dang mtshungs shing lhag dang bcas par spyod nus kyang dang po dang thun mong gi yon tan yin pas/ sbyin pa'i phyogs nas ma brjod la/ 'chal tshul gyi dri ma thams cad spangs pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i tha snyad thob cing*/ bzod pa sogs la de bzhin du spyod mi nus pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gtso bor spyod ces gsungs te/ mdor na 'og ma 'og ma'i yon tan gong ma gong ma la yod pa sogs rim pa 'di nyid kyis rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /sa 'di gtso bor mthong lam zhes bzhag mod/ thog ma'i mnyam bzhag de las langs ma thag nas sgom lam yin no/ /'on kyang sa 'di rang gi yon tan gyi nus pa thams cad mthong lam du thob/

ngo skal gyi spang bya thams cad der spangs pas mthong lam du bsdus pa'o/ /bzhi pa sgom lam che 'bring chung gsum la che 'bring chung gsum gsum du dbye bas dgu/ sa lhag ma dgu la re re sbyor te/ sgaum lam chung ngu'i chung ngu sa gnyis pa nas/ chen po'i chen po sa bcu pa'i bar du'o/ /de la sa gnyis pa ni/ tshul khrims 'chal pa'i dri ma dang bral bas sa dri ma med pa zhes bya/ rtog pa'i khyad par mchog gi don rtogs te chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar mthong nas/ chos dbyings kyi mchog sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba sgrub pa'i phyir 'bad par sems pa'o/ /spangs pa'i khyad par nyon mongs can min gyi sgrib pa chen po'i 'bring dang rnam smin gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal po dang*/ sa dang po'i yon tan dang gzhan 'dra ba la stong phrag bcu gnyis so/ /sa 'dir tshul khrims kyi phar phyin gtso bor spyod/ spangs pa'i skabs/ dang po dang 'dis rigs bsgres te 'og ma rnams la yang shes par bya'o/ /ji srid du 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang thos don thams cad 'dzin mi nus pa de srid du sa gnyis pa'o/ /sa gsum pa ni rang gzhan la dam chos kyi snang ba rgya chen po'i 'od byed pas 'od byed pa'i sa zhes bya/ rtogs pa ni rgyu mthun don gyi mchog ste/ chos dbyings rtogs pa dang gsung rab gnyis phan tshun gcig la gcig brten nas 'byung bar shes te gsung rab chos dbyings kyi rgyu mthun yin pas thos pa mchog tu rig nas tshigs bcad gcig gi phyir du yang me nang du mchod pa la sogs par spro ba'o/ / bsam gtan dang mngon shes gtso bor spyod pa dang*/ rnam smin brgya byin dang*/ yon tan 'bum 'gyur thob/ bzod pa la gtso bor spyod pa'o/ /ji srid du snyoms 'jug dang chos la sred pas sems btang snyoms 'ba' zhig mi nus pa de srid du sa gsum pa yin no/ /sa bzhi pa ni 'dir byang chub kyi phyogs chos gtso bor bsgom pas byang phyogs kyi 'od kyis sgrib gnyis kyi tshang tshing sreg pas 'od 'phro ba'o/

/gsum pa dang 'di gnyis la rtags snang 'od dmar lam pa dang*/ de rgya cher mched pa 'byung bar bshad do/ /rtogs pa ni yongs su 'dzin pa med ste/ spros med kyi ye shes gzung 'dzin dang bral ba khong du chud pas byang chub kyi phyogs thob pas mdo sogs chos la sregs pa ldog go /rnam smin 'thab bral gyi rgyal po dang*/ yon tan bye ba phrag brgya 'gyur thob/ brtson 'grus gtso bor spyod pa'o/ /ji srid du bden bzhi bsgoms pas 'khor ba dang myang 'das dag la gcig tu phyogs pa dang mngon par phyogs pa'i sems ldog ste thabs kyis zin pa'i byang phyogs rtag tu sgom mi nus pa de srid du sa bzhi pa'o/ /sa lnga pa ni sems can gyi don byed cing rang gi sems mi g.yo ba mi mthun phyogs kyis ma g.yengs par bsrung ba bya dka' ba byed pas sbyangs dka' ba zhes bya/ sa 'dir bden pa bzhi la zhib mor spyod pa 'ongs zhing*/ rtogs pa ni rgyud tha dad med pa'i don rtogs te/ sems dang bsam pa rnam par dag pa mnyam pa nyid bcus mnyam par rtogs pa'o/ /rnam smin dga' ldan gyi lha'i rgyal po dang*/ yon tan bye ba phrag stong 'gyur du thob cing*/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod do/ /ji srid du 'khor bas skyo ba yod cing mnyam bzhag la mtshan ma med par ci 'dod du 'jog mi nus pa de srid du sa lnga pa'o/ /sa drug pa ni/ srid zhi mnyam pa nyid kyi chos nyid mngon du gyur pas mngon du gyur pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la mngon du phyogs pas mngon du phyogs pa zhes bya/ sa 'dir rten cing 'brel 'byung gtso bor bsgoms/ rtogs pa ni kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ rnam par dag pa ma yin pa'i don du rtogs te/ chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin pa'i phyir/ kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang gi chos gang yang gdod nas ma grub pa rtogs pa'o/ rnam smin 'phrul dga'i bdag po'i lha rgyal po rab 'phrul du 'gyur zhing*/

yon tan bye ba 'bum phrag bcu gnyis thob/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gtso bor spyod/ ji srid du gnas skabs thams cad du mtshan ma med pa la mnyam par 'jog mi nus pa de srid du sa drug pa'o/ /sa bdun pa ni/ bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mi skye ba'i bzod pa chen po thob pa la bar ma chad du 'brel zhing*/ mtshan ma dang 'bad rtsol las ring du song ba na ring du song ba'i sa zhes bya/ 'dir skad cig gcig la 'gog pa la 'jug ldang byed/ rtogs pa ni tha dad med pa'i don rtogs te/ mdo la sogs pa chos kyi mtshan ma tha dad pa mi 'byung ba yin no/ /rnam smin gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po lha'i rgyal po dbang bsgyur du 'gyur zhing*/ yon tan bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum phrag bcu gnyis thob/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gtso bor spyod/ ji srid du mtshan ma med pa la lhun gyis grub pas gnas mi nus pa de srid du sa bdun pa'o/ /de yang drug pa yan chad du mi 'dod bzhin du mtshan ma dang 'dre/ bdun par de med kyang mtshan med la mnyam par 'jog pa ste 'bad rtsol dang bcas pa yin pas/ spyir mtshan ma dang ma 'dres kyang rtsol ba dor ba'i tshe mtshan rtog dang 'dre rung du song la/ brgyad pa thob nas mtshan ma'i rnam rtog gtan nas mi 'byung ba rtsol med lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /de ltar sa bdun pa de la lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ skyon med sa bdun zhes bya/ bskal pa grangs med pa gnyis pa'i tshogs rdzogs pa yin no/ /sa brgyad pa ni/ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi chos gang la yang blang dor gyi 'du shes mi 'byung zhing*/ mnyam bzhag las mi g.yo bas na mi g.yo ba zhes bya/ 'dir zhing sbyong ba gtso bor spyod cing mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa chen po thob pa yin te/ de yang sa dang por skye med mngon sum du rtogs kyang*/ de la mnyam par bzhag pa las ldang dgos pas na/ skye med de cung zad ma bzod pa yin pas bzod pa chen po thob pa zhes mi bya/

'di thob phyin chad skyai med la mnyam par bzhag pa las nam yang ldang mi dgos pa bzod pa chen po thob pa'o/ /yid kyi lus khyad par can ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang*/ zag med kyi las kyi bsgrubs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ston pa de yang 'dir 'grub cing*/ rnam smin ni stong gi bdag po'i tshangs par 'gyur/ yon tan stong gsum gyi 'jig rten 'bum phrag gi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob/ ji ltar smon pa thams cad 'grub pa'i smon lam gyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod de/ smon lam grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu la sogs pas sems can gyi don byed/ rtogs pa ni 'phel 'grib med pa'i don rtogs te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba na yang chos dbyings la 'phel ba dang*/ bri ba med par shes pa'o/ /des na mtshan med lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ zhing dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ston pa'i mthu ma brnyes pas/ dbang bzhi las rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dbang ba dang*/ zhing dag pa la dbang ba'i gnas su rtogs/ spangs pa nyon mongs kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i gnas ngan len thams cad spong la/ mngon gyur kun tu spyod pa ni thams cad spong ba yin no/ /shes sgrib dang phyogs mthun pa'i gnas ngan len spri ste bar shun la gnas pa lta bu spong zhes bshad do/ /ji srid so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la dbang ma 'byor bar de srid du sa brgyad pa'o/ /sa dgu pa ni/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi'i blo gros dang ldan pas legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya/ sems can smin par byed pa gtso bor spyod do/ /rtogs pa ni dbang bzhi las so so yang dag rigs pa bzhi la dbang ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtogs pa'o/ /rnam smin stong gnyis kyi bdag po'i tshangs par 'gyur/ yon tan 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob/

shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs chen pos bdud thams cad 'joms pa'i stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gtso bor spyod de bsam pa'i stobs dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu thob pa yin no/ /ji srid du chos kyi skur yongs su rdzogs pa yang dag par rig mi nus pa de srid du sa dgu pa'o/ /sa bcu pa ni/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi chos kyi sprin gyi khyab par g.yogs nas/ gdul bya'i zhing du phan bde'i lo tog skyed par byed pas chos kyi sprin zhes bya/ rtogs pa ni dbang bzhi las sangs rgyas ltar ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed pas/ chos kyi dbyings la dbang ba'i gnas su rtogs pa yin no/ /rnam smin ni lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba gnas gtsang ma'i bdag por 'gyur/ yon tan ni phyogs bcu'i zhing khams brjod du med pa'i bar brjod du med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i rjes mthun thob pa ye shes kyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod do/ /nyon mongs pa'i bag chags dang bag la nyal gyi sgrib pa thams cad spangs/ ji srid du shes bya thams cad la chags thogs med pa'i ye shes bskyed mi nus pa de srid du sa bcu pa'o/ /sa gsum po 'di la rnam par smin pa'i sa dang*/ dag pa'i sa gsum zhes bya/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum pa'i tshogs rdzogs so/ /sa 'di thob ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod pa dbul zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur sogs dag pa'i snang ba 'byams klas par 'byung*/ sangs rgyas la skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ rjes thob tu sems can gyi don mdzad pa sangs rgyas dang mnyam par dang mdzad pa des tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas srid pa tha mal pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'jig rten khams mtha' yas par dus gcig tu ston pa'i dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/

shes bya ji snyed pa thams cad mkhyen pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos nyid ji lta ba gzigs pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi shes sgrib sny-ing po la gnas pa lta bu spangs te bdud btul nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba nus pa yin no/ /sa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par sa bcu pa'i mdo dang*/ de'i dgongs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ yongs sbyong rnams ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo dang*/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel rnams las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang lam ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir du slob pa ste/ spang bya spong zhing yon tan sgrub pa'i phyir slob pa'i lam yin pas slob lam zhes bya/ sa de 'das nas mi slob pa'i lam ni sangs rgyas kyi sa ste sa bcu gcig pa'o/ /de 'chad pa la gnyis pa 'bras bu ni/ sangs rgya ba'i rgyu/ sangs rgyas tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la gnyis kyi ngo bo ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ dang po gsum bsod nams kyi tshogs/ phyi ma gnyis ye shes kyi tshogs/ brtson 'grus ni gnyis ka mthar phyin pa'i rgyu'o/ /mdo sde rgyan las ni cung zad 'di dag mi 'dra bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dus ni gong du bshad pa ltar bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsog dgos pa ste/ de yang thabs mkhas kyi khyad par mang po la brten te dngos gnas su de tsam ma thogs kyang 'tshang rgya ba ni yod de/ ded dpon snying rje chen pos tshong pa g.yo can bsad pas bskal pa 'bum gyi 'khor ba phyir brnyil bar bshad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rten gyis chos sku mngon du mdzad nas/ sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nges pa lnga ldan kyi sku ston zh-ing*/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten ther 'bum gcig tu mchog gi sprul pa'i sku cig car ston par mdzad de/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i tshul sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad de gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas 'og min stug po bkod pa zhes pa'o/

/de ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho phyag gi mthil na gnas pa'i sangs rgyas rnam snang gangs chen mtsho bzhugs pa'i gnas yin zhes phal cher gsungs la/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas mngon par 'tshang mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod der 'tshang rgya/ /gtsang ma'i gnas pa spang pa yi/ /'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po zhig 'di sangs rgyas/ /zhes gzugs khams kyi 'og min yin la/ gnas gtsang lnga po gang yang ma yin pa zhig tu bshad pas gnas gtsang ma'i steng na lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'i gnas yod par bshad pa de yin la/ de yang gdul bya'i ngo bor snang ba tsam ma yin pas phyogs dang tshad la sogs pa 'di'o zhes brtag mi nus zhes dam pa 'ga' zhig gsung*/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas la bdag gis 'di'i snying po gang lags zhus pas/ sems rang snang dag pa'i rtsal ma 'gags pa dag pa'i zhing du snang ba de rang 'og min yin no gsung*/ gong du gsungs pa de rnams ni/ gdul bya so so'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste/ nges pa'i don ni phyi ma 'di kho nar mthong ngo*/ /lung dang yang 'di mthun te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis chos dbyings bstod par gsungs pa/ dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog dang*/ /'og min de nyid rnam mdzes pa/ /zhes pa gsum po gcig nyid du/ /'dres par gyur la bdag smra'o/ /zhes ye shes gsum me long lta bu'i ye shes su ro mnyam zhing 'dres par gyur pa/ 'og min dang dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes gsung pa'i don dngos gnas yin par bshad pa dang*/ theg bsdus las kyang*/ bdag tu 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ /gnas la tha dad yod ma yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa la/ sku dang*/ ye shes dang*/ mdzad pa gsum las/ dang po la/ ngo bo dang dbye ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ gtsang bdag bde ba rtag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/

/de yang sems rang bzhin rnam dag de/ sngar bag chags kyi rten yin pa las sangs rgyas pa'i tshe bag chags kyi rten mi byed pas dag pa gnyis ldan ni/ gtsang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ rnam rtog yin phyin chad bag chags kyis gos pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la/ rnam rtog gi gzhan dbang du ma song bas bdag dam pa ste/ bdag dang bdag med kyi spros pa'i rnam rtog thams cad zhi bas bdag por gyur pa'o/ /sgra don snang ba'i rnam rtog sa brgyad pa nas 'gags kyang*/ rtog med kyi snang ba la snod bcud kyi snang ba 'char ba de sdug bsngal phra shos yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phung po yin la/ de de'i rgyu ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang bcas pa 'gags pas sdug bsngal rgyu bcas thams cad 'gags pa'i phyir bde ba dam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi 'phel 'grib med pa srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sgom pa mthar thug pas 'khor 'das mnyam nyid brnyes pa ni/ nam mkha' srid kyi bar 'gyur ba ye mi srid pas rtag pa dang dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /phar phyin de bzhi gang la tshang ba ni sangs rgyas kyi sku ste gnas tshul gyi sku gang la yang 'di dag tshang ngo*/ /gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ rang don don dam pa'i sku chos sku dang*/ gzhan don kun rdzob kyi sku gzugags sku gnyis sam/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sku gsum mam/ ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ ye shes chos sku gnyis so sor bgrangs pas sku bzhi la sogs pa rnam gzhag tu byung na yang 'dir sku gsum bshad par bya ste/ gzhan rnams kyang zhor la rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs sku gnyis sangs rgyas su bshad pa dang*/ gser 'od dam pa sogs nas ma yin par bshad pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig nas sangs rgyas med do zhes bshad pa rnams drang don dang nges don dang mthar thug gi nges don zhes mkhas pa gnad mkhyen pa rnams gsung ngo*/ /de la chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid can ni ngo bo nyid sku dang*/

de ltar gzigs pa'i ye shes glo bur rnam dag gi mtshan nyid can ni chos sku ste/ de gnyis rim pas spangs pa dang rtogs pa yang yin zhing*/ yul dang yul can yang yin pas chos kyi sku zhes gcig tu byas te/ 'di la rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas pa dang*/ gnyis su dpyad du med pa dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa dang*/ sgrib pa dag pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ste mtshan nyid lnga ldan no/ /sku phyi ma 'di gnyis la/ snang tshul dang*/ gnas tshul gyi sku gnyis gnyis su phye ba/ rang lugs ni gzhan du bshad zin pas der shes par bya la/ dngos gnas tshul dang*/ brtags pa ba snang tshul gnyis so sor ma phye bar brjod na go bde bas/ longs spyod rdzogs sku ni/ mtshan dpe thams cad kyis brgyan pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la snang zhing chos kyi sku'i rten du gyur pa'o/ /'di shes pa'i rang snang yin pas spyan nas sku lus kyi bar du snang ba rnams mig gi skye mched nas lus kyi skye mched kyi bar ma yin la/ thogs bcas la rgyun gyi rtag pa yang mi srid pas thogs bcas las 'das pa'o/ /in+d+ra bhu ti'i zhabs kyi dpal ye shes grub pa las/ ye shes min pa'i sku 'dod na lus 'jig pa'i chos can yin pas ye shes kyang der thal bar gsungs te/ de skad du yang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes ni/ /sku dang yan lag ldan zhe na/ /mya ngan 'das na de yang 'jig /lus ni 'jig pa'i chos can pas/ /ye shes kyang ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /de bas sangs rgyas ye shes sku/ /'jig par rig pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ rten 'gyur na brten pa yang 'gyur dgos pa las ye shes 'gyur ba can ma yin pas sku yang mi 'gyur/ bem chos la mi 'gyur mi srid pas sku de nyid ye shes yin zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas rang snang dang byang chub sems dpa'i snang bas bsdus pa gnyis 'jog go

/de yang gnas nges pa 'og min/ ngo bo nges pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ dus nges par 'khor ba ma stong bar te rtag tu gnas pa/ 'khor nges pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'/ chos nges pa theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig gsungs pa ste nges pa lnga ldan no/ /mkhas pa kha cig ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la longs sku gcig 'ba' zhig las gnyis gtan med par bzhed/ kha cig ni longs sku chen po gcig dang*/ longs sku chung ba tha dad yod par 'dod/ gzhan dag ni longs sku gcig tu 'gyur ba blo la gtan ma shong bar de mu stegs kyi 'dod pa dang mtshungs par byas nas longs sku tha dad kho na 'dod par byed/ spyir ni longs sku gcig tu 'gro ba mi srid na/ ngo bo nyid sku yang ci ltar zhes brtag go /mdo sde rgyan las kyang*/ zag med dbyings na sangs rgyas rnams/ /sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang phyir dang*/ / mkha' ltar lus ni med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gcig min du ma min/ /zhes lus rang mtshan pa zhig med par bshad pas/ gdos bcas kyis lus gcig la gcig thim mi nyan pa'i rigs 'gre ni sbyor mi dgos pas/ kho bo ni snga ma gnyis po bzang bar sems so/ /longs sku 'di yang gsung brjod pa dang*/ sku snang ba dang*/ mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa dang*/ sku gsum gyi mdzad pa du mar ston kyang de'i rang bzhin dang bral ba ste mtshan nyid lnga ldan no/ /sprul pa'i sku ni/ chos sku'i rten du dngos gnas la yod pa ma yin kyang*/ sprul pa sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa ste/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes las byung ba/ dri za rab dga' 'dul ba'i phyir dri za'i rgyal por bstan pa lta bu bzo dang*/ dga' ldan du skye ba len pa ltar ston pa sogs skye ba dang*/ mtshan dpe can ma dag pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas 'byung ba ston pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ste gsum mo/

/rim pa ltar bzo'i las dang skye bar sprul pa ston pa dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa ston pa'o/ /de dag kyang zhi ba'i lam ston pa dang*/ gdul bya smin par byed pa dang*/ lung ston par byed pa dang*/ 'phrin las sna tshogs pa'i rgyu gang 'dul gyi gzugs ston pa dang*/ gzhan gyi rnam rig la snang ba ste mtshan nyid lnga ldan no/ /gnyis pa ye shes ni/ chos thams cad ma lus par ye shes gcig gis mkhyen pa me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ shes bya thams cad rang bzhin med par mnyam nyid du mkhyen pa mnyam nyid ye shes dang*/ ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad ma 'dres par mkhyen pa sor rtog ye shes dang*/ gdul bya gdul ba'i bya ba mkhyen pa bya sgrub ye shes te bzhi'o/ /ye shes des shes bya mkhyen tshul ni/ chos nyid don dam pa snang ba med pa'i tshul gyis mkhyen la/ brtag pa'i don gyis dben gyur pa/ /brten nas skyes pa thams cad ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pas mngon sum gzigs/ zhes dbu ma bden gnyis las gsungs pa ltar grub mtha' smra ba rnams kyi rtog pas btags pa ma yin pa'i kun rdzob/ rgyu 'bras/ rten 'brel snang tsam ni/ snang ba'i tshul gyis mkhyen/ rang rang gi sgro btags pa'i cha yang*/ rang rang gi blo la snang bar mkhyen te/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyis rmi lam byung ba'i mi'i snang don rmi lam byung ba shes pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa mdzad pa ni/ rnam rtog dang 'bad rtsol med pa lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rgyun chad pa med pa gnyis te/ sems can rnams lam gyi rten mtho ris la 'god/ lam dngos la 'jugamathar ma phyin pa rnams nges legs la 'god pa gsum du 'dus so/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ rgyu'i rgyud dang*/ thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ 'bras bu'i rgyud de gsum gyi dang po ni gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs te/ de la sems kyi rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa dang*/

de rgyu'i rgyud du 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i don bshad/ de phra ba'i bdag tu bzhagade la 'jug pa'i ye shes ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das byams pas/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar sny-ing po'i don gsum gyi dang po 'od 'phro ba'i don ni/ de las 'byung ba'i don du'ang 'gyur mod/ gtso bor khyab pa'i don te/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis de'i don/ sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku sangs rgyas de dngos po thams cad la nye ring med par gnas pas khyab pa ste/ de la dgongs nas kyang sems can thams cad bde gshegs snying po can du gsungs te/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa dang snying po gnyis ka yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar dmyal ba nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam mkha' ltar 'gyur ba mi bsten pa ste/ ji skad du/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes ngo bo gsal stong de la mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pas 'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can du gsungs so/ /snying po ni dngos yin/ bde gshegs ni yin min gnyis yod de/ de yang glo bur gyi dri ma gtan ma dag pa'i skabs sems can so so'i skye bo dang*/ nyon sgrib dag shes sgrib ma dag pa'i skabs/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa zhes dang*/ sgrib pa gsum char dag pa na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes sems kyi rang bzhin de la btags pas ldog chas phye na gsum du 'gyur ba'i dang po gnyis bde gshegs dngos ma yin pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ thog ma med pa nas brgyud de 'ongs pa/ chos nyid kyis thob pa/ skye mched drug gi khyad par de 'dra ba ste/

khyad par gsum ldan gyi rigs yod pas kyang sems can snying po can du gsungs so/ /de la skye mched drug gi khyab pa de 'dra ba ni/ sems kyi steng na skye mched drug tu snang ba'i cha shas yod pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zag med skye mched drug dang shin tu mthun pa'o/ /dper na gser gyi ri ni 'di 'dra la zhes gser gyi ri bcos ma ston pa lta bu'o/ /'o na de nam byung zhe na/ gsar du byung ba'i skabs med de/ thog ma med pa nas brgyud de 'ongs pa ste/ dge rtsa sogs kyis gsar du ma rnyed pa rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs zhes bya/ de yang 'ga' zhig la yod/ 'ga' zhig la med pa lta bu ma yin/ sems can yin phyin chad de de ltar yod pa chos nyid yin pas chos nyid kyis thob pa'o/ /rigs 'di ni rang bzhin gnas rigs te/ dad pa la sogs pa rigs su gsungs pa ni/ rigs 'di sad byed rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs zhes bya ba de'i rkyen la dgongs pa yin te thar pa'i dbang du byas pa'i dge chos gsar du blangs pas sems can gyi rgyud sngar bas sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar song ba la rgyas 'gyur ram/ yang dag blangs pa'i rigs zhes bya la/ dad sogs khams rgyas byed du gsungs kyi/ khams kyi ngo bor gsungs pa ni ma mthong ngo*/ /sangs rgyas nas rigs kyi ming don gnyis char mi 'jug pas snying po dngos dang de bzhin gshegs pa btags pa tsam mo/ /de gsum la dang po 'bras bu'i dang*/ gnyis pa rang bzhin gyi dang*/ gsum pa khams bde gshegs snying por bod snga ma rnams bzhed pa'i tha snyad shin tu legs la/ 'on kyang rang bzhin med dgag kho na ni don gyi gtso bo las phyir phyogs pas yongs sbyong kyi chos gong du bshad pa ltar 'jog dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin nyid rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sems can yin nam/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid sems can zhe na/ phyi ma ltar te/ ji ltar yan lag tshogs tsam la/ /brten nas shing ltar brjod pa ltar/

/de bzhin phung po rnams brten nas/ /kun rdzob sems can zhes brjod do/ /zhes 'jig rten rnams rags pa'i phung po la brten nas 'di ni che ge mo zhig go zhes btags pa rags pa'i bdag ces bya ba phyin ci log kho na'o/ /de dang mu stegs kyis btags pa lta bu'i bdag med kyang las bsog cing rnam smin myong ba dang*/ phung po lnga ma 'dor zhing yang srid len pa po ni sems tsam ste/ kun gzhi'i 'di ni brtan pa 'jug gi gzhan lus sems kyi chos gang yang brtan par mi 'jug pas so/ /des na phra mo'i bdag ni 'di lta ste/ lang gshegs las/ gtso bo dbang phyug byed po rnams/ /sems tsam po la rnam par btags/ /zhes dang*/ bu mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug po gang lags pa 'di dang*/ rnam par shes pa 'di ste/ chos bdun po 'di ni mi gnas pa/ ma 'brel ba/ skad cig pa lags pas sdug bsngal myong ba ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ 'brel ba/ rnam par dbyer med pa skad cig pa ma lags pas sdug bsngal myong ba lags so/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /kun gzhi'am 'od gsal gyi sems gtan du 'jug pa 'di med na drug pa'i yid sogs shin tu mi brtan pas las 'bras kyi 'brel ba'i rten du mi rung ba dang*/ de med pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la skyo ba dang*/ myang 'das la smon pa mi 'byung ba las/ de dag 'byung zhing 'dug pas de yang yod dgos te du ba las me dpog pa bzhin no/ /mang du mkhyen pa rnams ni 'di bzhed de/ legs ldan gyis rtog ge 'bar bar kho bo cag kyang tha snyad du rnam par shes pa la bdag gi sgra yongs su 'dogs zhes pa dang*/ zla ba grags pas kyang*/ byed pa po ni sems tsam yin par rtogs/ zhes pa 'di bdag dang sems can zhes gang la 'dogs pa'i gzhi dbu ma pa'i rang lugs gtan la 'bebs pas/ sher 'byung blo gros kyis spyod 'jug 'grel par bshad do/

/des na las 'bras kyi rten sems khas len pa sems tsam kho na yin zer ba ni shin tu ma nges so/ /zla bas 'jug 'grail las ni/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa rnams las kun gzhi rnam par shes pa chos mtha' yas pa nus pa'i khyad par gyi gzhi sa bon thams cad rlabs rnams la rgya mtsho ltar dngos po thams cad skye ba'i rgyur gsungs pa gang yin de ci/ rnam pa thams cad du med pa zhig gam zhe na/ de lta ni ma yin te zhes gsungs pas/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la kun gzhi gzhi ma grub par 'dod pa yang bsal la/ gal te dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyud bla ma lta ba gcig par smra ba rnams kyis ni/ lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ zhes bde gshegs snying po de shes pa zag med du bshad pa 'di bsam dgos so/ /'jig rten phung po la dmigs nas bdag ces 'dogs kyang*/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo'i don/ skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ /me min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rnam shes ma yin kun min na/ /de las gzhan don skyes bu gang*/ /zhes rin chen phreng bar gsungs pa ltar/ 'jug par yang*/ gang phyir thub pas bdag de sa chu me sogs gsungs pas de las 'bras kyi rten du mi 'grub pas phra ba'i bdag 'di'o/ /'o na mu staigs dang mtshungs so snyam na/ de nyid kyang stong par 'chad pas ga la mtshungs/ des na khams drug yid/ nyer rgyu bco brgyad sogs te rnams kyi ngo bo'i steng gi gsal cha dang stong pa ro mnyam/ mnyam nyid kyi cha ni rgyu rgyud phra ba'i bdag go /'di ni spros pa'i mtshan mas dben pa ste/ 'di mngon sum du rtogs na sems rtogs pas bdag lta'i gnyen po'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ spyir rigs pa'i spyad pas 'jug pa yang rgyal bas kyang gsungs la shing rta chen po mang pos kyang bshad mod/ 'on kyang rdo rje theg pa 'dir ni shing rta chen po mkhas grub rnams kyang rnam par dpyad pa'i stong nyid de gtso bor mi mdzad pa sha stag snang bas rnam par mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa 'jog sgom gyi skabs su bshad zin pa ltar te/

ye shes de'i yul stong nyid kyang med par dgag pa'i mtshan nyid can kho na ma yin te/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ dus gsum mkhyen pas ma byas pa'i/ /rtogs pa nam mkha' dbyer med mtshan/ /'di nyid kho na don dam ste/ /so so rang rig mtshan nyid do/ /zhes sogs rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ste de yang 'od gsal gyi don dri mas stong tsam ma yin par rang rig go /'o na bcom ldan 'das kyis sems nam mkha'i dper bstan te/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/ /nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par gyis/ /de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ zhes med dgag gi dper gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni de ltar yin du rung yang*/ nam mkha' dper brjod tshad/ med dgag gi dpe kho na ni ma yin te/ bu ga nam mkha' zhes bya ba/ mig shes kyi yul bar snang dwangs sang nger snang ba 'di dang*/ gzugs can gyi go 'byed tsam bskal pa chags 'jig sogs kyi 'phel 'grib med pa chos kyi skye mched pa'i nam mkha' ste/ 'di gnyis ni yongs sbyong du grub pa yin te/ sems gsal rig tsam dang*/ snang ba thams cad 'char ba'i dpe yin la/ bum pa na chu yod bkag tsam lta bu'i med dgag gi nam mkha' ni/ dngos po rnams las phyogs gcig la khyab pa dang ma khyab pa'i dbye ba yang mi rung ste/ ji ltar yod na ri bong rwa yod ma yin dgos pas/ ri bong rwa med kyis shes bya thams cad la khyab pa yin no/ /des na sems can rang bzhin med tsam bde gshegs snying po yin pa dang*/ des phyi don la ma khyab par 'dod de/ dper na bum pa de sems can rang bzhin med pa ma yin na/ de sems can rang bzhin yod pa yin par mi 'gyur ram/ 'dir smras pa/ med dgag tshig tu rab brjod kyang*/ /ma yin dgag gcig snying la bzhag/sems can kho na la 'dod pa/ /dri ma dang mtshungs med dgag mtshar*/ /chos sku'ang chos kun la khyab par/

/med dgag bzhed pa'i mkhas rnams gsungs/ /'gal 'dus dus 'da' rigs smra yi/ khengs gtam smra ba 'di dag blun/ /'dus ma byas rdzas 'gog pa zhes/ /bye brag smra ba'i 'khrul pa de/ /'khrul med dbu ma'i lam yin zhes/ /smra ba 'di yang ga zha'i rgyu/ /rang nyid nor bas rgyud dkrugs te/ /ma nor gzhan la bzhad gad byed/ /de la dpyod ldan rnams kyis ni/ /slar yang bzhad gad rgya cher gyis/ / zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gzhan yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes sgom pa la/ tha mal shes pa sgom zhes thos pas tha mal shes pa ngan ngan por bzung ste ma rangs par byed do/ /tha mal ni rang bzhin dang 'gyur khyad yin te/ dper na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ tha mal sngags kyi lus can ma/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tha mal gyi mkha' 'gro ma ni/ lhan skyes kyi mkha' 'gro mar slob dpon chen po bha wa bha dras kyang bshad do/ /des na lhan cig skyes pa'i don no/ /grub chen lwa ba pas kyang tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad/ /ces sogs gsungs pa rnams kyang lta bar byos shig/gnyis pa rgyu rgyud du

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ 'jog tshul £© bshad pa la/ 'khrul pa dgag pa dang*/ rang lugs bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kha cig bde gshegs snying po med dgag tu bzhag pa de nyid rgyu rgyud yin par/ a bhā ya dang*/ shān+ti pa yang bzhed cing*/ don dam gyi dbang du byas nas de yin la/ kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas na/ lā ba pas/ shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i sgrub pa po la bshad/ nā ro pas/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag la bshad pas/ skal pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag tsam de yin zhes 'chad do/ /a bhā yas man ngag snye ma las ni/ rgyu rgyud sangs rgyas kyi nyer len gyi rgyur bshad/ shān+ti pas snyim pa'i me tog las ni/ rgyu'i rgyud gang yin pa de sangs rgyas kyi rus yin no zhes gsungs pas/ med dgag gi nyer len gyi rgyu dang rus ci ltar byed/ rang bzhin med rtogs kyi shes rab tsam la 'jog na ni/ 'phags pa gsum char gyi yum yin na/ sangs rgyas kho na nyid kyi rigs su ga la 'gro/ de ni gzhi 'khor ba'i dus na med pas kyang rgyu'i rgyud du 'ong don med do/ /rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de bzhin rang bzhin dang*/ /mi 'phrog pa yi rab dbyai bas/ /rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yin te/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya ba'o/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu ste/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes rgyud gsum kar rgyun chags pa'i don can du bshad pas/ gtan nas ma skyes pa'i med dgag dang*/ rgyun chags pa gnyis don gcig la 'dus na khas blangs pa'i 'gal 'du sngon med pa 'di lta bu nye bar bzung nas/ gzhan dag 'gal ba'i phung po'o zhes smra ba 'di ni mi 'dzangs pa'i rnam thar ro/ /ma nor lugs nyid bzhag pa yi/ /'khrul ba de dag rtogs kyang sla/ /rtsod pa'i lan ni mtha' dag pa/ /skye ba du mar brjod nus sam/ /lwa ba pa dang*/ nā ro pa'i bzhed pa de yang skal pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gi sems kyi rang bzhin la ngos 'dzin pa yin gyi/

brjod du med pa'i gang zag gi bdag gcig khas blangs nas/ de rgyu rgyud du 'jog pa 'di ni shin tu mi rigs so/ /gnyis pa la/ ngo bo ngos bzung*/ de rgyu'i rgyud du 'gro tshul/ de'i don nyams su blang ba'i thabs so/ /dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de theg pa chen po mtha' dag gi dgongs pa yin la/ 'dir ni rang rig de yang bde ba chen por gsungs te/ rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid/ dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ zhes pa'i 'grel par/ grub chen mtsho skyes kyis rang rig de yang bde chen yin par bshad do/ /de ni zhu bde yin pas sems kyi rang bzhin bde bar ma bshad do snyam par yang mi bsam ste/ kyai rdo rje las/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*/ / bshang ba'i srin bu la sogs pa/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi yang*/ /bde ba gang yin mi shes pa/ /rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can/ /'jig rten khams ni gang du yang*/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan du med/ /ces 'gro ba rnams kyang sems sangs rgyas kyi bde ba'i ngo bo yod mod/ rang rang gis ma shes par gsungs pas so/ /des na sems rang rig 'od gsal rang bzhin gyi bde ba chen po/ phung khams snod bcud sogs 'char sgo'i rtsal ma 'gags par snang ba dang bcas pa ni rgyu rgyud kyi ngo bo ste/ de'i rang rig bde ba'i cha ni gzhi'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung dang*/ snang ba'i cha ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /sdom 'byung las/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /de nyid dkyil 'khor yang dag rig /rnam pa thams cad mchog mtshan nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni rtsa rnams kun/ /sems can skye mched dkyil 'khor te/ /thams cad ro gcig thob pa na/ /spro ba he ru ka yi gzugs/

/zhes sems 'char sgo rnam pa thams cad pa ngo bo stong par sdom pa 'di gcig pur rang bzhin lhan skyes dang*/ de'i snang ba las rtsa dang skye mched la sogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rigs su bstan pa dang*/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bde ba 'byung*/ /gang la 'gro ba rnam par gnas/ /zhes sems sangs rgyas kyi bde ba'i rigs shes dang*/ brjod med mtshon med stong rnam pa/ /dngos po thams cad gnyug mar gnas/ /zhes stong pa dang zhal phyag gi rnam pa sogs 'bras bu'i dus kyi dngos po rnams gnyug mar gnas par gsungs pa yang de nyid do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhir 'gro tshul ni/ 'khor ba'i chos phung khams skye mched las nyon thams cad kyang*/ rgyu sems las byung ba dang*/ ngo bo sems kyi snang ba yin zhing*/ de thams cad kyi rang bzhin ngo bos ma grub pa'i stong nyid rnam par de dang der snang ba ma 'gags pa gsal stong de nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo bo yin pas 'khor 'das gnyis char sems kyi snang ba'o/ /gnyis pa thabs rgyud dang 'brel zhing 'bras rgyud kyi rgyud 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ sems 'di'i rang bzhin gyis bde stong rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam yang bde stong bsgoms pas 'bras bu chos sku bde stong de 'grub pa'i phyir/ chos sku'i rigs dang rgyu yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ rnam dag rnam pa'i sems kyi ni/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems de'i snang cha lus kyi chos su snang ba ni rgyu yin te/ lha'i zhal phyag dang rnam pa mthun pa yin la/ las su yang lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas de nyid je bzang du gyur nas 'bras bu'i dus su yang gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa yin te/ de na de'i rgyu zhes bya/ kyai rdo rje las kyang*/ lha'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyi ni/ /bzhin lag kha dog gnas pa ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyi rnam par gnas zhes gsungs la/

rgyas par na phung khams skye mched thams cad la lha so so'i dag pa sbyor ba yang rim pa 'di nyid kyis rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /gzugs can lus la sogs par snang ba'i sems kyi snang cha dang*/ rang bzhin mchog tu bde ba de gnyis chos nyid kyi thob pa yin pas lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med pa ni/ gzhi dus kyi zung 'jug yin no/ / sems gang ci yang rung ba phra rags kyi rtog pa thams cad rang bzhin gyi bde ba yin na tshor ba sdug bsngal gtan med par 'gyur zhes smra ba ni yang dag pa ma yin te/ shes pa thams cad rang gi ngo bo la mngon sum mo zhes smra ba rnams la 'khrul shes gtan nas med par mi 'gyur ram/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med ces pa yang shes bya la srid pa ci yang med par mi 'gyur ram/ kho bo cag kyang tshor ba sdug bsngal bde ba gang yin ga la zer/ de de'i rang bzhin bde ba yin zhes ni brjod do/ /spros pa stong dang 'od gsal rig /bde chen zhes bya rnam gsum po/ /waṃ yig bde ba'i chos su bshad/ /de las logs su med na yang*/ /phung sogs sgrib bral cha gang yin/ /rnam pa thams cad e yi go /dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang ni/ /de 'drar nges par bshad pa yin/ /gsum pa ni lta ba skyong pa yin te/ sems bde ba chen po yin pa'i gnad des/ de sad par byed pa'i rkyen yang lam dus kyi bde ba chen po dgos pas dbang gi ye shes kyis khyad par du byas pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa skyong ba dgos pa yin te/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis stong nyid sgom dgos pa bzhin no/ / gnyis pa thabs kyi rgyud la/ bsgom bya dngos dang*/ de'i sa lam rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /dang po la/ lam gyi gzhi dam tshig /lam gyi ngo bo rang gzhan gyi don/ mthar thug gi bogs 'byin spyod pa'o/ /dang po la/ dam tshig ma thob pa thob par byed pa dbang bskur ba/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba spang blang gi dam tshig

/nyams pa phyir bcos pa bshags bsdam gyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ slob dpon gy-i las dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po go sla'o/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi bya ba la/ sa brtag/bslang*/ bzung*/ sbyang*/ bsrung ba ste lnga ni sa chog gi bya ba yin la/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ lha dang*/ slob ma dang*/ bum pa sta gon te bzhi ni/ sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ thig tshon gyi bya ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag 'jug ste bzhi po ni dngos gzhi'o/ /gsum pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ phyi nang gi 'jug pa sngon du song nas me tog dang*/ chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ ming dang*/ sngags dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ rjes gnang dang*/ dam tshig sbyin pa dang*/ lung bstan dang*/ dbugs dbyung ba ste/ thun mong gi bum dbang bcu gnyis/ rdo rje slob dpon thun mong ma yin pa mchog gi bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa ste/ slob ma la bya ba dbang bzhi'o/ /'di rnams kyi cho ga ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ go don ni rgyud sde rnams las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni gong du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa lam gyi ngo bo rang bzhin don la/ rang don rim pa gnyis/ gzhan don rgyud kyi sbyor ba'o/ /'di rnams 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud dang sbyar ba ni/ 'og nas rgyas par 'byung la/ rgyud gsum gyi spyi don zhib mo ni/ kho bos sngags kyi mngon pa zhes bya bar bshad zin pas 'dir mdor bsdus tsam brjod na/ dang po ni/ rdo rje can gyi chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang*/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa rnams gtso bo'i don gyi dbang du byas nas rim pa gnyis su 'du ste/ rim gnyis kyi ngo bau/

sgra don/ grangs nges/ go rim/ grol ba'i rgyu mtshan rnams so/ /dang po ni/ spyir yid mtshan rtog las 'phral du skyob pa'i thabs te/ de la yang bskyed rim gyi ngo bo ni/ rang gi dngos rgyu rnam rtog gi rtsol ba las byung ba/ ngo bo snang stong bde ba'i lha sku/ khyad par skye shi bar do gsum dang rnam pa mthun par sgom pa'o/ /rdzogs rim gyi ngo bo ni/ dbu mar rlung sems thim pa las byung ba'i ye shes thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhigaklu sgrub yab sras sbyang gzhi la ming 'dogs te/ bskyed pa skye ba dang*/ rdzogs pa 'chi ba/ rim pa de gnyis sbyong ba'i lam du bzhed/ sems 'grel ba 'bras bu la 'dogs te/ bskyed pa thun mong dang rdzogs pa mchog gi dngos grub/ rim pa de gnyis sgrub byed kyi thabs su bzhed ces gsungs yang*/ phyogs mthun tsam la dgongs pa las/ sgra don dang mi 'brel zhing*/ de gnyis kyi dgongs par bzhag dka'o/ /rang lugs ni/ bskyed pa'i skad dod/ ut+pat+ti zhes pa bcos ma la 'jug pas rnam rtog gis bskyed pa dang*/ rnam rtog gis bcos pa'i don te/ brtags pa'i rim pa dang*/ bcos ma'i rnal 'byor zhes kyang bshad do/ /rdzogs pa'i skad dod/ niṣ+pa n+na ni yongs su grub pa'am/ rnal ma la yang 'jug pas dngos gnas la yongs su grub pa'am/ rnal ma'am/ rang bzhin la yod pa'i don te/ gsar du ma bskyed kyang sngon nyid nas rdzogs par grub pa'i chos zhig sgom pa'i don no/ /rim pa ni lam gyi rim pa'o/ /rdzogs rim la ma brtags pa'i rim pa dang rnal ma'i rnal 'byor zhes kyang zer ro/ /gsum pa ni/ thun mong mchog gi dbye ba yis/ /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu dngos grub gnyis la ltos nas rim pa gnyis gsungs te/ re zhig mchog don du mi gnyer ba la rdzogs rim mi dgos pas thun mong bde blag tu rtogs pa'i bskyed rim bstan/

'phral du mchog thob 'dod la rdzogs rim yang nges par dgos pas rim pa gnyis su bstan spang bya la ltos nas kyang gtso bo'i don gyi dbang du byas nas tha mal gyi rnam rtog 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang bcas pa 'phral du mngon gyur 'gog pa bskyed rim dang*/ 'phral du sa bon spong ba rdzogs rim mo/ /ngo bo la ltos nas rten brten pa yin pas te/ 'bras bu rten longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku brten pa bde chen chos sku gnyis 'brel ba can du gnas la/ de gnyis ka'i nyer len tsam sems can la yod kyang thabs kyi ma bsgrubs na mi 'grub ste/ sa bon yod kyang zhing la ma btab na lo tog mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /chos sku'i lam rdzogs rim yin kyang gzugs sku gnyis 'grub pa la bskyed pa'i rim pa nges par dgos te/ med na rdzogs rim gyi sku mi 'byung zhing*/ de ma byung na gzugs sku mi 'grub bo/ /lam dus su yang bskyed rim lus kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ rdzogs rim sems kyi rnal 'byor yin la/ 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim grub nas kyang*/ rlung sems kyi sku lus dang*/ 'od gsal sems kyi rnal 'byor yin la/ gzhi dus su yang skye mched drug lus dang*/ bde ba sems su snang ba yin pas/ lus kyi dngos med gang las bde/ /bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang gnas skabs de dang de'i lus med na sems la bde ba mi 'byung ste/ lus dang 'brel ba la bde ba dang yid bde ba mthong zhing*/ lus med pa gzugs med bzhi dang*/ dgra bcom pa lhag med du mya ngan las 'das pa la de med pa bzhin no/ /bla ma gong ma rnams chos sku sgrub byed rdzogs rim dang*/ gzugs sku sgrub byed bskyed rim zhes gsung pa la/ phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis 'gog par byed kyang gnad gong du bshad pa ltar yin pas don shin tu bzang ngo*/ /bzhi pa ni/ gong ma rnams/ klu sgrub yab sras bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod/

sems 'grel ba brtan rung ma brtan rung*/ lo bcu gnyis bsgom nas rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod/ rang lugs bskyed rim thun stod dang*/ rdzogs rim thun smad la sgom par bzhed/ kha cig rim gnyis gcig gis gcig la rgyas btab ste/ sgom par 'dod de mi legs zhes gsung ngo*/ /sems 'grel ba'i lugs ni de ltar ma yin la/ gzhan gsum po de ni gang ltar rung mod kyi/ bod phyi rabs pa rnams ni/ bla ma gong ma'i lugs thams cad la zur za ba byas te/ rgya gar ba thams cad dang*/ 'gos lo sogs bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim sgom par bzhed pa 'di nyid kho na rgyud kyi don yin la/ mar 'brog rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ni thun stod la bskyed rim dang*/ thun smad la rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod de/ rgyud don ma yin kyang bskyed rim dang bsres pa'i phyir rim pa brgal ba'i dgag bya chung bar mngon zhes dang*/ bskyed rim ma brtan par rdzogs rim sgom na/ rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa 'dra min gcig gis dus 'da' la/ rim pa bzhin bsgoms na rtogs pa mtshan nyid tshang ba 'phral du skye zhes zer ro/ /spyir gang zag dbang po rno ba bskyed rim yud tsam gyis brtan par 'gyur ba rnams gdul bya'i gtso bo yin pas de rnams la dgongs nas/ rgyud gzhung phal cher las rim can du gsungs pas/ spyir go rim ni bskyed rim sngon du 'gro ba yin mod kyi/ gang rung re ma gtogs sgom mi nus pa rnams la cha shas re tsam bstan kyang 'gal ba med pas/ rang phyogs sde dang bcas pa gnyis char mi sgom par tshe stong zad la skyel ba la bzang 'dzin byed cing rdzogs rim 'ba' zhig sgom pa la skyon du lta ba 'di ni bzhad gad kyi gnas te/ rtogs pa 'dra min tsam zhig las ma skyes kyang bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i rtogs pa sna gcig kyang ma skyes pa las ches mchog yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir ni rang la bskyed rdzogs gnyis po gang gi yang rtogs pa ma skyes bzhin du rim can du bsgoms na rtogs pa tshad ldan skye/

de min mi skye zhais pa ni cha med kyi rgyus gtam yin la/ lung la brten pa'o zhes smra mod/ sngon la bskyed rim dang phyis rdzogs rim sgom zhes bshad pa mang mod/ bskyed rim sngon song de la brtan pa ma thob par rdzogs rim ji tsam bsgoms kyang rdzogs rim kyi rtogs pa 'dra min las tshad ldan mi skye ba'i lung ltar snang yang 'dren rgyu med na tshad ldan lta ci smos/ dam bca' brdzun du smra ba la su zhig mgu ba thob par 'gyur*/ des na gang zag gi rim pa la ltos nas ni ma nges par 'byung la/ shas che ba'i dbang du byas nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub ky-i zhal nas/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing*/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /zhes thog mar bskyed rim dang*/ phyis rdzogs rim sgom par gsungs la/ thun stod thun smad kyi rim pas kyang gtso bo'i don la 'dra ba yin no/ /lnga pa la rigs kyi don dang thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin yin pas grol ba 'thad ces bla ma snga rabs pa rnams bzhed pa ni don bzang zhing*/ tshig 'doms che la legs pa yin pas de ltar bshad na dang po ni/ rgyud gsum gcig la gcig gis rgyas btab pa yin te/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas btab cing*/ /'bras bu la yang rgyu rgyas btab/ ces thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud du gsungs te/ gzhi'i dus na rang bzhin gyi rigs yod la lam gyi sems rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs te/ 'bras bu grub pa ni rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa ste/ nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen gnyis ka tshang bas 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa spang pa ste bskyed rim lha bsgom pa dang rdzogs rim bde ba yin na/ rnam rtog dang 'dod chags bsgoms pas ci ltar grol zhes pa la/ thabs mkhas gnyen por che ba bzhi gsung yang dpe bya dka' bas 'di ltar thabs la mkhas pas log gnon gnyen po che ba yin te/

kyai rdo rje las/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang*/ /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa dag/ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/ /de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang*/ /rnam par nges pas sbyang bar bya/ /zhes dang*/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ zhes tha mal gyi rnam rtog 'gog pa la lha'i rnam rtog gis shin tu myur bar 'grub ste/ mi gang la dgrar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la gnyen du rnam rtog byas na de 'phral du 'gog pa tsam/ gzhan stong par bsgom pa sogs la dka' ba lta bu'o/ /tha mal gyi 'dod chags la bde stong bsgom pas myur du zlog pa tsam stong nyid rkyang pa sogs la mi 'byung ste/ 'dod chags ched du bskyed pa stong par zhen med du 'byongs pas/ ngang gis 'byung ba'i 'dod chags la zhen med 'byongs pa zhor la 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni dang po'i rgyas bshad de/ 'di la de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ lha so so'i dag pa/ rang rig pa'i dag pa gsum las/ dang po gzhi'i dus su chos thams cad de bzhin nyid stong pas dag pa yin pas bskyed rdzogs su stong pa bsgoms pas grol bar rigs te/ dngos po'i gnas tshul bsgoms pas so/ /gnyis pa gong du bshad pa'i phung khams sogs lha'i rigs yin pa'i phyir bsgom pas mngon du 'gyur bar rigs pa'o/ /gsum pa la bla ma gong ma rnams lus zhal phyag tu snang ba de yang sems yin pas rdzogs rim gyis mngon du 'gyur rigs par bzhed/ de'i dgongs pa kho nar rlom pa'i phyi rabs pa kha ci snang ba de sems su shes pa rang rig gi dag pa/ de rdzogs rim bsgoms pa mngon du 'gyur ba dang*/ dag pa gsum gzhi dus nas 'jog pa'i lugs smra ste/ gzhi dus nas snang ba sems su shes pa ngo mtshar/ der shes zin nas rdzogs rim ma bsgom bar du mngon du mi 'gyur bar smra ba las ci zhig tha chad pa yod/

rang lugs ni sems bde ba'i ngo bor rang rig gi dag pa yin pas rdzogs rim bde chen rang rig bsgoms na grol bar 'thad de/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la zhugs par bsgom pas so/ /des rim gnyis kyi spyi'i don bshad nas rim gnyis kyi don bskyed rdzogs so sor bshad pa ni mdo tsam 'og nas 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa gzhan don rgyud kyi sbyor ba la/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i don du sngags kyi bzlas pa/ lha mnyesapa'i don du sbyin bsreg /bsod nams sgrub pa'i don du rab gnas/ blo dman gyi ngor gzhan don phra mo spyod pa las tshogs rab 'byams/ rang gzhan gyi don chen po spyod pa dngos grub sgrub thabs/ de thams cad kyi yan lag tu mchod pa dang gtor ma'o/ /de dag gi rnam par gzhag pa ni/ ci rigs pa bshad cing 'chad par 'gyur la/ cho ga rnams kyi rnam par gzhag pa ni mang par 'gyur bas mi 'dri'o/ /gsum pa mthar thug gi bogs 'byin spyod pa yang 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /de la mdo las bshad pa'i nyams len pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ni 'dir yang nyams su blangs bya kho na yin te/ mdo rang rkang nas bshad pa'i phar phyin drug ni/ mdo sngags gnyis char gyi thun mong yin la/ 'dir dngos bstan du bshad pa'i bsgom bya'i lam rim gnyis la sogs pa de rnams ni/ spyir phyin drug tu 'du yang pha rol tu phyin pa nas gtan ma bshad pas sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam yin no/ /de ltar nyams su blang bya bstan zin nas/ da ni de ltar bsgoms pas sa lam gyi rtogs pa skye tshul te/ gnyis pa la lnga las/ dang po tshogs lam la/ thun mong gi nyams len ni mdo lugs kyi lam rim du bshad pa bzhin te/ 'on kyang 'dir bsgom bya dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ni gong du bstan pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis 'bad pas bsgom par bya zhing*/ ye shes phebs pa'i rtogs pa skyes pa de'i tshe/ tshogs lam chung ngu'i rtog pa thob ste lam du zhugs pa yin no/
