/de nas mnyam bzhag rim gnyis dang*/ rjes thob rgyud kyi sbyor bas sems can gyi don byed cing*/ yang dag spong ba bzhi bsgoms pas rjes kyi spyod lam dang*/ gnyid dang rmi lam na yang rim gnyis kyi sgom skyong ba rgyun gtan du byung ba'i tshe/ tshogs lam 'bring po'i rtogs pa skyes pa yin no/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten te/ lha sku dang bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu 'bad pas ye shes la dbang ba'i rtogs pa skyes pa'i tshe/ tshogs lam chen por sleb pa yin no/ /de nas rim gnyis kho na la 'bad pas bde stong gis drangs pa'i mngon shes lnga rim gyis 'byung zhing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub 'phral du don du gnyer na/ 'di'i drod thob na spyod pa spyad pas mngon shes lnga dang*/ dngos grub brgyad la sogs pa rdzas kyi rig 'dzin dang*/ 'dod khams dang gzugs khams kyi rig 'dzin lta bu lus kyi rig pa 'dzin pa rnams sgrub par byed/ thun mong gi dngos grub la 'dun pa'i spyod pa des 'phral du mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la gegs su 'gro bas da ltar gyi mi'i tshe tshad tsam la ni mchog gi dngos grub mi thob kyang tshe la dbang ba thob pa yin pas rim gyis lus rten de nyid la sangs rgya ba ni yin no/ /bskyed rim gtso bor mdzad pa'i sngon gyi slob dpon dag gis kyang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i lam nyid kyis/ /tshe la dbang pa'i rig 'dzin thob/ / rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshe nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas sgrub par bzhed pa yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs pa yin no/ /de la grub chen brgyad grub pas ni/ tshe'i rigs pa 'dzin pa grub pa'i nges pa med cing*/ rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa rnams rdzas dang bral ba na nus pa nyams pa shin tu mang ste/ yid 'phrog ma gtsug gi nor bu dang bral bas mkha' la 'gro ma nus pa dang*/ ri lu'i gtam rgyud bzhin no/ /'dod khams kyi rig pa 'dzin pa ni/

tshogs lam chen po pa des las kyi phyag rgya'i bde stong rtse gcig tu bsgoms shing thun mong gi drod thob pa na spyod pa spyod cing*/ sgrub pa brtsams pas lus 'dod khams kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam pa/ rig sngags dang dngos grub sna tshogs byed pa tshe la dbang bar 'gyur/ 'di'i lus ni yon tan brgyad ldan yin pas mi'i nang du 'ong mod kyi/ mi phal pa rnams kyis mi mthong zhing sprul pas 'gro ba'i don byed do/ /gzugs kyi rig 'dzin ni/ gzhan gong ma dang 'dra ba la spyod pa'i tshe shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa 'ba' zhig spyod pas lus gzugs khams kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur/ de'i lus dngos kyis ni mi'i nang du 'ong ba med la/ sprul pa ni sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don byed do/ /snga ma la las rgya'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'di la ye rgya'i rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bshad pa ni spyod pa'i skabs la dgongs pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis kyang slar bsgom bya ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa kho na yin no/ /de man chad ni bskyed rim 'ba' zhig gis thob pa yang yod/ rdzogs rim nyid sgom pa yang yod/ gnyis char bsgoms kyang rung ste/ rdzogs rim kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa ma skyes pas/ bskyed rim las rtogs pa mi mtho bas de'i rtogs par 'du ste/ rtogs pa'i sgo nas bskyed rim gyis bgrod bya'i lam du bzhag go /gnyis pa sbyor lam ni/ mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi thob nas re zhig thun mong gi dngos grub kyi don du spyod pa mi spyod pas/ bskyed rim ci rigs pa bsgoms yang rung*/ ma bsgoms kyang rung rdzogs rim nyid la 'bad pas snang ba gsum mam lam dus kyi dga' ba dang po gsum gyi rtogs pa skyes pa'i tshe/ sbyor lam drod che 'bring chung gsum gyi rtogs pa skyes par 'jogade tsam la las rgya bsten dgos pa'i nges pa med mod lam dus kyi nyer thob chen po'am khyad dga'i nang tshan sems dben mthar thug gi 'od gsal lam/

dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug skad cig ma dang po sbyor lam drod chen po'i phyi mtha' khams thim rim gyi nyams rnams 'chi ba 'od gsal ji lta ba bzhin du 'byung ba de thob pa la ni spyod pa spyod pa'am min na'ang phyag rgya bsten pa dgos shing*/ drod chung ngu'i rtogs pa ni rdzogs rim gyi drod de'i 'di ma skyes gong du rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa spyod du mi rung ste/ ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa cung zad 'gyangs 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug de'i rgyun thogs de las langs ma thag tu rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub ste/ 'di thob nas sbyor lam rtse mor 'jog pa yin no/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu 'bad pas ma dag pa'i lus 'di dwangs mar gnas gyur te/ sems tsam gyi sku de la thim pa na/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku'i rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ste/ 'di ni khams gsum gang gi lus su yang mi gtogs la/ 'on kyang bden pa ma mthong bas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rig pa 'dzin par ni mi 'jog go /rlung sems tsam gyi sku grub kyang rags pa'i lus gnas ma gyur na/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i skur mi 'jog cing*/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes bya ba zung 'jug grub nas ni/ rags pa'i lus gnas mi 'gyur mi srid pas zung 'jug gi sku thams cad 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rig 'dzin no/ /rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'di grub nas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas bzhir spyod pa spyad/ de'i rdo rje pho nya mo rnams dang 'du ba thob pas spyi bo la sogs pa bzhi'i rtsa khams rlung rnams dbu mar 'gags pa na/ sbyor lam gyi sa dang po'o/ /de nas nye ba'i gnas bzhi dang rna ba g.yon pa la sogs pa bzhis sa gnyis pa dang*/ de nas nye ba'i dur khrod kyi bar brgyad la/ lus kyi gnas gnyis gnyis sbyar te/ gnas de dang der phyin pa na/ de'i pho nya mo rnams kyi 'du ba thob pas lus kyi gnas de dang de'i rtsa rlung thig le'i nus pa phra mo rnams dbu mar thim zhing 'gags pa las sbyor lam gyis re re'i rtogs pa skye ste sbyor lam sa bcu'o/

/'di la mthong lam dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku gnyis 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod du 'jog go /gang ltar rlung sems tsam gyi sku grub nas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog mngon gyur ma spangs kyi bar du sbyor lam rtse mo yin te/ mnyam bzhag tu phyag rgya'i lam gyi bde stong gtso bor sgom/ rjes thob tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa spyod pa ste/ dbang po lnga gtso bor sgom pa yin no/ /rang bzhin brgyad cu mngon gyur nub nas/ don gyi 'od gsal gyi dngos rgyu'i snang ba'i ye shes ma skyes kyi bar du sbyor lam bzod pa yin/ de thob nas chos mchog tu 'jog chos mchog gi snang mched thob gsum gyi skad cig ma gsum lam dus kyi lhan skyes zhes bya ba 'jig rten pa'i lhan skyes mthar thug pa ste/ spyir rang bzhin brgyad cu mngon gyur thim nas lam gyi lhan skyes thob pa yin no/ /bzod pa dang chos mchog gnyis su stobs lnga gtso bor sgom mo/ /gsum pa ni/ chos mchog skad cig ma gsum pa de nas bar ma chad du don gyi 'od gsal mthong lam skye ste/ rang bzhin brgya brgyad dam brgyad cu'i sa bon spong*/ der byang chub yan lag bdun sgom/ 'di yan chad kyi dga' ba bzhi ni 'bras bu'i dga' bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa sgom lam la dngos dang*/ dogs pa bcad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de las langs ma thag tu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa yin te/ 'di phan chad sgom lam mo/ /de yang sa bcu'i bdag nyid de/ sa'i ngo bo ni kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi ye shes gong ma'i yon tan gyi gzhi rten te/ zung 'jug gi sku de 'grub ma thag tu thugs 'od gsal la slar zhugs te ldang mi srid ces bod mang po dag zer na yang*/ sa brgyad pa ma thob pa de srid du mnyam rjes tha dad par yong pas de ni mi 'thad mod/ 'on kyang bde stong gi ye shes dang 'bral ba mi srid cing*/

ye shes kyi sku de yang rgyun chad pa med pas sku dang ye shes zung 'jug tu ni 'jog go /sa bcu po 'dir 'phags lam yan lag brgyad bsgom zhing*/ dngos su spyod pa spyod pa dang*/ sprul pas sems can gyi don tshad med pa byas pas/ sa re re'i rtogs pa myur ba myur bar rdzogs te/ rim gyis rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid mngon du byed do/ /sgom spangs snang ba gsum po la che chung dgur phye ba sa lhag ma dgus spangs te/ sems sems byung thams cad gnas gyur pa la sems byung gi rang bzhin snang ba gsum gyi ngos 'dzin dang de spong tshul ma gtogs gzhan gnas gyur tshul mdo dang 'dra'o/ /'on kyang phung khams skye mched rags pa gong du gyur zin kyang dwangs ma phra ba gnas 'gyur tshul rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa 'di dag gi yon tan ni/ lam thun mong gi skabs su bshad pa bzhin shes dgos te/ des na dus kyi 'khor lor ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs kyi sa bcu gnyis dang*/ lam 'bras su bshad pa'i sa bcu gnyis po de dag ni/ gong du bshad pa'i sbyor lam gyi sa bcu gnyis de yin par mngon te/ de ltar ma yin na/ mdo lugs kyi 'phags pa las/ sngags lugs kyi 'phags pa yon tan chung bar 'gyur ba'i skyon yod de/ sbyor drug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bcu gnyis pas ni/ zhing khams stong dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam gyi lkog gyur gyi don mthong ba las ma bshad cing*/ lam 'bras nas kyang longs sku'i zhing khams rab bkram la sogs pa bsgul ba sogs las ma bshad/ 'di'i longs sku'i zhing khams ni/ stong gsum phrag khrig cig yin par 'chad/ mdo lugs la ni sa bcu pa'i mdo bzhin te/ 'jug pa las kyang*/ re zhig bcu pa 'dir de'i yon tan dag/ngag gi spyod yul las ches 'das 'gyur zhing*/ /ngag gi spyod yul ma yin sdoms rnams na/ /rdul dag ji snyed yod pa de snyed 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na dus kyi 'khor lor rga shi sogs rten 'brel gsum 'gags/

ma dag pa'i lus gnas gyur/ len pa po gsum 'gags/ ngag rlung gnas gyur/ reg pa sogs gsum 'gags/ sems khu ba gnas gyur/ rnam shes sogs gsum 'gags/ tha mal pa'i ye shes 'dzag bde'i bag chags gnas gyur/ rten 'brel re re 'gags pa la sa re re/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub par bshad de/ sbyor lam gyi sa bcu gnyis so/ /de yang las rlung stong brgyad brgya pa re re 'gags pas de'i sa re re thob par bshad pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams bde kyai la sogs pa'i skabs su yang rlung thim pa la sa lam gyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa la/ de 'dra gang nas kyang ma bshad ces zer ba ni/ brdzun gyis rang gi slob ma rnams mgo bskor ba yin no/ /gnas la sogs pa bcu po de dag rab tu dga' ba sogs bcur shin tu gsal la/ 'thung spyod mos spyod kyi sa dang*/ nye ba'i 'thung spyod sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhag pa'ang yod/ sa bcu rgyun mtha'i ye shes rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bar chad med lam de/ sa bcu gcig pa dpe med ye shes dang*/ 'thung spyod yin la/ rnam grol lam sangs rgyas kyi ye shes skad cig ma dang po de/ sa bcu gnyis pa ye shes ldan dang*/ nye ba'i 'thung spyod de skad cig gnyis pa phan chad khyad par lam ni/ sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bshad pa yang yod/ phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las ni/ sa bco lngar bshad de/ mos spyod/ sa dang po rab dga' nas kun tu 'od kyi bar rim pa bzhin sbyar bas kun tu 'od sa bcu gnyis pa/ kun tu snang ba mched pa'i 'od ni/ sprul sku'i sa de bcu gsum pa/ kun tu snang ba thob pa'i 'od n-i/ longs sku'i sa ste bcu bzhi pa brjod du med cing tshad med pa ni/ bde ba chen po'i sku'i sa de bco lnga pa yin par gsungs pas gzhan rnams go sla la/ kun tu 'od rgyun mtha'i ye shes dang*/ lhag ma gsum po sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sku gsum la 'jog par mngon no/

/gzhan yang tshogs lam chen po'i skabs dang*/ sbyor lam drod kyi skabs su spyod pa spyad pas rtsa rlung thig le'i nus pa rags pa rnams dbu mar thim pa la ltos nas kyang*/ sa bcu dang bcu gnyis sogs su bzhag pa ci rigs pa yod pas/ sa bcu'i ming tsam gyis gcig tu 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i nus pa phra mo 'gags zhes bya ba'i don ni/ rtsa rlung de dag gi 'khor ba'i rnam rtog bskyed pa'i nus pa de 'gags pas rtog pa mngon gyur spangs shing*/ phyin chad skye bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /rags pa thim pa ni/ res 'ga' ba ste/ dus gzhan du na mngon gyur du yang skye ba'o/ /yang rdo rje snying po rgyan las/ kun tu 'od kyi sa chen po/ /de nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /bdud rtsi 'od ni gnyis pa ste/ /shin tu 'od gsal zla ba 'dra/ /nam mkha'i 'od ni gsum pa ste/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin rab tu gnas/ /rdo rje'i 'od ni bzhi pa ste/ /sa de'i 'od ni yid dga'o/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan sbyor bas/ /rdo rje zhes ni yongs su brtag /lnga pa rin chen 'od ces bya/ /dbang bskur ba la rab tu gnas/ /pad+ma'i 'od ni drug pa ste/ /pad+ma bzhin du rab tu skye/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /dri ma med pa yongs su 'dzin/ /bdun pa las kyi 'od ces pa/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las byed par 'dod/ /brgyad pa dpe med ces pa ste/ /de la dpe ni yod ma yin/ /dpe ldan zhes pa dgu pa ste/ /thams cad dpe ni so sor rtogs/ /bcu pa shes rab 'od ces pa/ /sangs rgyas sa ni bla na med/ /bcu gcig thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ /sa chen rab tu 'od gsal ba/ /bcu gnyis so so'i bdag nyid rig / rnal 'byor ye shes rab tu rdzogs/ /zhes sa bcu gnyis gsungs pa ni/ bod kyi mkhas pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi sa 'ba' zhig la sbyor/ kha cig 'phags lam sa bcu gnyis la sbyor/ 'ga' zhig dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bcu gnyis la sbyor mod/

de thams cad la gnod byed re 'jug par snang zhing*/ rang lugs ni 'phags lam gyi ye shes zung 'jug la ldog chas phye bas bcu gnyis byung ba/ gong ma'i yon tan skye ba'i gzhi yin pas sa zhes btags te/ rim pa bzhin du ma rig pa shes sgrib kyi mun pa sel ba dang*/ 'dzag med kyi bde ba'i 'od dang bcas pa dang*/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mthong ba dang*/ lhag bsam brtan po rang don gyi rnam par rtog pas mi phyed pas/ gzhan don la dga' ba dang ldan pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i lhas dbang bskur ba'i ye shes dang*/ sems rang bzhin gyis dag par mthong ba dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis sangs rgyas la sogs par sprul nas 'phrin las byed pa dang*/ dpe las 'das pa'i ye shes te brjod bral du mthong ba dang*/ chos thams cad kyi dpe dang rgyu mtshan rtogs pa dang*/ shes bya la blo gros bla na med pa rgyas pa dang*/ shes sgrib kyi mun pa'i bag chags sel ba dang*/ so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'o/ / lnga pa mi slob lam la sbyor tshul ni/ spyir so so skye bo'i dus su dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug mngon du byed pa yang dbang bskur ba'i rkyen gyis thob pa mang zhing*/ khyad par mthong lam mngon par byang chub pa dang*/ 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe nges par dbang bskur ba la ltos pa yin no/ /de la snga ma ni sprul pa'i skus dbang bskur la/ phyi ma ni longs sku rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'o/ /de yang de ltar dbang bskur bas shes rab ye shes rgyun mtha' rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gyur ba'i bag chags phra mo yang spangs te/ kun gzhi gnas gyur pas skad cig gnyis par mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba'o/ /'dir mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa dang*/ de'i mchod pa'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa ltas dang bcas pa yang 'byung ngo*/ /'o na rgyud nas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa bshad pa ni mthong ba'i lam gyi skabs ma yin nam zhe na/

de dang rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa'i ltas bshad pa rnams dngos bstan de ltar yin mod kyi/ de bas kyang ches cher rgya che zhing 'byams klas pa 'dir 'byung ba yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i rgyud la/ rten gang la mngon du byed pa/ mi slob pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ /de'i khyad par gyi chos sku dang ye shes kyi rnam gzhag go /dang po ni/ mi'i skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgya bar gsungs pa la brten nas/ rten mi lus yin par 'dod pa ni phyogs 'di na shin tu mang na yang 'khor ba pa'i lus la sangs rgyas kyi sems mi srid pas mi 'thad do/ /sa dang po'i rjes thob tu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub/ tha mal pa'i lus rtsa khams/ ngag rlung*/ sems rnam rtog rnams ni snga nas 'gags te/ des na ye shes kyi sku de yang je bzang du song nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi lus rnam pa thams cad pa longs spyod rdzogs sku dang phyogs mtshungs pa zhig gi rten la sangs rgya ba yin no/ /'on kyang ma dag pa'i phung po de dbyings su zad pa ma gtogs bor ba ma yin pas/ tshe gcig dang skye ba gcig la sangs rgyas ma thob pa ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ gsum gyi dang po ngo bo ni khyab pa dang rtag pa'i mtshan nyid can te/ 'di na kha cig stong pa nyid tsam khyab pa dang rtag par 'dod kyi/ sku khyab rtag tu mi 'dod/ gzhan dag ni khyab pa'i don sprul pa gang dgos su 'byung ba la 'chad de/ gnyis kas kyang longs spyod rdzogs sku 'byung 'gyur gyi lus phra ba zhig tu 'dod par snang ngo*/ /'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur la rgyun gyi rtag pa gtan mi srid/ med par dgag pa'i mtshan nyid can tsam chos sku'i cha shas su 'jog pa'i skabs kyang yod mod kyi yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku khyab rtag tu bzhag pas/ de yang ma yin te/ med dgag la yan lag bdun rtsi rgyu med pa'i phyir/ /des na lugs de gnyis ni/ khyab rtag gi ming tsam thos kyang don ma shes pa'o/

/des na rang lugs ni sku dang ye shes gnyis po ngo bo gcig yin pas yan lag bdun ldan gyi ye shes kyi sku yang shes pa kho na yin no/ kha cig chos sku dang longs sku ngo bo gcig par bshad pa dang*/ longs sku de la gnyis med kyi skur gsungs pas gzugs sku sangs rgyas kyis ma bsdus par 'dod pa dang*/ shes pa las ngo bo tha dad pa'i bem por 'dod pa dang*/ ye shes med par 'dod pa sogs klu sgrub kyi dgongs par 'chad pa nor zhes gsung pa ni gzugs sku gdul bya'i rgyud kyi bsdus par bzhed pa'i skyes chen kun longs sku mtshan nyid pa gzugs skur mi bzhed pas phyogs snga ma longs shing*/ lhag ma rnams rang gi grub mtha' la co 'dri bar song ba yin te/ de yang khyed nyid kyis longs sku rlung sems las grub par 'bad des bsgrubs pas bem po dang ngo bo gcig pa'i shes pa gcig 'jog pa las tha chad pa'i khas len ci yod/ gzung 'dzin gnyis yod bzhin du mi snang ba'i ye shes 'khrul pa de 'dra 'dod pa bas ye shes med ces smra ba'ang bzang ngo*/ /des na gang dgos su sprul pa 'byur bar ma zad/ sku de nyid kyang chos thams cad la nye ring med cing gnas 'di na yod kyi gzhan na med do zhes sogs dbye ba med pas dngos po thams cad khyab pa dang*/ ngo bo rigs mi 'drar 'gyur ba dang rgyun chad pa gtan mi srid pas rtag pa'o/ /des na sku dang ye shes gnyis ka khyab rtag go /gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni zung 'jug chen po ste/ spangs rtogs chen po dang ldan pa'o/ /'di la kha cig rgyun mtha'i rjes thogs su chos sku 'od gsal bde chen thob nas/ de'i skad cig gnyis par longs skur ldang*/ kha cig sku gnyis dus mnyam du 'grub zer gnyis ka yang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi ngos 'dzin/ sems chos sku dang lus longs sku mnyam du byung ba la zung 'jug zer te/ sku dang thugs tha dad du 'dod/

'on kyang bde chen dang sku la gnyis snang med/ slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sku/ nges ngor gnyis snang med/ snang ngor yod ces zer te/ 'o na sangs rgyas la gzigs pa 'khrul pa yod par 'gyur te/ lus sems kyi chos sku gnyis tha dad dngos gnas yod pa de gnyis su mi snang bar gzigs pa'i phyir/ slob pa'i zung 'jug gi gnyis snang shes ngor 'gags pa de yang nges ngo ma yin par log rtog gi ngo bo 'gyur te/ gnyis su yod pa dngos gnas yin pa la gnyis su med par 'dzin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur zlog tu med pa yin no/ /'o na ci zhe na/ rnam par mi rtog pa rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyi chos thams cad med par yang gzigs la/ med bzhin du snang ba dang snang bzhin pa dang snang bar 'gyur ba tha na rdul phran gcig g.yo ba tshun rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa gcig kyang ma lus par ye shes gcig gis cig car mkhyen pa ni chos sku dang*/ de'i snang ba 'gags pa med pa sku dang zhing la sogs pa sna tshogs par 'char ba longs sku dang*/ med pa la 'khrul pa'i sems can sgrol ba'i thabs kyang ston pa'i ye shes ni sprul sku ste/ de gsum kar ye shes gcig nyid kyi ldog cha yin pa ni sku gsum zung 'jug gi don no/ /de yang sems can mtha' dag gi don mngon par 'dod pa ma tshang ba med pa/ dus yol ba med pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa btang snyoms su lus pa dang don med par 'byung ba gtan mi srid la rnam par rtog pa cung zad mi mnga' zhing shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas 'di la ni phyag 'tshal lo zhes rigs kyi rang blos phar rgyas ma 'gebs shig /spang pa chen po ni bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa mtha' dag gdod nas 'gags par gzigs pa'o/ /gzungs kyi dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i mdor/ bral ba blo yis zad pa ma yin te/ /gdod nas zad pas de phyir zad ces bya/ /zhes so/ /rtogs pa chen po ni pra phab sogs ltar 'khor 'das gzhi lam sogs chos thams cad ma brtags par mkhyen pa'o/

/gsum pa ni/ yan lag ste/ slob dpon chen po ngag dbang grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bdun gyi dang po ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa ste mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha sbyor te rang snang gi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /'di la 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa na lha pho mo'i dbye ba med de sprul pa kho na yin pas yab yum zhal sbyor drang don te/ stong nyid snying rjes dbyer med pa tsam la 'jog pa yin zer/ zhal phyag gi snang ba yod phyin yab yum gyi rnam pa 'gog mi thub cing*/ yan lag bdun gyi skabs su stong nyid snying rje gnyis yan lag zur du bgrangs pas de mi 'thad la/ des na rang lugs ni/ gsang 'dus nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'dod yon gyi dga' bas rol ba la/ thugs rgyud bskul ba bshad pas dag snang rab 'byams kyi snang ba la rig ma sogs 'dod yon tu snang ba'i ye shes kyi spyod yul la dgyes pas rol pa yang rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la yod do/ /gsum pa ni bde chen te rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i ngo bor gnas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni rang bzhin med pa ste/ spros pa dang thams cad bral ba'i stong pa'o/ /lnga pa ni sems can rnams la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang rtag tu bcas pa'o/ /drug pa ni rgyun mi 'chad pa ste sku dang ye shes gnyis char rgyun gyi rtag pa'o/ /bdun pa ni 'gog pa med pa ste thugs snang med kyi 'gog pa la 'jug pa dang*/ gzugs sku re zhig rgyun chad pa'i 'gog pa med pa'o/ kha cig ye shes kyi rgyun mi 'chad pa dang sku 'gog pa med pa zhes sbyor ba'ang yod de mi 'gal bar mngon/ dbang dus su dbang gi ye shes kyang yan lag bdun ldan dang*/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su yang de ltar bsgoms pas sangs rgyas kyi sku yang yan lag bdun ldan du thob ces pa ni/

spyir rgyud gzhung thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang*/ khyad par slob dpon chen po ye shes zhabs rjes 'brang dang bcas pas rtsal du bton pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ sku dang ye shes gnyis las dang po la spyir theg pa 'dir sku bcu drug dang*/ sku bcu gnyis dang*/ dam pa rigs brgya'i dbye bas sku brgya la sogs pa zad pa med pa zhig bka' stsal mod kyi/ snying por mdor bsdus su brjod na/ sku'i zhing*/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ 'phrin las 'jug tshul lo/ / dang po la/ spyir gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas lam thun mong gi skabs su bshad pa ltar sna tshogs par 'byung mod kyi/ don dam par ni btsun mo'i bha ga dang gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ming can spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid rnam pa thams cad pa sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes grags pa de kho na yin te/ dpal saṃ pu ṭi las kyang*/ rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni/ gang du yang mi gnas/ gang du yang mi 'gro/ thog ma dang tha ma dang dbus dang bral ba gnyis su med pa/ gnas gsum du snang ba/ thams cad du son pa zhes gsungs pas/ des na de'i zhing la phyogs cha dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams la nye ring gi dbye ba ni med de/ gong du bshad pa ltar kun tu khyab pa/ spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad pa de nyid zhing gi snang bar shar ba'i dag snang 'ba' zhig yin pas so/ /ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug cing 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i zhing ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yin no/ /de yang ma dag pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas kyi snang ba 'byung ba na/ de yang zhing dngos su 'jog mod/ gtso bor sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi gzugs brnyan te/ rdul gcig rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas bzhugs par gsungs pa'ang 'di'i snang ba yin la/ mdo dgongs 'grel las/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang bsgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ ces gzhal yas khang la bshad pa'ang

'di'o/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams zhing khams tha dad par blta bar mi bya'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam 'di'i sgrub pa po rnams la dngos grub stsol ba'i sprul pa'i sku dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams nye bar spyod pa'i zhing gi gtso bo ni/ yul nyer bzhi/ dur khyod brgyad rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ gang zag gcig nyid mngon par byang chub pa na/ phung khams skye mched gnas gyur pa'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun nam/ rtsa khams kyi rang bzhin gnas gyur pa'i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis lta bu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa cig car du 'grub pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ re zhig sku gcig nas drug gi bar du bzhag pa la/ dang po ni/ zung 'jug gi sku gcig pu'o/ /gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas rang snang gi bsdus pa chos sku dang*/ gdul bya gzhan snang gis bsdus pa gzugs sku gnyis so/ /gsum pa la/ mdo lugs su bshad pa'i sku gsum mam/ 'di nyid kyi lugs ni/ rang snang ngam gzhan snang gi mtshan dpe can gyi sku nas/ rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs par snang ba'i bar gyi gzugs brnyan ni sku rdo rje dang*/ gsung dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra snyan ni gsung dang*/ zung 'jug gi ye shes ni thugs te rdo rje gsum mam/ stong pa chos sku dang*/ bde ba longs sku dang*/ gsal snang sprul pa'i skur bshad pa'ang yod la/ gzhan mdo dang 'dra ba las zung 'jug gi ye shes chos skur bshad pa dang*/ thugs gsung sku gsum yang rim pas chos longs sprul sku gsum du bshad pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ stong pa ngo bo nyid sku/ bde ba chos sku'am bde chen gyi sku/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi gsung longs sku dang sprul pa'i skur 'jog pa rdo rje bzhi'i sku'am/ rang snang gi sku longs sku dang*/ thugs rje chen po sprul skur 'jog pa yang yod do/ /lnga pa ni/ rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i dbye bas sku lnga dang*/

drug pa ni/ khyab byed rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po'i sku bsnan pas drug go /mtshan dpe'i sku rlung ste 'od kyi lus las grub par 'dod pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'i sku 'di ni nga yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yul rnams kyi rgyus nga bsgrub par bya ba yin pas na'o/ /phyag na rdo rjes yang gsol ba/ ci bcom ldan 'das bem po'am/ rdo rje 'dzin gyis bka' stsal pa/ nga ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /zhes gsungs pas nges par bkag pa yin no/ /sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa zhig byung na bem por 'gyur ram snyam pa la ye shes yin zhes gsungs pas/ rlung las grub pa yin pa bkag cing*/ me long lta bu'i ye shes de longs sku'i ngo bor bshad pas/ byams pa'i gzhung dang shin tu mthun par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni spyir gong du thun mong bar bshad pa ltar te/ sems rang bzhin 'od gsal mngon du mdzad pa las/ spangs rtogs khyad par can gyi mthus phyogs bcu nam mkhas gar khyab tu dus nam mkha' ji srid par sems can gyi don mdzad dgos pas khyab pa dang rtag pa de yang tshang dgos/ 'phrin las kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yang de gnyis so/ /dgos su rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi lam la zhugs pa rnams dang*/ yang sgos su 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor can rnams la 'phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyi 'du ba khyad par can la brten nas dpal he ru ka nyid kyi go 'phang la sbyor ba ste 'og tu pho nya gsum 'chad pa'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi rnam par gzhag pa ni thun mong pa mdo'i lam rim dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa lam bsten pa'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ thun mong gi lam gyis rgyud sbyong ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam rgyas par bshad pa/

'bras bu bla na med pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul/ smon lam gyi mtha' dge zhing shis par byed pa'i tshigs bcad do/ /dang po la mdor bstan pa ni/ thun mong lam gyis zhes sogs so/ /rgyas par bshad pa la/ theg dman dang thun mong gi lam/ theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam/ gnyis kar la nye bar mkho ba'i lam/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la skyes bu chung ngu'i lam ni/ tshe 'di'i sogs te/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag bsam pas/ tshe 'di'i bde sdug thams cad glog ltar mi brtan par shes/ dge sdig gi 'bras bu mthong bas ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas/ las dkar nag gi blang dor tshul bzhin du spyod pa'o/ /gnyis pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam ni/ 'khor ba sogs te/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin dang*/ nges par legs pa ni/ de las gtan du thar pa dang*/ de'i lam yang bslab pa gsum yin par shes te de la 'dun pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyes bu chen po'i lam skye bo sogs tshig rkang gsum mo/ /de yang byams pa dang snying rje mthar phyin pas 'gro ba kun gyi khur 'khyer ba'i blo skyes te/ des smon 'jug gi sems bskyed nas/ bdag gzhan mnyam par dang brjai ba sgom pa thabs snying rje chen po'am byang chub kyi sems/ bdag med gnyis sgom pa shes rab mtha' bral gyi lta ba ste/ shes rab 'di theg pa gsum char gyi lam du dgos pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ re zhig theg dman 'phags pa gnyis kyis chos kyi bdag med ji lta ba mngon sum du ma byas pa'i lugs las so//'dir smras pa/ gcig ni 'khor ba'i bde ba don du gnyer/ /gzhan ni lha yi dpal 'byor dag la'ang skrag/blo chen dmyal bar 'jug pa'ang mchog tu dgyes/ /rang bde 'dod gnyis gcig ni gzhan don gnyer/ /tshe 'di'i don gnyer shes tsam gyis/ /skyes bu'i don 'ga'ang mi 'grub pas/

/de dag 'dir ni ma bsdus te/ /skal med phyir na dkrir ma rung*/ /gsum pa ni/ zhi gnas sogs te gong du bshad zin to/ /bzhi pa la/ mos spyod kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*/ /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*/ /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*/ /de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ /spyod pa de bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ ces pa ltar gyi chos spyod bcu la bslab pa 'di dag theg pa thams cad du'ang spyod pa yod mod kyi/ nyan thos rnams ni bdag nyid grol ba tsam gnyer ba yin la/ de ni tshigs su bcad pa gcig kho na thos pas kyang 'grub pa yod pas med mi rung ma yin la/ nyan pa dang len pa dang kha ton byed pa la sogs pa mi 'bad du mi rung ba ni theg pa chen po kho na'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslab bya'i gtso bo pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la/ thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po la drug ni/ gong du bshad zin/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dge ba ci bsags thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byed pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ rjes su yi rang dang*/ mos pa khyad par can dang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa sher phyin gyis zin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa khyad par can te/ dge ba chung ngu gcig gi yang 'bras bu zad mi shes pa'o/ /de yang rgyas pa gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo sde sogs las shes par bya'o/ /smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ gar skyes kyang byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bar byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa sogs rang la dmigs pa dang*/ yongs su 'brel ba'i sems can la mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi bde ba thob par smon lam 'debs pa gzhan la dmigs pa ste/ 'grub pa'i gnas yod pa'i smon lam dang*/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin pa dang*/

'khor ba stong par smon lam 'debs pa sogs 'grub mi srid pas gnas ma yin pa'i smon lam zhes bya ba/ de bas na smon lam chen po grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu la sogs pa smon lam rgya mtsho la spyod pa'o/ /stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ gnyis te/ kun brtags dang*/ bsgoms pa'i stobs so/ /ting nge 'dzin dang 'grogs pa'i shes rab kyis chos thams cad bdag med par mthong bas spang bya zil gyis gnon pa ni kun brtags dang*/ goms shugs che bas dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad mi dgos par sgrub pa ni bsgom pa'i stobs te/ mi mthun phyogs kyis mi tshugs shing slar yang 'joms pas stobs zhes bya'o/ /ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa shes pa'i ye shes te/ mngon shes dang gzungs la sogs pa yang 'dir bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid dkyus dang mthun par sbyor te/ 'on kyang bla na med pa'i theg pa 'dir dus shin tu myur bas byang chub sgrub par 'dod pa'i phyir/ phyi'i spros pa chung ngus kyang phar phyin de rnams rdzogs dgos pas thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par 'di ltar phyi nang gi dngos po mtha' dag yongs su gtong shing*/ rnam rtog dang yid kyi rnam 'phrul mtha' dag gtong ba ni sbyin pa/ bud med dang 'grogs pa las thig le 'dzag med du byed pa ni tshul khrims/ yul bzang ngan gyi bde sdug thams cad la mngon zhen med pa ni bzod pa/ rlung dbu mar 'ching ba la rtse gcig tu rtsol ba la sogs pa ni brtson 'grus/ yang 'dod yon gyi yul snang dang nyon mongs kyang lam du longs pas lam la mi rtsol ba'i dus skad cig kyang med pas brtson 'grus zhes kyang bya/ zhu bde'i bde stong dang lha sku la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni bsam gtan/ skad rnam pa thams cad pas chos ston pa dang*/ las tshogs dang dngos grub sna tshogs pa'i sems can gyi don shes pa ni shes rab phyag rgya'i bha gar btsan thabs su thig le bkag pa'i sbyor bas brgya stong 'gyur gyi ye shes 'phral du rgyas shing*/

de tsam gyi tshogs rdzogs phul yang che bas thabs mkhas kyi phar phyin dang bde ba'i mthus stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyang ches mthu che bar gyur pas khams gsum du gtogs pa'i spang bya mthar byed pa la stobs dang ldan pa ni stobs kyi phar phyin no/ /myur du byang chub rnam pa bzhi thob par 'dun pa ni/ gzhan don rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir smon lam gyi phar phyin no/ /nor bu nas spyi bo'i bar du thig le lugs zlog tu brtan pas 'gyur bcas kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'joms pa'i ye shes kyi phar phyin no/ /'o na 'di dag kho na las lhag ma mi spyod dam zhe na/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la mi gnod cing grogs su 'gyur ba de dag ni thams cad spyod la/ zung 'jug ma thob bar du lus sbyin par gtong ba sogs ni mi spyod de/ shin tu las dang po pa'i skabs ni/ snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag par/ lus 'di btang bar mi bya ste/ zhesamado lugs nas kyang sbyin par ma gsungs/ rnal 'byor gyi nus pa rnyed nas ni skye ba 'di nyid la ye shes kyi sku bsgrubs te/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji bzhin du 'gro ba'i don tshad med pa spyod pa nyid 'phral du byar yod pa nyid bor nas/ dngos grub kyi gegs su gyur pa'i gzhan don ni tshe des ci zhig bya/ zung 'jug thob nas ni/ des 'di dag spyod la/ des bas lhag pa gzhan mi spyod ces tshad bdag cag sus kyang bzung mi nus so/ /sngags kyi theg pa 'dir 'jug pa la/ lam thun mong ba 'di dag nges par sngon du 'gro dgos sam zhe na/ de dag gi dmigs rnam rim pa bzhin du skyong ba ni gcig tu dgos pa'i nges pa med/ gang zag 'ga' zhig byang chub chen po don gnyer yan chad skyes stobs kyi skyes pa yang yod pa de ni thog ma nyid nas sngags kyi sgor 'jug par bya zhing*/ 'ga' zhig kyang mi rtag sdug bsngal la sogs pa cha shas re bsam pas kyang byang chub don gnyer khyad par can yan chad zhor la skye ba yang yod/

der ma zad sngags kyi lam nyid la yang dkri tshul mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa cig yod pas/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam/ 'phrang dog po'i lam bzhin dkri tshul gcig kho nar ma sems shig /gnyis pa la smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ grol byed kyi lam gnyis kyi dang po la gang dang dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor ni dkyil 'khor sogs te/ de la dkyil 'khor gsum ni phyi rdul tshon dang lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor te gsum mo/ /byang chub sems dkyil la kun rdzob kun+da lta bu'i byang chub sems dang*/ don dam bde chen gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis su phye bas bzhi ni dbang bzhi la rim pas sbyor te/ bod gong ma mang po zhig kun+da byang sems gsang dbang dang*/ bha ga shes rab ye shes la sbyor te/ gnyis ka mi 'gal lo/ /rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la dbye na/ mngon brjod bla ma las yi ge'i dkyil 'khor dang po ste/ /gnyis pa mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya gsum pa ste/ /gzugs brnyan dgod pa bzhi pa'o/ /me tog dkram pa lnga pa yin/ /drug pa tshogs ky-i dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes pa'i dang po lnga ste/ yi ge sa bon bkod pa dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ lha so so'i lag pa'i phyag rgya'i gzugs brnyan dang*/ rdul tshon gyi tshom bu dang*/ bris pa'am lugs ma la sogs pa'i sku gzugs bkod pa'i dbye bas lnga'o/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ gong du phyogs tsam smos te/ gtso bor dbang gong ma bskur ba yin la/ bum dbang yang bskur du rung ngo*/ /ras bris sogs ni rdul tshon gyi phyogs mthun te/ sa chog nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gis byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba ste/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba ni/ de'i rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang brtan pa dgos la/

ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la ni slob dpon dang slob ma de ji tsam gsal btab pa thebs pa'i gsal snang thob pa cig dgos so/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor ni bod kyi mkhas pa rnams rdul tshon sngon 'gro can du bzhed/ rgya bod kyi bde mchog gi rnal 'byor pa mang po zhig grub chen dril bu pas/ bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*/ /de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod/ /mkhas pas bsgrub bya de min te/ /yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bcos ma rdul tshon ras bris sogs blo dman lus dkyil kho nas yid mi ches pa'i dbang gis yin gyi/ mkhas pa dbang rnon gyis de mi sgrub ces 'byung*/ sngags la dang por 'jug tshad dbang brtul yin pas ma khyab pas thog ma nas rung bar bzhed pa ltar kho bo yang sems so/ /de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la lnga/ lus dkyil/ ting nge 'dzin/ tshogs dkyil/ ras bris/ blos bslang rnams rdul tshon gyi yan lag phyogs mthun dang bcas pa'o/ /des na de rnams kyi gtso bo ni rdul mtshon dang*/ de bas kyang lhag pa ni lus dkyil te/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du bsdus pa'i tshe/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ /dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha ga zhes su brjod/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems yin te/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs pa'o/ /zhes lus dkyil ma gtogs rdul tshos ma smos pa ni/ gtso bo brjod pas gzhan go ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo las gsungs pa ni/ rnam gzhag cung zad mi 'dra bar snang bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /gsang dbang ni bla ma'i phyag rgya'i bha ga las gsang rdzas len dgos pas/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du bshad pa 'di gtso che zhing*/ slob dpon gyi byang chub kyi sems 'thung ba yin pas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du yang bzhed do/ /shes rab ye shes thig le zhu ba'i bde ba la ngo sprod pas/

kun+da byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs pa'i 'di gtso che la/ bha gar mnyam par sbyar ba las byung bas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes kyang bzhed do/ /zhu bde la brten nas dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pas don dam byang sems bde chen gyi dkyil 'khor zhes tha snyad mdzad/ kun rdzob byang sems ni smon 'jug dang*/ snang phyogs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ kun+da byang sems gsum dang*/ don dam byang sems ni/ stong phyogs dang*/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ye shes dang*/ bde ba gsum la ci rigs par 'jug pa yod pas de dang de'i skabs thob shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor der dbang bskur ba'i tshul ni/ dbang bzhi sogs te/ cho ga rnams ni 'dir mi brjod pas snying po tsam ni sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni dam tshig bsrung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la dbang bzhi'i bum dbang gi nang tshan chu dbang la mtshon na/ rgyu dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ 'bras bu gsum gyi dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi rdzas sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin te/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum chu rdzas dang*/ slob ma mi bskyod pa yab yum du bskyed bstims skye mched byin rlabs la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /zhes pa nas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ gi bar lta bu sngags so/ /gnyis pa la dbang gi ngo bo ni/ cho ga des rnam shes kyi phung po'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa/ chu khams kyi rang bzhin mā ma kī/ chu rdul dang de las gyur pa'i skyes mched drug yul dang bcas pa dpa' bo'am sems dpa' drug la sogs pa dang*/ phung khams des bsdus pa'i lus ngag yid kyi chos nyid sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang*/ zhe sdang gi rang bzhin me long ye shes la sogs par gnas gyur te/ rim gyis 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i skal ba can dang*/ gnas skabs su rnam shes kyi phung po la sogs pa mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi lha la sogs par sgom pa la dbang ba'i sems rgyud kyi khyad par yin la/

dbang bskur ba'i ngo bo ni/ bla mas rdzas la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ slob ma 'khrud par byed pa lha'i bya bas slob ma'i rgyud la dbang de thob par byed pa'i 'du byed do/ /gsum pa ni dbang de las bdag nyid kyi rnam shes mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rigs su shes pa ni gnas skabs dang*/ sa dang po thob pa ni mthar thug gi 'bras bu thog ma yin no/ /de nyid rim pa bzhin du sbyar te/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed rgyas pa rnams kyang snga mas rigs 'gres te shes par bya'o/ /cod pan la/ tshor ba dang*/ rin 'byung*/ sa gnyis pa/ rdo rjai la 'du shes dang 'od dpag med/ sa gsum pa/ dril bu la 'du byed dang don grub/ sa bzhi pa/ ming la gzungs phung dang rnam snang sa lnga pa/ sngags la ngag rlung*/ gsung dang*/ sa drug pa/ brtul zhugs gnyis la nyon yid rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro/ sa bdun pa/ slob dpon la kun gzhi/ rgyu'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ sa brgyad pa zhes sbyar bar bya ste/ lugs 'di la mtha' bsten rnams la ni de ltar sbyor ba mi mdzad do/ /gnyis pa sogs la snga ma ltar sbyar ba las/ khyad par gsang dbang du slob dpon gyi dga' ba bzhi brtan par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems mgrin par myangs pas mgrin pa'i rtsa khams rnams dang*/ ngag byin gyis brlabs pas ngag gsung rdo rje dang sa dgu pa sogs/ gsum pa ni/ phyag rgya gtad cing snyaums par zhugs pas/ snying ga nas gsang ba'i bar gyi rtsa thams cad kyang byang chub kyi sems kyi byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sems bde bas byin gyis brlabs pas yid thugs rdo rje dang*/ sa bcu pa sogs sbyar/ bzhi pa ni/ sgo gsum bde stong lha sku dbyer med du ngo sprad pas lus ngag yid gsum dbyer mi phyed pa/ mi phyed rdo rje'am rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes rdo rje dang*/ sa bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes gong bzhin du sbyar ro/ /'di ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor pa chen po snga rabs pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun bzhin te/

gzhan yang rgyud sde gzhan nas kha bskang ste mtha' bsten sogs la'ang sbyar te dbang bcu bzhi'am bco lnga/ sa yang de dang de la sbyar ba'ang rgyu mtshan nam bde mchog phyogs la khungs zhig yod na rung bar mngon no/ /gsum pa dri ma ji ltar 'khrud pa ni/ tha mal sogs te/ spyir dbang bzhi pos sgo bzhi'i dri ma yang 'khrud mod kyi/ gtso bor bum dbang gi phyi nang gi dngos po rnams la tha mal gyi snang zhen dang*/ gsang dbang gis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra thams cad dang*/ de'i rgyu rlung dang*/ rtsa nang na yi ge'i gdangs su gnas pa rnams spros pa'i rnam rtog bskyed pa'i mthu can du yod pa ni spros pa'i gdangs te de dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyis ni sgra don snang ba'i kun tu rtog pa dang*/ dbang bzhi pas ni gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi shes pa yang dag ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa thams cad 'khrud pa ste/ 'khrud pa'i go don yang de dang de'i gnyen po bskyed thub pa'i mthu can du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam la/ lam gyi rtsa ba dang*/ lam gyi dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dam tshig sogs te/ dam tshig ni bsrung bya'o/ /sdom pa ni bsgrub bya'o/ /brtul zhugs ni de gnyis kyi yan lag phra mo rnams dang*/ sgom bsam gyi cha shas rnams so/ /gnyis pa la bskyed rim 'khor bcas dang*/ rdzogs rim 'khor bcas las/ dang po la/ bskyed rim spyi dang*/ bye brag tu lam 'di'i bskyed rim yan lag 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsnyen pa sogs te/ yan lag bzhi ni/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nyer sgrub dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gsum ni/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog dang*/ las rgyal po mchog go /rnal 'byor sogs ni rnal 'byor bzhi ste/ rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po rnams so/ /'dir bskyed rim gyi don spyi'i khog dbug pa cung zad cig brjod par bya ste/

gang du sgom pa'i gnas/ sgom pa po'i gang zag/sgom pa'i dus/ sgom pa'i mthun rkyen/ bsgom bya'i rang bzhin bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang mthun pa'i gnas mi dang mi ma yin gyis 'tshe ba med pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas rnams su'am/ rang gi khyim du bsgom par bya zhing*/ gal te nye bar 'tshe ba phra mo rnams kyis mi gnod pa zhig yin na ni dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ las dang po pas mtshan mo'i dus su sems 'dzin pa gtso che zhing*/ spyir sgom bzlas ni thun gsum mam drug gam/ gtso bor thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor du bya la/ cung zad brtan pa thob nas ni/ /gus pa dang bcas pas rgyun mi 'chad par bsgom par bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ bsam pa the tshom med pa'i snying stobs/ grogs rig ma mtshan ldan/ yo byad bza' ba'i dam tshig mchod pa dang bcas pa nye bar tshogs par bya'o/ /de yang slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes/ yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su gnas pa rig ma dang bcas pas bdud rtsi lnga'i dam tshig bsten nas mchod pa dang gtor ma byas nas/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ji skad du/ dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di yis las rnams thams cad byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang theg pa thun mong gi bsam pa rnams dang*/ lus gnad mtshan nyid tshang ba sogs kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi mthun rkyen yin no/ /lnga pa la/ bskyed rim gyi ye shes ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul/ ye shes de gang zag bzhir ji ltar na 'phar ba'i tshul/ ye shes de la 'jug tshul gyi rim pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la spang bya ngos bzung ba ni/ rdo rje gur las/ tha mal rnam rtog gzhom don du/ /sgom pa yang dag rab bsgrags so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ tha mal du snang ba dang zhen pa gnyis yin la/ de la lha sku'i snang ba dang lhar zhen pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas snang zhen mngon gyur 'phral du 'gog pa yin te/

de yang rang bzhin med par shes pas/ tha mal dang lha'i snang ba gang la'ang bden zhen 'gag ste/ snang zhen bden 'dzin gsum la/ rang rang dang rnam pa 'gal ba'i gnyen po la 'bad pa yin pa'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las ni/ rgyu nyon mongs bcom pas 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa tsam yin pa las/ 'dir ni thog mar sdug bsngal bden pa ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di nyid dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur nas sdug bsngal gyi snang ba 'phral du 'gog pa yin no/ /slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis kyang*/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun las gzhan pa yis/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan ci'ang yod ma yin/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal bar gyur pa'i sems/ /'di ni mngon sum du ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi rang bzhin can/ /gang yin des ni kun rtog 'char mi byed/ /ces dang*/ gang zhig gang dang mi mthun pa dag tu/ /lan cig 'gyur ba'ang de bgrod rgyas 'gyur bar/ /mthong dang bslab pa rnam par 'phel ba dag /rang gi mi mthun shin tu 'gags par byed/ 'di la tha mal gyi rnam pa dang 'gal ba'i lha'i rnam pa dang*/ tha mal mi'i nga rgyal lta bu dang 'gal ba'i he ru ka la sogs pa'i nga rgyal byed pa dang*/ de rnams bden 'dzin dang 'gal ba'i sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa ste/ de dag la gsal snang skyes na 'phral du de rnams 'gag cing*/ gsal snang yang skye sla ba yin te/ chags ldan gyi yid yul du bud med kyi gsal snang mthong ba bzhin no/ /rnam 'grel las kyang*/ de phyir yang dag yang dag min/ /gang gang shin tu goms gyur pa/ /goms pa yongs su rdzogs pa na/ /de gsal mi rtog blo 'bras can/ /zhes goms na yang dag yin min gnyis ka'i gsal snang 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar spang gnyen gyi tshul bshad zin nas/ de lta bu'i gsal stong bde ba sgom tshul ni/ gsal snang sgrub pa la bla ma gong ma rnams gtsug gi nor bu sogs sku'i cha shas re re la sems bzung nas/

de dang de la gsal snang thob pa na rgya cher spro bar bzhed/ 'ga' zhig de bkag ste dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam sku tsam la phyogs gcig tu gsal snang sgrub par 'dod de/ las dang po la dmigs pa rgya chen po sgom mi nus pa rnams la ni snga ma de nges par gal che la/ dmigs pa rgya chen po gsal thebs pa'i gang zag la ni phyi ma des kyang rung tsam mo/ /gsal snang de thob nas kyang slar 'grib mi 'gro zhing brtan pa thob pa'i don du yun bsrings te sgom dgos so/ /nga rgyal sgrub tshul ni kho bo cag gi bla ma man ngag mkhyen pa rnams kyi zhal gyi rim pa ni/ de 'di yin no zhes sems pa de gcig pu mthu chung bas/ de'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang*/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum 'phrin las sna tshogs kyi spyod tshul la sogs pa thams cad rang gi yin pa'i 'du shes la brtan te lha'i 'du shes sgom pa yin no/ /de gnyis ni gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /stong pa sgrub tshul ni/ lha'i rnam par gsal tsam dang*/ nga rgyal gyi rnam par lhang nge ba/ de la ngo bo dran pas gsal bar rig tsam ma bcos pa'i tshul gyis skyong thub na/ rnam par lha'i snang zhen du snang ba de ngo bo spros pa gang gi yang rang bzhin du ma mthong ba/ bskyed rim gyi lha spros bral gyi rang bzhin de ltar bsgom dgos la/ de lta bu skyod mi thub pa rnams kyis stong pa nyid kyi nges shes sam/ stong par mos pa tsam sbyangs pas kyang 'grub bo/ /bde ba ni phra thig gi rnal 'byor bsgoms pas sgrub pa yang yod de/ rnam rtog shas che bas steng gi sna rtse'am snying ga'i thig le la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ nyon mongs shas che ba 'og gsang ba'i sna rtser thig le la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ de dag la brten nas srog rtsol ci rigs pa bsgom pa dang*/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sogs kyis bde ba bskyed par byed pa yin/ 'di dag sgom pas rlung sems dbu mar thim ste zhu bde skye ba'ang yod de/

bde ba de ni rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa yin kyang bskyed rim gyi lha la rgyas 'debs kyi skabs su byung bas de'i yan lag tu byas so/ /dper na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i dus su phyag rgya'i srog rtsol la brten nas rlung dbu mar thim pa'i bde stong skyes na/ de rdzogs rim gyi ye shes yin par yang bshad mod kyi/ 'on kyang smin grol gnyis las/ smin byed du bsdus pa dang 'dra'o/ /rdzogs rim gy-i skabs su yang gtum mo'am las kyi phyag rgya las byung ba'i bde stong rlung dbu mar thim pa las byung ba ma yin pa rnams ni bskyed rim gyi bde ba'i rtogs rigs yin kyang*/ de dang 'brel zhing rlung dbu mar thim pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir rdzogs rim du bsdus so/ /'di na las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas bskyed rim gyi bde stong sgrub pa ni/ hūṃ yig la sogs pa'i dmigs pa 'ga' zhig gis thig le 'gog thub pa dgos zhes pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi bde stong sgrub pa las kyang ches dka' ba zhig bskyed rim gyi skabs su dgos zer ba 'dug pas nang gi sa rim pa gnyis rim can kho nar bsgrubs pa dang 'gal ba ltag sprod do/ /de thams cad kyang brtan gyi bar du rtsol bas drag tu bsgoms dgos/ brtan pa'i tshad ni du ba la sogs pa'i mthong rtag lnga'am/ sems rtags tshad kyi rtags thob pa dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba'ang 'byung bar bshad do/ /bskyed rim la zhi gnas sgrub pa phra thig gi rnal 'byor kho na la brten dgos zhes zer ba'ang*/ rgyud sde gang na phra thig gi rnal 'byor ma bshad pa de dag la yang 'di rang bzos sbyor bar byed dam ci/ des na zhi gnas sgrub pa ni rigs pa'i lha sku dang de'i sku cha shas re re la yang rung ba yin no/ /phra thig gi rnal 'byor ni rnal 'byor gsum par slob pa'i gang zag gis ni thig le'i dbus su dkyil 'khor dang*/

de'i thugs kar yang thig le bsgom pa sogs la sems 'jog par byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bskyed rim bsgom pas gang zag bzhi'i rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor du na 'pho ste/ las dang po pa dang*/ ye shes phebs pa dang*/ ye shes la cung zad dbang ba dang*/ ches dbang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dang po sgom pa nas brtsams te rags pa'i lha rnams cig car du gsal mi thebs shing rim can du gsal thebs pa'i bar du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rags pa'i dkyil 'khor cig car gsal thebs nas skye mched kyi lha la sogs pa rnams cig car gsal mi thebs pa'i bar du'o/ /gsum pa ni ye shes la dbang ba zhes kyang bya ste/ skye mched kyi lha rnams kyang cig car gsal thebs pa nas te/ de tsam yan chad ni bskyed rim rkyang pas 'grub pa yang yod la/ 'di phan chad ni rdzogs rim dang ma 'brel ba la mi 'byung ste/ da dung bskyed rdzogs gnyis sbrags te bsgom pas phra thig gi dbus su dkyil 'khor spro bsdu nus pa dang*/ thun dang thun mtshams dbye ba med par 'gyur te/ rtsol ba dang bcas na nyin mtshan med par bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ bsam gtan gyi las tshogs thogs pa med par ma grub pa tshun chad du'o/ /bzhi pa ni ye shes la yang dag par dbang ba zhes kyang bya ste/ skad cig gcig la ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal snang rab 'byams zad mi shes pa 'byung zhing*/ yid la bsam pa tsam gyis sems can gyi don mang po sgrub nus pa yin te/ bskyed rim nyid kyi rtogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa mthar thug pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi yang drod phan chad kyi rtogs pa rdzogs par skyes pa gnyis tshang ba zhig dgos so/ /gsum pa la 'jug tshul gyi rim pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang*/ 'dir bsdu na mngon rtogs kyi yan lag dang*/ yan lag can gyi mngon rtogs gnyis las/ dang po la bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i chings bshad pa dang ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings bshad pa dang*/

rnal 'byor bzhi'i chings bshad pa dang*/ rnal 'byor drug gi chings bshad pa dang*/ byang chub bzhi'i chings bshad pa dang*/ rigs drug gi yan lag bshad pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa las shin tu gsal ba yin te/ de yang 'phags skor la ches 'grig pa ma yin zhing*/ ye shes zhabs lugs la ni shin tu 'grig pa yin te/ 'phags skor la byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal yang med pa dang*/ lha so gnyis lus la bkod pa skye mched bcu gnyis kyi grangs las lhag pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' yang zhal phyag rang dang mi 'dra ba bsgom pa dang*/ mngon rtogs thams cad yan lag bzhis bsdus pa gsal ba la/ rgyal mchog gnyis yan lag bzhir ma 'dus par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na skabs 'dir 'dus pa zhabs lugs dang mthun par bshad na bde bas/ de yang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ /bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin rab sbyor dang*/ /nye bar sgrub pa 'byung ba dang*/ /sgrub pa'i don gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sgrub pa chen po dag dang bzhi/ /rdo rje'i bye brag shes byas la/ /de nas las rnams bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pas mdor bstan nas/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag skor gsum ste yan lag bcu gnyis las/ chung ngu skor bzhi ni/ bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin rab sbyor ba/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /de yang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed/ mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed nas sems can la snying rje'i dbang bskur bya ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ bar srid zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis zhu ba/ lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs nas byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal gyis sngags 'don pa yan chad dngos gzhi ste bsnyen pa'o/ /nye bar bsgrub pa grub mchog la/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par dpyad/ /ces skye mched byin rlabs ni nyer sgrub dang*/ sngags kyi bdag po bsgom pa yis/ sgrub pa'i tshe na skul bar gsungs/ sngags ni lha rnams te/ de rnams thams cad kyi bdag po sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum ste sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs te ye shes pa bstims pa ni sgrub pa dang*/

sgrub pa chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /rang sngags rdo rje can gyi gzugs/ dbu rgyan la ni bdag po bsam/ /ye shes rdo rje 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang sngags rdo rje can ni rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' ste sems dpa' sum rtseg dang*/ dbang bskur te rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /bar pa skor bzhi ni/ yum la yan lag bzhi bskyed de/ /bsnyen pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi dag /thams cad du ni brtag par bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sngags kyi don kun sgrub byed pa'o/ /dgon pa chen po sa phyogs ni/ /rab tu rnam par dben pa dang*/ /ri bo nags 'dabs chu ngogs su/ /rtag tu bsam gtan 'grub par 'gyur/ /chen po skor bzhi ni/ yang na rdo rje bzhi dag gis/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas bsten par bya/ /sku gsum mnyam pa nyid gyur pa/ /bsgom na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yum gyi mkha' nang du dkyil 'khor bskyed/ phyir spros pa la yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya ba ste 'khor la ltos pa'o/ /des na dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ skye mched byin rlabs nyer sgrub/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs sgrub pa/ dbang skur rgyas btab sgrub pa chen po'o/ /'og tu rgyas par 'chad par 'gyur ba nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog sgrub thabs kyang 'di dang mthun te/ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs bde mchog ji snyed cig dang*/ kyai rdor gshed skor sogs phal cher 'di dang mthun pas lugs 'di shin tu khyab che'o/ /dus 'khor nas yan lag bzhi bshad pa ni/ rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi mkha' nang nas dkyil 'khor thams cad spro ba bsnyen pa dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog /'bras bu rdor 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mkha' spro mdzad de ye shes pa bstims pa dang*/ byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi bar ni nyer sgrub dang las rgyal mchog /yas babs kyi bde ba sgom pa/ thig le'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa/

mas brtan gyi bde ba bsgom pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor sgrub chen du bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni gong du bshad pa'i gtso bo'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi lta bu gtso bo'i bskyed chog /dang po sbyor ba 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor spro ba yan lag dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchogaphra thig gi rnal 'byor la sogs pas ye shes bskyed pa las rgyal mchog ste/ bde dgyes gsang 'dus sogs phal cher gyi lugs so/ /gdan bzhi'i lugs ni nam mkhar gtso bo bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa/ lha tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa/ ye shes spyan drangs nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ dbang bskur mchod bstod sogs te rags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnal 'byor ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzlas pa lus dkyil mchod bstod sogs las rgyal mchog go /sangs rgyas thod par ni/ rgyu rdor 'dzin zhu ba/ dang po sbyor ba/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin yan lag bzhi rdzogs dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog spro bsdu lus dkyil sogs las rgyal mchog tu bshad do/ /gzhan yang mahā ma ya dang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs pa na khyad par yang ji snyed pa zhig yod do/ /gsum pa la/ gshin rje gshed skor gyi rgyud dmar nag gnyis las ni/ dang po sgom pa rnal 'byor te/ /gnyis pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor yin/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor te/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /zhes mdor bstan/ rdo rje sems dpa' rdzogs pa ni/ /rnal 'byor yin par 'di ltar 'dod/ /de yi rgyu mthun lha yi sku/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor yin par grags/ /'khor lo thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /shin tu rnal 'byor yin par 'dod/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams dang*/ /lha yi mig sogs byin rlabs dang*/ /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug pa dang*/ /mchod dang bstod pa chen po ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya'o/ /mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdor 'dzin bskyed pa rnal 'byor dang*/

zhu ba glus bskul te 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ mkha' nang nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spro ba shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ skye mched dang sgo gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa spyan drangs dbang bskur mchod bstod sogs rnal 'byor chen po zhes bshad la/ bde mchog gi lugs 'di la ni/ sgong skyes kyi tshul gtso bor sbyor te/ mngon byang dang po gnyis yan chad rnal 'byor/ gsum pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor/ mngon byang phyi ma gnyis dkyil 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu bskyed pa dang lus dkyil dang yan lag lhag ma rnams shin tu rnal 'byor/ dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdu ba rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /gdan bzhi dang mnyam sbyor sogs las kyang mi 'dra ba re bshad cing*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i chings kyi lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnal 'byor phyi'i rgyud nas kyang bshad de sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul dang bde stong gis rgyas 'debs med pas bla med kyi skyed rim du mi 'gro mod/ mtshan nyid phyogs mthun tsam yod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ rnal 'byor rjes su rnams 'byor dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /dang po'i sbyor ba mdor bsdus pa/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog/las kyi rgyal mchog rnal 'byor mchog /ces pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs mdor byas mdzad de/ de yang tshogs bsog bsrung 'khor stong par sbyangs pa sngon du song nas/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lhag mos dkyil 'khor te/ lha thams cad skad cig gis bskyed/ de rang lus la bsdus/ de yang 'od gsal du bsdus/ der stong nyid sgom pa dang*/ zla ba dang*/ sa bon dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ dang po'i rdo rje'i sku yongs rdzogs bskyed pa ste lnga po la mngon byang lngar mdzad/ de nas spro bsdu la brten nas sprul sku rdor sems zhal gsum par bsgyur/

lus dkyil bkod/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom/ dbang bskur ma byas par rigs bdag tsam bkod/ rig ma bskyed la lus la lha mo'i tshogs bkod/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs rjes chags dang bcas pa yan chad dang po sbyor ba/ thig le las mkha' dkyil sprul/ lha re re zhing sgo brgyad kyis bskyed pas/ ye shes gzhug pa dang dbang bskur sgos su mi byed do/ /de dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /de nas phra thig gi rnal 'byor/ bzlas pa/ gtso bo 'od gsal du thim pa/ de las lha mo bzhis zhu ba glus bskul bas bzhengs/ de la bstod pa mchod pa bya ba las rgyal mchog tu mdzad pa'i dang po sbyor bas/ mngon byang dang po bsnyen pa dang*/ de nas gzung lus dkyil yan chad nyer sgrub dang*/ rdo rje gsum sgrub pa dang*/ sems dpa' sum rtseg sgrub chen du bshad kyang*/ dum bu nyi tshe tsam la brjod pas mngon rtogs yongs rdzogs bsdud byed du mi snang ste/ des man 'di ni gtso bor rnam 'byor drug gi chings te/ dang po sbyor ba la rnal 'byor/ rjes su rnal 'byor/ shin tu rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor chen po ste bzhi/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog/ las rgyal mchog ste drug go /zla ba las byang chub pa yan chad rnal 'byor/ byang chub phyi ma gsum rjes su rnal 'byor/ de nas lus dkyil rdzogs kyi bar shin tu rnal 'byor/ rdo rje gsum byin rlabs nas rjes chags kyi bar rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma dang kyai rdor dang yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud rnams las/ dang po stong nyid byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yi ge dgod/ 'di mngal 'byin gyi lha tshogs dang gong du bshad pa'i yan lag bzhi bskyed so so la sbyor lugs mang mod kyi byang chub bzhi bskyed dngos bstan la ches 'grig ste/

dang por stong nyid sgom pa stong nyid byang chub/ gdan nam gzhal yas khang sogs rten gyi dkyil 'khor du sa bon phyag mtshan sogs sgom pa sa bon bsdu ba/ lha bskyed pa gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa/ skye mched dam sgo gsum byin rlabs sogs yi ge dgod pa'o/ /de rnams las ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi/ rnal 'byor bzhi rnams gtso bo ste/ gong 'og gi yan lag thams cad kyang gsum po de dag gang rung re re'i nang du 'dus pa dang*/ bla med kyi bskyed rim mtha' dag la 'jug pas yan lag 'di rnams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye zhib tu shes dgos pas 'bad par bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ rdo rje gur gyi dgongs pa yan lag drug ste/ rnam snang gi rang bzhin gzhal yas khang sgom pa 'khor bcas pho brang bskyed pa rnam snang gi yan lag dang*/ kyai rdor kho na'i dbang du byas na/ mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdor 'dzin yab yum bskyed la/ mkha' nang nas 'khor rnams spros/ rjes chags kyi yab yum zhu ba glus bskul te 'bras bu rdor 'dzin du bzhengs/ sems dpa' sum rtseg dang skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang ye shes pa bstims pa rnams dang*/ sgrub thabs spyi khyab kyi dbang du byas na/ rjes chags kyi rnam pa can gyi lha bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag dang*/ mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag dang*/ bstod pa rin 'byung gi yan lag ste/ de ltar drug go /de ltar bskyed rim gyi yan lag de rnams kyi mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad dgos mod kyi/ yi ge rgya chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir 'dir rkang grangs tsam las ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa yan lag can gyi mngon rtogs bskyed rim rnam par gzhag pa la bzhi ste/ sgrub thabs kyi chings kyi gtso bo rnams kyi khyad par dang*/

khyad par de dang ldan pa'i skyed chog gi rang bzhin dang*/ mngon rtogs sgom tshul gyi rim pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi rim pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la sgrub thabs dngos dang*/ rgyas gdab kyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso bo'i chings mi 'dra ba rnam pa lnga'am drug tu mthong ste/ 'dus pa lugs gnyis dang*/ bde mchog lū yi pa dang*/ dril bu lus dkyil dang*/ dus 'khor dang*/ gdan bzhi rnams te/ de la dril bu pa dang gdan bzhi gnyis bor ba'i lhag ma bzhi ni shin tu mi 'dra ba che bar mthong ngo*/ /dang po 'chi ba chos sku lam 'khyer gyi skabs mi 'dra ste/ phyi'i snang ba mi bsdud pa'i lugs la phung khams rags pa'i bsdud rim tsam yod pa 'phags skor dang*/ nang gi khams phra ba'i bsdud lugs yod pa dus 'khor te gnyis dang*/ phyi snang ba yang bsdud pa la khams gsum gyi snang ba yig 'bru gsum snang ba gsum sogs dang sbyar ba'i bsdud tshul khyad par can gyi bsdu ba lū yi pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad skad cig gis 'od gsal du bsdu ba zhabs lugs sogs gsum mo/ /bar do longs sku lam du byed lugs kyang mi 'dra ste/ mngon byang lnga char bar do'i skabs la sbyor ba ye shes zhabs lugs/ mngon byang dang po bzhi bar do'i sems dang*/ lnga pa bar do'i lus la sbyor ba gdan bzhi/ mngon byang dang po ma gtogs bzhi bar do la sbyor ba 'phags lugs/ mngon byang gsum bar do dang sbyar ba dus 'khor/ mngon byang gnyis yan chad bar do dang sbyar ba lū yi pa/ mngon byang las mi bskyed par gzhi lus bar do dang sbyor ba dril bu lus dkyil lo/ /skye ba sprul sku'i skabs lus dkyil yod med gnyis las/ yod pa la phyi dkyil dang cig car bskyed pa lū yi pa dang*/ lus la rim gyis bskyed pa 'phags lugs/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i skabs su bskyed pa gdan bzhi ste/ gsum po yang rim pas rtsa khams phra ba'i lus dkyil dang*/

phung khams rags pa'i lus dkyil/ lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir du bkod pa'i lus dkyil lo/ /lus dkyil med pa la btsas pa nas sgo gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar du rags par sbyar ba zhabs lugs dang*/ rgyas 'debs byed kyi bde stong yang yan lag zur du bgrangs te/ sbyang gzhi lo bco lnga dang bcu drug lon pa sogs kyi dus rtsis dang sbyar ba dus 'khor dang*/ phyi dkyil med par lus dkyil sgom pa dril bu lus dkyil lo/ /zhu ba glus bskul gyi sgo nas kyang mi 'dra ste/ de med pa lū dril lta bu dang*/ yod pa'ang bar do 'grub byed kyi rlung dang sbyar ba gdan bzhi dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu dang sbyar ba 'phags lugs/ khye'u btsas pa'i skabs mnga' sgor 'thon nas rlung mi 'khrugs par cha mnyam par byed pa'i phyir bskul ba dus 'khor dang*/ mngal na gnas pa'i skabs 'byung bzhi mi 'khrugs par bya ba'i phyir bskul ba ye shes zhabs lugs so/ /bskul tshul yang lha mo bzhis bskul ba dang thig le las sprul pa'i lha mos bskul ba sogs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod do/ /gzhan yang kyai rdor dang*/ ma hā ma ya la sogs pa shin tu mang po zhig la cung zad cung zad mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa yod kyang gtso bo'i rigs mthun bsdu na de rnams so/ /gnyis pa rgyas btab ky-i dbye ba ni/ rnam snang sogs rigs bzhi la mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs pa ni mi bskyod pa sems kyi phung po/ /bzhi po sems kyi snang ba tsam yin pa rgyas 'debs pa ste ngo bo nyid kyi rgya'o/ /de bzhin du phyogs dang mdog dang*/ sbyang gzhi phung po 'byung ba sogs dang nyon mongs dang*/ ye shes sogs kyi rigs mthun sbyar ba ni ngo bo nyid kyi rgya/ rnam snang gi rigs la mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa lus la sems kyi rgya/ de zlog pa sems la lus kyi rgya/ rigs bdag la rgyu'i sgo nas 'dra chos yod pa 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya/

rigs bdag la sbyang gzhi'i skabs su 'bras bu'i 'dra chos yod pa rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya ste rgyas par yi ges 'jigs pas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir lha'i mngon par rtogs pa gang la yang tshogs bsag gnyis dang*/ bsrung 'khor rnams ni gang du byung yang sngon 'gro yin zhing*/ mchod bstod la sogs pa ni yan lag tu shes par bya la/ skye shi bar do gsum sbyong ba dang*/ sku gsum lam du byed pa ni phal cher dngos gzhi yin zhing bskyed rim kyang dngos yin no/ /lha bskyed pa ni mngon byang lnga bskyed dang*/ zhu ba glus bskul dang*/ cho ga gsum bskyed dang*/ sa bon phyag mtshan gnyis ga'am re res bskyed pa dang*/ rlung las bskyed pa skad cig gis bskyed pa/ bskyed tshul cho ga mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa yod cing*/ rigs bdag rang bcas dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ bar do mtshon byed kyang rgyas pa zhal phyag can dang*/ 'bring po yi ge dang*/ bsdus pa nā da dang*/ shin tu bsdus pa gzugs kyi rnam pa mi 'jog par sems snang bsre ba tsam ste/ de ltar mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa zhig yod pas/ bar do sbyong byed gzugs 'god pa ma byung na bar do sbyong byed chad par 'dod pa dang*/ bskyed rim gyi lha skad cig gis bskyed du mi rung ba sogs ni bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /gsum pa mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ni/ 'bras bu'i brda dang sbyar nas tshogs bsog pa'i yan lagabar chad bsrung ba'i yan lagagang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing*/ ji ltar 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul/ sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa zhes bsdu ba yin la/ de nyid bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pas mnyam par bzhag pa dang ma bzhag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dngos nyid yin la/ phyi ma la bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor/ rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/

khrus kyi rnal 'byor te/ de rnams ni bla med thams cad la 'jug pa yin la/ gong du bshad pa'i 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa rnal 'byor dgu po de dag ni bde mchog nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i brda chad do/ /bzhi pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi rim pa bshad pa la kha cig sbyang gzhi skye ba snga mar bsod nams bsags pa la sogs pa tshe 'dir lam bsgom par sbyong bar 'dod pa de dag ni/ 'das pa rdzas grub tu khas blangs par song zhing*/ 'das zin nas med pa'i phyir de ni mi rigs so/ /'on kyang 'das pa la dmigs nas rnam rtog skye bas bsgom dgos so zhe na yang*/ 'das pa dang dngos ni dmigs rgyu med la/ ming dang sgra spyi tsam la brten nas rnam rtog skye bas yin na ni/ ri bong rwa'i de la brten nas kyang de skye bas de yang sbyang gzhir byed dgos par 'gyur ro/ kha cig 'dra chos sgrigs pa tsam gyis sbyang gzhi la sogs pa'i go mi chod pas/ skye shi bar do gsum yod pa bzhin du sku gsum lam byed dgos zhes gsung ngo*/ /bla med 'dir bskyed rim zab pa'i don yang cho ga mang po dngos grub len pa tsam dang*/ rang lha tsam dang*/ dam ye dbyer med kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa dang*/ lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can la'ang mi 'dod de/ gong ma gsum rgyud sde 'og ma la yang yod pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub rtogs pa'i thabs ma yin pa dang*/ phyi ma yang bsgom bya'i khyad ma gtogs sgom tshul gyi khyad ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na sbyang gzhi dang mthun pa'i bskyed rim khyad par can yod pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa sbyang gzhi'i khyad par gyis ni 'jog mod kyi/ snga ma rnams 'gog ni mi dgos te/ dngos grub len pa sogs gsum po de yang ches bla med myur zhing bzang ba yin pas so/ /lar dngos grub len pa zab khyad du mi byed pa'i legs bshad 'di ya mtshan no/ /rang gi de nyid gsal bar ma mdzad cigachos mthun sgrigs pa tsam gyi go mi chod ces zer ba dang*/

bsod nams tshogs bsogs nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar sbyang gzhir sbyong ba yang shin tu 'gal ba yin no/ /des na rang lugs ni/ skye shi bar do la sogs pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul khyad par can yod pa rnams ni sbyong tshul gtso bo yin pas sbyang gzhi dag pa dang 'bras bu grub pa'i nga rgyal yang dgos pa yin no/ /lhag ma cha shas phra mo rnams ni/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul phal pa ste/ chos mthun sgrigs pa tsam yin kyang*/ tshul de tshad ldan 'ga' las kyang bshad pas sbyang gzhi dang sbyor tshul ni yin no/ /'ga' zhig dam tshig pa yongs rdzogs bskyed zin nas/ sbyang 'bras te sangs rgyas zin pa'i skabs dang sbyor rgyu yin pas/ de phan chad la sbyang gzhi mi sbyor zhes dang*/ 'chi ba lam byed chos sku dang*/ bar do lam byed longs sku dang*/ skye ba lam byed sprul sku dam tshig sems dpar bzhengs pa yin par 'dod pa'i nang 'gal smra ba dag ni rnam par 'khyams te/ 'bras dus su sangs rgyas thob pa'i skabs su sbyor ba la/ sbyang 'bras kyi skabs yin par 'dod na ni/ chos sku thob la sku gnyis ma 'grub cing sangs ma rgyas pa'i gang zag ni mi srid pas sprul sku kho na sbyangs 'bras la sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ de tshun chad sbyang gzhi gtso che ba yin snyam na/ sbyang gzhi gtso bo'i skabs sbyang 'bras dang sbyor du rung na/ sbyang 'bras gtso che ba'i skabs sbyang gzhi dang ci phyir sbyor du mi rung*/ des na 'khrul pa 'di ni rnam gzhag rim pa'i gzhung la 'khrul gzhi byas shing*/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel dang*/ sngon gyi lo paṇa chen po rnams la dbang za ba'o/ /'dir sbyang gzhi'i rnam gzhag phal cher grags che ba ltar bkod pa yin la/ spyir sbyang gzhi rigs gnyis yod pas dam pa chen po 'ga' zhig gis sbyang gzhi sbyang bya'i dbye ba rtsal du 'don par mdzad pa ni ches legs mod/ 'khor ba'i chos sbyang gzhir 'dod pa la dkag pa shugs phyung nas mdzad pa ni bdag nyid rtsod pa lhur len pa la dges par gsal ba tsam mo/

/de rnams kyi rgal brtags zhib mo ni mangs par 'gyur bas rgya mi bskyed do/ /de ltar log rtog bkag nas rang lugs la yang*/ yang snying du gril ba la sbyang gzhi dang sbyar ba dang*/ sbyang 'bras dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'chi ba sbyong byed dang*/ bar do sbyong byed dang*/ skye ba sbyong byed yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs dang*/ bde mchog nag po lugs kyi mngon rtogs la ni ye shes tshogs bsog nyid 'chi ba sbyong byed yin te/ 'di ni sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis char yin no/ /lugs gzhan rnams ni brjod mi lang ngo*/ /gnyis pa bar do sbyong byed ni/ mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla med dang*/ gshed dmar dang*/ gdan bzhi rnams la ni zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su sgom ste/ bar do'i lus dang rnam pa mthun pa yin/ kha cig las yi ge lnga dgod pa ni/ 'bru gsum po bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum/ ho gnyis ni sred len gnyis so/ /de bzhin du yi ge gcig pa dang nā da 'jog pa tsam kyang mtshon byed tsam mo/ /sems kyi snang ba tsam las bar do'i gzugs mtshon byed dngos su mi 'jog pa ni/ rags pa'i lus med cing phra ba'i yid lus tsam la brten pa dang*/ sa bon bskyed pa nyid kyi dus su ma gtogs/ bar do'i sems snang du ldang ba yang med pa ni/ srin bu pad pa 'pho ba bzhin du bar do shin tu yun thung ba dus mtha'i skad cig ma tsam las mi gnas pa rnams dang mthun par bsgom pa yin no/ /gsum pa la skye gnas bzhi'i rim pa la dpyad pa ni/ bskyed rim tshad ldan gang yang rung ba gcig gis kyang skye gnas bzhi char spyod nus pas mngal skyes sbyong byed zhes bya ba la sogs pa tha snyad sbyor ba ni mi mdzes so/ /'o na ci zhe na/ sbyong byed yin pa la skye gnas bzhi la nye ring med kyang*/ bskyed tshul 'dra ba'i dbang du byas nas gtso bor brdzus skyes dang rnam pa mthun pa'i dkrongs bskyed dang*/

drod gsher skyes dang rnam pa mthun pa'i zla ba sa bon tsam las bskyaid pa dang rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed/ sgong skyes dang rnam pa mthun pa'i mngon byang lnga bskyed/ mngal skyes dang rnam pa mthun pa'i zhu ba glus bskul las bzhengs pa rnams so/ /gong ma rnams mngon rtogs gcig nyid la yang mi sogs byin rlabs kyi lha brdzus skyes dang*/ mngon byang lnga bskyed drod gsher skyes dang*/ mkha' spro byed pa mngal skyes dang*/ thig le'i gong bu las bzhengs pa sgong skyes dang mthun par bzhed pa ni/ de ltar ston pa'i khungs zhig yod na ni rung bar mngon no/ /de'i phyir skye ba len tshul dngos ni bar do 'jug pa'i dus kyang sna tshogs pa 'byung ste/ skad cig gis bskyed pa la ni/ sems kyi 'jug pa bsre ba tsam yin la/ bar pa gsum pa la ni sa bon skyed pa'i skabs de nyid yin zhing*/ zhu ba glus bskul ba la ni/ 'jug sgo mi 'dra ba du ma'ang yod de/ bar do 'ga' zhig ma'i skra nas 'dzin par 'dod pas mngal du 'jug pa'ang yod pas spyi bo nas 'jug pa dang*/ 'o byed par 'dod pas 'jug pa yod pa ltar zhal nas 'jug pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig pha'i kha nas 'jug pa yod pa ltar yab kyi zhal nas 'jug pa dang*/ kha cig skye gnas la reg par 'dod pas 'jug pa ltar thog ma nyid nas bha gar 'jug pa'o/ /'di'i 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs pa dang*/ mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi skabs la hūṃ yig sogs sa bon sgom pa ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga sbyong zhing*/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa bskyed pa'i lugs la 'og gi rtse lnga ni yan lag lnga grub pa dang*/ steng gi rtse lnga ni rkang lag re re bzhin sor mo lnga lnga dang*/ mgo bo la mig rna sna lce lus kyi cha shas dang bcas pa sbyor ba yin/ yang 'bras bu'i skabs 'od ky-i gong bu tsam las bskyed pa ni bsdus pa'i dbang du byas shing*/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa sogs ni/

dbang po rnams dang lus ngag yid gsum rim gyi rgyas te lhag par brtags pas/ yul la longs spyod nus su gyur pa dang*/ ye shes pa bstims pa ni bye brag phyed pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba ni rang gi rigs kyi chos la 'jug pa dang*/ mchod bstod la sogs pa ni 'dod yon la longs spyod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu ni dus las 'das te shi ba dang*/ thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs pa ni skye ba gzhan du yang srid len pa mtshon pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu la sbyar ba yang gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas dang mtshungs pa gzhal yas khang*/ ji ltar sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dang mtshungs pa mngon byang lnga sogs bskyed chog gis bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa dang mtshungs pa mchod bstod bzlas pa dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu la sogs pa/ mchod pa len pa chos ston pa sogs 'gro don spyod pa dang mtshungs so/ /gzhan yang sku gsum dang*/ de'i sprul sku'i khyad par rgyas pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la dbang bskur ba brnyes nas 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang*/ ma dag pa'i gdul bya rnams la mya ngan las 'das par snang ba dang*/ dag pa'i 'khor la chos ston pa dang sprul pa la sogs pas 'gro ba'i don rgyun ma chad pa rnams dang rim pas sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /des na bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung gi yar ltas rnam byang gi 'dra 'bag dang mthun pa/ mar ltas 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag dang mthun pa zhes gsungs yang mngon rtogs kyi rim pa'i gtso bo rnams sbyang gzhi'i gnas tshul dang mthun pas de sbyong ba'i nus pa yod pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i gnas tshul dang mthun pas de 'thob pa'i nus pa yod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu lam 'di'i bskyed rim yan lag 'bras bu dang bcas pa la/ bskyed rim dngos rgyas par bshad/ de'i ye shes skye tshul bshad/ de las 'bras bu 'grub tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir sdom pa 'di'i sgrub thabs mtha' yas pa mtha' dag su zhig gis brjod par nus/

'on kyang 'dir nag po spyod pa'i gzhung ltar bshad na/ de la phyi dkyil sgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ lus dkyil sgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rgyas par bsgom pa dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dag pa sbyar ba/ snang stong bde ba sgrub tshul lo/ /dang po la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen spong ba gnyis so/ /de'i yang dang po la/ rkyen bsod nams tshogs bsog dang*/ rgyu lam 'khyer gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro sogs te/ de yang ro'i stan la 'jug nas/ sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ mchod gtor sngon du 'gro ba ste/ 'dir mkhas pa 'ga' zhig sngon 'gro gtor ma sngon du 'gro ba bzhed pa la/ gzhan 'ga' bdag nyams len skabs sngon 'gro gtor ma gtan mi gtong zer te/ dgos med kyi dgag pa yin la/ gal te khyed bsnyen pa song nas sgrub pa'i tshe sngon 'gro gtor ma mi mthong ba'am/ sgrub pa de nyams len gyi skabs ma yin zhes bsam dgos so/ /des na mchod gtor rgyas par byed pa gtso bo yin mod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma yang 'gog mi dgos so/ /de dag ma grub na/ bsnyen pa'i skabs la thog mar 'jug pa'i tshe ma gtogs nyin re bzhin ma byas kyang dgag bya chung bar ni mngon no/ /de nas rgya gzhung rnams na med kyang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gsol 'debs dang*/ yig brgyas rgyud sbyong ba tsam byed pa ni/ bla ma rnams kyi phyag len te shin tu legs so/ /dngos la rten dag par byas pas tshogs gsog pa'i nus pa tsam ma dag pa la mi 'byung bas tshogs bsag 'di la gsum gyi dang po gsog pa po ni/ sgrub pa po ste de'i rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ dag pa gsum dran pa ste/ ngag yid lus gsum sngags dang ye shes dang lha skur byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /phung khams byin gyis brlob pa yang*/ de nyid rig pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed cing*/

rgyu mtshan yang de nyid bcu'i gsung 'khor gyi de nyid kyi nang du de 'dus pa dang*/ kun spyod dang mngon brjod las sgom par gsungs pas so/ /zhes gsungs mod kyi/ de lta na khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor yang nag po pa'i lugs la sgom dgos par 'gyur te rgyu mtshan de gnyis kyi phyir ro/ /spyir de ltar bsgoms kyang 'dir mi 'gal mod/ slob dpon 'di'i dgongs pa ma yin pas 'dir mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa yul ni tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar gsog tshul ni/ phyag dang mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas yan lag bdun pa byed pa'o/ /dgos pa ni spyi tshogs rdzogs par ma zad/ khyad par dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'i rgyu tshogs sgrub pa'o/ /de dag gi cho ga rgyas bsdus ni ci rigs par yod mod kyi mi 'gal bar mthong ngo*/ /gnyis pa la/ 'chi ba chos sku dang*/ bar do longs skur lam du 'khyer ba'o/ /dang po ni ye shes tshogs gsog dngos yin te stong pas sogs so/ /'di la gsum las/ dang po sbyang gzhi ni/ lus can rnams 'chi ba'i sems de gsal stong mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin can yin te 'chi ba 'od gsal zhes kyang zer ba de'o/ /gnyis pa/ sbyangs 'bras ni chos sku rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /rdzogs rim 'od gsal dang bde stong dbyer med khyad par can gyi smin byed du 'gro'o/ /gsum pa sbyong byed kyi lam 'dis/ /lam du 'khyer tshul ni gzhi 'bras gnyis char dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam stong pa nyid bsgoms te/ sbyang gzhi dag pa dang 'bras bur rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal lam mos pa 'jog pa yin te/ 'og ma rnams la yang 'dis rigs 'gre bar bya'o/ /'di la'ang rnam thar gsum mam bzhi dang*/ stong pa nyid gcig pu'i sngags brjod cing sgom pa'ang rung mod kyis lag len la sngags tshan gnyis brjod pa'i dang pos sems tsam du shes pa dang*/ gnyis pas thams cad stong pa nyid du mos par bya ste/

slob dpon 'di'i lugs la shin tu legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni ye shes tshogs bsag gi 'bras bu ste nā das sogs so/ /'di la gsum gyi sbyang gzhi ni/ 'chi ba las langs ma thag bar do'i lus 'grub cing*/ sems snang ba gsum rlung gi bzhon pa dang bcas pa de'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ni rlung sems rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi sku mtshan dpes spras pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'o/ /rdzogs rim rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sku dang zung 'jug gi smin byed du 'gro'o/ /sbyong tshul lam lam du 'khyer lugs ni gzhi 'bras gnyis ka dang rnam pa mthun par stong pa las langs ma thag tu shin tu phra ba'i gzugs nā da tsam zhig bkod nas/ dag rdzogs kyi nga rgyal byed pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi dgos pa ni gtso bor sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnyis yin mod kyi/ gnas skabs su 'og nas 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi snang ba rab 'byams stong pa nyid kyi cho 'phrul du shes pa'i phyir yin no/ /skabs 'dir spyi don cung zad brjod na/ spyi'i chos lam byed bzhi dang*/ sgos kyi chos lam byed dgu'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir bskyed rdzogs sgom pa'i rim pa thams cad la/ bod snga ma rnams lam du 'gyur tshul lam/ lam byed bzhi'i tha snyad mdzad de shin tu chos skad bzang ngo*/ /de la gzhi'i rnam pa lam byed ni/ 'bras bu dang rnam pa mthun par bsgoms pas gsal snang skyes nas ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog pa ste/ keng rus bsgoms pas gsal snang skyes pa'i tshe/ 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags 'gog pa bzhin no/ /mos pa lam byed ni gang du mos pa de mngon du 'gyur te/ mnar med kyi me yang shā ri'i bus chur mos pas chur song ba bzhin no/ /'bras bu lam byed ni 'bras bu thob bya de nyid bsgoms pas de 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa bsgoms pas bsam gtan gyi sems 'grub pa bzhin no/ /byin rlabs lam byed ni sangs rgyas sogs kyi byin rlabs kyi tha mal pa'i lus sems ye shes su sgyur ba ste/
