ba'i lci ba gser du byin rlabs mdzad pas der 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /dang po ni/ lha sku dang bde stong thams cad yin la/ bar pa gnyis kyang bskyed rim gyi lha sku thams cad la yod/ phyi ma ni ye shes kyi lha tshogs rang la bstims pa dang*/ rang dang rtsa khams lhar bskyed pas de'i byin rlabs 'byung ba dang*/ sngags bzla ba dang mchod gtor dbul ba la sogs pa yang yin mod kyi gtso bor ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ mos gus dang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis phyag rgya chen po mngon sum lam du byed pa yin no/ / des lam du byed nus par bstan no/ /gnyis pa la thun mong pa'i sku gsum lam byed/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sku gsum lam byed/ dgongs chos mkhyen gsum lam byed do/ /dang po ni/ stong pas 'chi ba dang chos sku lam du byed/ nā da sogs kyis bar do dang longs sku lam du byed/ bar srid zhugs phyin chad skye ba sprul sku lam du byed do/ /gnyis pa ni phyi dkyil sgom pa rags pa'i lus dang chos mtshungs pas sprul sku lam byed/ lus dkyil phra ba'i lha'i ngo bo dang bde ba'i rgyu yin pas longs sku lam byed/ byang phyogs kyi dag pa dran pa chos nyid bsam pa yin pas chos sku lam byed de/ snga ma gsum bla med thams cad kyi spyi skad dang*/ 'di bde mchog sgos kyi chos skad sku gsum lam byed do/ /gsum pa ni/ byang phyogs kyi dag pa dran pa lam thun mong bar dran pa gzhi shes lam byed/ lus dkyil sa bcu sogs dang sbyor bas lam gyi rnam pa la dmigs pa'i phyir lam shes lam byed/ gong du srid gsum lam byed dang*/ go cha rgyas gdab mchod bstod sogs rnam mkhyen lam byed ces pa shin tu thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'gal rkyen 'gog pa ni bsrung ba'i sogs la bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ste/ khro mo spro ba/ bgegs dgug pa/

phur bus btab ste tshar gcod pa/ phyin chad bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phyir phyogs bcing ba drug gis bsrung bar byed pa'o/ /de ltar yang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ rwa ba rnams ni phyogs su dgod/ /'og tu mtshon cha dgod par bya/ /'khor lo gnas pa'i bdag nyid mnyam/ /steng du mda' yi drwa ba bya/ /mkha' spyod du ni gur byas te/ /de dag gis ni go char 'gyur/ /de ltar go bgos sum cu ni/ /rtse gsum pas kyang 'jig mi nus/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'di'i chos mthun ni rgyu rdor 'dzin la ltos nas sbyor te/ bsrung 'khor ni dus bzhi 'dul ba mtshon la/ rgyu rdor 'dzin du bzhengs pa ni/ snga ma'i rjes thogs su mngon byang lnga la brten nas sangs rgyas pa mtshon zhing*/ 'dir bgegs 'joms par bka' bsgo ba po ni/ rang sems nā da he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni 'byung bzhi sogs te 'di la gsum gyi/ rang bzhin gyi yan lag ni chos 'byung bskyed pa ste/ sbyang gzhi nam mkha' la brten nas snod kyi 'jig rten 'chags pa dang*/ skye gnas la brten nas sems can skye ba ltar sbyong byed lam du yang rten brten pa gnyis char gyi gzhir chos 'byung sgom pa yin te/ chos 'byung ni nam mkha' dang skye gnas mtshon pa'o/ /yang chos 'byung dkar po'am phyi dkar la nang dmar ba ni bde ba chen po mtshon zhing*/ steng gi zur gsum dang 'og gi zur gcig ste bzhi pos ni/ rnam thar bzhi ste stong nyid mtshon pas rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad bde stong du shes pa'i ched do/

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ gnyis pa £© gnas kyi yan lag la gsum las/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ dang po sgom £© tshul gyi dbye ba ni 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa sgom pa ste/ 'di la kha cig bla ma gong ma rnams 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung lugs zlog gnyis mdzad pa la khungs med ces dgag pa byed pa dang*/ kha cig ma rgyud la de ltar byed pa mi rigs te/ 'byung bzhi ri rab lan gnyis byed pa gnyis med rgyud kyi khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba ni gnyis char slob dpon gyi gzhung shin tu brling pa'i don ma rtogs shing*/ bla ma'i zhal lung ma thob par thos bsam gyi shes rab kyi rgya gar gyi gzhung 'grel 'ga' ltas pa'i don la rtsing chos byed par snang ste/ phyi ma ni sgrub byed bsgrub bya dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lugs 'di skyong ba rnams kyis kyang gnas ji bzhin ma thon te/ mngal du 'jug pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyor ba tsam zhig ma gtogs/ gzhan dgag pa byed pa rnams la lan ma thebs shing*/ rang lugs kyang gtsang mar 'jog shes pa shin tu nyung bar byung ngo*/ /des na rang lugs ni/ slob dpon nyid kyi gzhung las/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig drangs te/ dung chen po yi ngo bo dang*/ /yang na rus sbas dag gis so/ /zhes pa la dung chen po dang bde ba chen po yi ge'i khyad par tsam mo/ /mkhas pa mar do'i 'gyur las/ dung chen po yi rang bzhin bya/ /mi phyed pa dang rus sbal lo/ /zhes 'byung ste/ don ni mal/ mar do/ pu rangs lo chung gsum char gyi lugs mthun te/ ri rab kyi steng du rnam snang gi rang bzhin gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ ri rab kyi steng du mngon byang lnga las gzhan yas khang rgyu rdor 'dzin yab yum dang bcas pa dus gcig tu bskyed pa'i lugs gnyis gdam nga can du byed pa yin te/ kha cig bde ba chen po zhes pas snga ma dang*/ kha cig mi phyed pa zhes pas snga ma bstan par bzhed cing*/ gsum char yang rus sbal zhes pas phyi ma bstan par bzhed

do/ /de la phyi ma'i dbang du byas na/ 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung lugs zlog gnyis car byed pa'am/ gcig las mi byed kyang lugs zlog byed dgos te/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa kho na la ltos pa'i sbyang gzhi mngal du 'jug pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ snga ma ltar na gnyis char byung na ni shin tu legs la/ ma byung yang gcig gis rung ba tsam du mngon te snod kyi 'jig rten gyi 'byung bzhi sbyong ba tsam las gzhan nang la mi sbyor ba'i phyir ro/ /sbyangs 'bras dang sbyar ba ni/ gong du sogs te gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed pa tshun chad gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing mtshon pas de sbyong ba yin la/ des na lam du byed tshul gong du bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro tshul la sbyar na/ 'byung ba sogs te/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bzhi la bshad rgyud rnams su mang du sbyar ba ltar yin pas/ da lta 'di bsgoms pas rtsa 'khor de rnams byin gyis rlobs te/ rlung gis spyi bo/ mes mgrin pa/ chus snying kha/ sas lte ba/ ri rab kyis dbu ma rnams byin gyis brlabs pas gnas der rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshe/ rlung thim pa'i bde stong 'dren pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'o/ /da lta 'di rnams la lha brten pa ltar rdzogs rim skabs bde chen ye shes kyi lha de yang rtsa 'khor dang dbus ma la brten pa yin no/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi la gnyis/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ dang po £© phyi rol dang sbyar ba ni 'byung bzhi gcig tu 'dus pa/ nam mkhar 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran tshogs pa dang 'dres pa de rnams 'dus pa dang*/ de las lugs 'byung bskyed pa 'byung bzhi ri rab bcas pa grub pa mtshon te/ slob dpon nyid kyi gzhung las/ blo ldan ldan pas mkha' dbyings su/ /zhes chos 'byung dang*/ 'byung ba thams cad 'dus pa las/ /zhes lugs 'byung bskyed nas 'dres pa dang*/ ji ltar sna tshogs gzhir gyur pa'i/

/'byung ba bzhi po rnam par bsgom/ zhes slar yang bskyed par shin tu gsal lo/ /'byung bzhi'i rim pa gcig byed pa'i tshe/ /steng 'og ji ltar yang gsal 'debs pa'i go rim lugs zlog gsal te/ slob dpon 'dis rtsa rgyud la gtso bor brten pa las/ des na lugs zlog 'ba' zhig gsal ba'i phyir ro/ / £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ /gnyis pa £© mngal du 'jug pa'i mtshon don la sbyar ba ni/ lugs 'byung gi tshe rlung nas ri rab kyi bar bskyed pa/ dri za pha ma'i reg sbyor la brten nas 'jug pa na/ reg pa sra ba'i bde ba dang bar do'i sems de 'dre zhing*/ de nas gsher ba chu'i dang*/ dro ba me'i dang*/ khu ba g.yo ba rlung gi dang*/ de rnams kyi bde ba'i khams la zhugs pa mtshon no/ /nam mkha'i khams bde ba mtshon zhing*/ ri rab kyang khams der bzhag pas so/ /'khor lo so so'i byang chub kyi sems rnams dang gcig tu 'dres te mngal du phyin pa ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab gcig tu 'dres pas mtshon/ /lugs 'byung nang la sbyar ba'i tshe/ rim pa ni bskyed pa'i go rim tsam ste/ dngos ni mngal du khams dkar dmar 'dus pa 'byung ba bzhis phan btags shing*/ nam mkhas go skabs 'byed pa rnams mtshon/ mngon byang lnga las rten brten pa dus gcig tu bskyed pas ni/ sems can sgo nga las skyes pa dang mthun par lha'i bskyed chog sgrub pa yin te/ rus sbal zhes gsungs pa yang*/ rus sbal khog pa dang srog chags lhan cig 'byung ba bzhin bskyed pa la dgongs pa yin no zhes bla ma snga ma rnams gsung ngo*/ /gsum pa ngo bo'i yan yag ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor rnam snang gi rang bzhin gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa bsgom pa ste/ ngo bo'i don yang lha drug cu rtsa gnyis nye bar spyod pa'i gnas yul nyer bzhi dang dur khraud brgyad dang bcas pa'i ngo bo yin pa la 'khor lo sdom pa ring du sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa snga ma rnams gsung ngo*/

/de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi ni ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten/ sbyangs 'bras ni rang snang gi dag pa'i zhing ste yan lag dang bcas pa'i dag rdzogs kyi lam sngar bzhin no/ /gnyis pa brten pa bskyed pa la/ dang po sbyor ba/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchogalas rgyal po mchog gsum las/ dang po la/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nyer sgrub dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub chen bzhi las/ bsnyen pa la/ sngon 'gro rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa dang*/ dngos gzhi 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa'o/ /dang po la/ rgyu mngon byang lnga/ 'bras bu zhal phyag rdzogs pa/ 'phrin las bde ba chen po'i rim pa la 'jug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de rgyu sogs te 'di la thob bya ye shes lnga bshad pa dang*/ lam mngon byang lnga bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ phal cher gong mdo lugs kyi lam du ye shes bzhi bshad pa bzhin yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang cung zad tsam gyi khyad par yang snang bas/ 'dir brjod na/ ye shes grub pa las/ ji ltar gzugs brnyan me long la/ /rang nyid nges par snang ba bzhin/ /de bzhin chos sku'i ye shes ni/ /snang ba'i me long zhes bya'o/ /zhes chos thams cad kyi ji lta ba'i gnas tshul dang*/ ji snyed pa'i snang tshul thams cad me long la shar ba bzhin du cig car gzigs pa'i ye shes te/ kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /mdo nas longs sku'i ngo bor bshad pa la/ 'dir res 'ga' chos sku'i ngo bor yang gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes te/ /rang nyid dang ni 'gro ba yi/ /dngos nyid gcig par thugs chud pas/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes bya'o/ /zhes rang gzhan mnyam pa nyid du gzigs pa ni nyon yid gnas gyur pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /gdod nas dag cing skye ba med/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes pas/ /so sor rtog pa can zhes bya/ /zhes chos thams cad kyi spu ris ma 'dres par mkhyen zhing*/ ji lta ba'i yang gdod nas dag pa dang skye ba med pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal bar gzigs pa ste/

ngo bo rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba ste bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin la/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis gsal bar gzigs pa'i don rnams 'dis ma 'dres par byed pa ste/ yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /kun tu kun nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa la 'jug pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mdzad gcig pas/ /bya ba sgrub pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pa ste/ sems can gyi don spyod par mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po 'phrin las dang bcas pa ste/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes sems byung gi rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa gnas gyur pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /gang tshe nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib/ /thams cad las grol de yi tshe/ /rnal 'byor pa mchog rdo rje can/ /shin tu rnam dag zhes bshad do/ /zhes theg pa 'dir lnga pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rtsal du bton te/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings la glo bur sgrib gnyis kyang rnam par dag pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes ni de'i ngo bo ste/ don dam byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid yin par yang gsungs shing*/ rang bzhin gnas rigs gnas gyur pa yin no/ /de la rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs ni kun gzhi'i gsal cha yin te/ de'i ngo bo la rnam shes tshogs brgyad ltar gnas gyur rgyu med kyang*/ sngar de bag chags gsog pa'i rten dang 'dre zhing gnas pa las/ phyin chad bag chags kyi rten kun gzhi rnam shes de des spangs pa la gnas gyur pa zhes ming btags pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa mchog rdo rje can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rdo rje can ni 'od gsal ba yin la/ rnal 'byor pa mchog ces skyes bur bshad pas sgrib pa las grol ba tsam gyi stong rkyang gi cha la 'jog pa ni mi legs so/ /de la gnas gyur gyi sa mtshams ni/ sa brgyad pa thob pa nas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur nas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes shin tu dri ma med par 'gyur/

nyon yid gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes phyogs mthun thob pa yin no/ /spyir mi rtog pa'i ye shes yid shes dang mtshungs ldan yin yang*/ nyon yid gnas ma gyur pa de srid du yid shes kyang gzugs sogs med bzhin du yod par snang bas phyin ci log tu 'jug la/ nyon yid gnas gyur na yid shes kyang gnas gyur te/ sor rtog ye shes rjes mthun pa rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor 'gyur ro/ /dbang shes rnams gnas kyang 'gyur te bya sgrub ye shes phyogs mthun tsam thob pa yin la/ de yang mdo sde rgyan las/ don bcas 'dzin pa gzhan gyur na/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'dzin pa dbang shes lnga gnas gyur pas gzugs sogs gzung ba'i don yul lnga yang gnas 'gyur ba ste/ yul gnas gyur pas zhing dag pa dang*/ dbang shes gnas gyur pas zhing der bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i 'byor pa thams cad 'byung ba yin no/ /yid kyi 'khor du gtso bor 'byung ba'i rnam rtog sems byung thams cad gnas gyur pas so so rig pa bzhi'i ye shes su 'gyur te/ sems can gyi don la thogs pa med par spyod pas sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'o/ /sa bcu rgyun gyi tha mar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ gnas don lugs su snang ba dag /ces gnas 'jig rten gyi khams/ lus su snang ba dang bcas pa'i kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur pas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du 'gyur ba'o/ /kun gzhi gcig pu la bag chags gsog pa'i rten gyi cha ni kun gzhi rnam shes dang*/ gsal rig gi cha ni rang bzhin gnas rigs te/ gnas gyur yang ldog chas phye ba ma gtogs so sor med do/ /gnas gyur rnam gzhag rgyas par gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de rgyu sogs te bsgom bya'i lam/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyar ba/ sbyang 'bras mngon du byed tshul/ khungs med kyi gtan la dpyad pa'i sgo tsam bstan pa'o/

/dang po la/ spyir mngon byang dang po gnyis la nyi zla kha sbyor dang*/ zla ba dkar dmar kha sbyor dang*/ zla ba gnyis la ā li kā li so sor mtshan pa dang*/ zla ba dmar skya ā li kā lis mtshan pa sogs sna tshogs yod kyang rgyas bsdus ma gtogs don gyi sgo nas 'dra'o/ /des na zla ba las byang chub pa ā li'i de nyid dang*/ nyi ma las byang chub pa kā li'i de nyid dang*/ sa bon dang phyag mtshan las byang chub pa dang*/ gcig tu 'dres pa'i bdag nyid las byang chub pa dang*/ sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgom tshul ni mngon rtogs su gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ zla ba ni pha'i khu ba mtshon la/ de'i rgyu dbyangs yig so gnyis su mdzad pa ni/ spyir dbyangs yig ni byang chub kyi sems dkar po mtshon zhing*/ bcu drug 'byung ba ni thig le de yang 'pho ba bcu drug gi cha shas yin pa mtshon zhing*/ bcu drug po de yang zla ba yar ngo mar ngo gnyis kyi dbye bas sum cu rtsa gnyis sam/ man ngag gi snye ma ltar na khu ba'i rnam pa bcom ldan yin/ /de yi bde ba 'dod mar brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ kun rdzob rten thig le bcu drug dang*/ brten pa sems bde ba bcu drug ste so gnyis yin par bzhed do/ /nyi ma ni ma'i dmar cha mtshon te/ de'i rgyu kā li brgyad cu byed pa ni/ kā li nyid rdul mtshon zhing*/ de brgyad cur byed pa ni/ rdul de la sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams lnga yod cing*/ de re re la yang 'byung ba bzhi bzhir phye bas nyi shur 'gyur te/ sdom 'byung las/ gang na gcig nyid gnas pa der/ / bzhi po de kun nye bar gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nyi shu po de la rten thig le lus kyi chos re dang*/ brten pa bde ba sems kyi chos re res phye bas bzhi bcu/ de rnams la kun rdzob snang ba thabs kyi cha re dang*/ rang bzhin stong pa don dam gyi cha re res dbye bas brgyad cu'o/ /sa bon dang phyag mtshan las mngon par byang chub pa 'di ni/

gal te gong du sgong skyes dang mtshungs pa rus sbal lta bur sgom pa yin na khams dkar dmar gyi dbus su srog gi rlung chags pa ni sa bon dang*/ de las rtsa dang yan lag 'grub pa ni phyag mtshan sogs dang sbyor ba yin/ 'on kyang spyir gdam nga tsam gyi rnam grangs su bshad pa ma gtogs/ 'di gtso bo'i don ma yin te/ gzhal yas khang bskyed zin nas der rgyu rdor 'dzin mngon byang lnga bskyed byed pa nyid 'dir don gyi gtso bo yin pas/ 'di'i ltar na thog mar yi ge tsam bar do'i rlung sems khu khrag gi dbus su zhugs pa dang*/ hūṃ gi cha lnga po ni mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga mtshon te/ sdom 'byung las/ mi bskyod gzugs kyi nur nur po/ /mer mer po ni rin chen 'byung*/ /dpag med mgon yang ltar ltar po/ /don yod grub pa gor gor po/ /'khrang 'gyur rnam par snang mdzad de/ rnam pa lngar ni bstan pa yin/ /zhes mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga rigs lnga dang sbyar zhing*/ de ye shes lnga dang*/ de hūṃ la sbyar ba'i rig pas yin gsung*/ rdo rje ni yan lag nying lag dbang po rnams dod pa'o/ /yum gyi sa bon phyag mtshan yang 'di gnyis kyi khongs su bsdu'o/ /thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa ni phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad rim gyis rdzogs te/ btsa' ba la nye ba'o/ /'di la 'od zer spro bsdu yod pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'od zer sna lnga ni 'byung ba lnga'i rlung yin la/ sangs rgyas byang sems ni phung khams skye mched rnams te 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gis phung khams skye mched rnams lhag par rgyas par byed pa'o/ /rus sbal gyi tshul ltar na 'di sgong rgya las 'byung 'dod dang*/ dkyus ltar na mngal nas 'byung bar 'dod pa tshun chad do/ /lnga pa'i phyogs gcig ni btsas pa na lus gzhan gyis mthong ba bzhin du sku yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gzugs kyi sku la mtshan dang dpe byad nges par yod pas/

rgyu'i skabs su ā li so gnyis mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo dang*/ kā li brgyad cu dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bor sgom pa'o/ /de gnyis kyis sku 'grib cing*/ hūṃ sogs sa bon gsung rdo rje'i rgyu dang*/ rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i rgyu gcig tu 'dres pa ni sku gsung thugs gsum mi phyed pa de las sku rdzogs pa ni/ sgo gsum mi phyed dbyer med pa zung 'jug gi sku rdo rje 'chang chen po'o/ /rgyu'i dus su khu khrag gi nang du sems 'jug pa ni lus 'grub tshul yin la khu khrag las lus 'grub pa dang*/ ngag rlung gi yi ge'i chos su 'byung ba dang*/ sems mtshan ma'i rnam par 'byung ba dang*/ lus sems dbyer mi nus pa la skyes bur 'dogs pa dang chos mtshungs sbyong byed yin te/ 'dir dag yid kyi chos yod kyang gtso bor sku 'grub tshul yin pas sku 'grub tshul dang sbyar ba de ltar bstan pa ni rnam grangs dang po'o/ /da ni thugs 'grub tshul dang sbyar bar bya ste/ zla ba ni bde ba/ nyi ma ni gsal stong gi ye shes/ kha sbyor ni mnyam nyid/ sa bon ni rang rig pa/ phyag mtshan ni ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ gcig gyur shes pa dang shes bya gcig tu gyur pa ste gzung 'dzin dbyings su dag pa/ sku yongs rdzogs ni de nyid ye shes kyi skur snang ba ste/ yang na zla ba dkar po rang bzhin skyon gyis gos pa med pa/ sems kyi ngo bo sgrib gnyis kyi rang bzhin du gdod nas skye ma myong ba ste/ sems kyi ngo bo yang stong pa tsam gyi cha nas mi 'jog gi rig stong gi ngo bo la 'jog go /nyi ma dmar po bde ba dang snying rjes rjes su chags pa mtshon zhes kyang gsungs te rnam grangs gnyis pa'o/ /'dir gtso bo'i don ni ye shes lnga dang sbyar ba ste/ zla ba ni kun gzhi gnas gyur me long ye shes te/ sam+pu ṭi dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo gnyis dgongs pa dang dbyangs gcig par/

yid gnyis kun nas rnam grol ba/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib 'phrog /nyon mongs dri ma kun las 'das/ /zla mtshungs sems ni zla ba nyid/ /yid gnyis sogs mthong bas spang bya rnams dang*/ yang dag min rtog thams cad de sems sems byung gnyis snang can gyi rab rib spangs te rang bzhin nyon mongs sogs dri ma kun nas 'das pa'i me long ye shes de zla ba dkar zhing dri mas ma gos pa dang 'dra'o/ /nyi ma ni nyon yid gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes te/ nyon yid bdag tu sgro 'dogs pa'i rnam pa can de gnas gyur pa bdag gzhan mnyam nyid du gzigs pa'i ye shes des sems can la chags pas rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ snying rjes sdug bsngal yang dag 'byung*/ /sems can rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /dge ba'i chos kyis yang dag gang*/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges par gnon/ /nyi mas mun pa 'joms pa ltar/ sems can gyi nyon mongs 'joms/ snang bas phan 'dogs pa ltar rjes su 'dzin/ drod kyis gdung ba dang bcas pa ltar snying rjes gdung ba'o/ /phyag mtshan ni/ yid gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes te/ byang chub spyod pa de bzhin du/ /ye shes dag pa zag pa med/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor snang gnas pa/ /de yi nang gi phyag mtshan brtagaces te/ zla nyi sogs thun mong gi rgyu yin/ phyag mtshan so sor nges pa dang rang bzhin ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'o/ /mngon byang bzhi pa gcig gyur ni dbang shes lngar gnas gyur pa/ bya sgrub ye shes te thams cad 'dres pa sgo lnga'i rnam shes ye shes kyi ngo bo gcig tu 'dres pa dang*/ ye shes gzhan thams cad kyi las byed pa yin pa chos mtshungs so/ /mngon byang lnga pa sku yongs rdzogs ni/ rigs gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes te sku yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rdzogs pa chos mtshungs pa'o/ /dpal sam+pu ṭi las gsungs pa ni/ gru gsum rgya che'i rang bzhin can/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gnas/

/'di ni a sogs gzugs kyi ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i yon tan gyi gnas ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ gru gsum sogs chos 'byung gi nang du sgom pa ste/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi don no/ /zla ba gnyis pa sems can rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /dge ba'i chos kyis yang dag gang*/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges par gnod/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /byang chub zla ba gnyis pa can/ /'dir yang skar ma'i rnam pas ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan ka sogs kyi/ /gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan lta bu yi/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di ni zla ba dmar po ste/ /mtshon don nyi ma dang 'dra'o/ kha cig skar ma'i gzugs zhes pas/ /kā li rnams dang*/ des mtshon nas zla ba 'di yang dkar po yin par bzhed pa dang*/ kyai rdor gyi 'grel pa ku mu ṭir/ lha mo'i yan lag dang nying lag gi gzugs zur gsum gyi zla ba gnyis pa zhes bshad/ zla ba zur gsum gru gsum rgya che'i don yin zhes bla ma gong ma 'ga' re bzhed/ skar ma ni mig dmar ltar dmar ba dang*/ pad+mar gnas pa'i thig le sbyong byed yin pas/ chos 'byung la gnas pa ched du smos dgos byung bas gru gsum sogs gsungs par/ a bhā ya ka ra'i zhal snga nas bzhed pa ni mi thub zla ba'i 'grel pa'i don dang yang gcig pas rang lugs 'di'o/ /zur gsum gyi zla ba zhes pa/ gzhong pa'i zan zhes pa lta bu yin pas lha mo'i yan lag pad+ma la gnas pa'i thig le dkar dmar gyi don te/ mi thub zla ba rang gi gzhung las/ lha mo'i gzugs kyi yan lag ni/ /gru gsum du ni zla ba lta/ /zhes pas gsal lo/ /'gar ston la rdog tu 'khrul pa kha cig dgag pa gtong ste snying po med pa sha stag go /byang chub phyi ma gsum ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /lung rnams dang mtha' dpyod bris na mang par 'gyur bas 'di rnams la dang po sems sor rtog las byang chub pa ste/

stong pa nyid la so sor rtog pa'i 'jug pa rab kyi mthar son pa rgyun mtha'i dus su 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems las byang chub pa ste/ bde ba chen po don dam byang sems rab mthar thug pa'o/ /gsum pa brtan pa'i rdo rje las mngon par byang chub pa ste/ bde stong des sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de sgrib pa dang gdod nas bral bar gzigs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje'i bdag nyid las mngon par byang chub pa ste/ der yul yul can dbyer med du gzigs pa bde stong dang rang rig rang bzhin gyi dag pa dbyer med mthar thug par gzigs te/ 'dis ma rig bag chags kyi sa spong*/ kun gzhi gnas gyur/ spang bya thams cad spong ba'o/ /lnga pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ji lta ba de lta bu las mngon par byang chub pa ni/ dbyer med mthar thug pa'i gzigs pa de nyid longs spyod rdzogs sku'i sku dang*/ zhing dang yo byad ma 'gags par shar ba ste sku longs sku/ thugs chos sku 'grub/ sangs rgyas thob zin pa'o/ /de la lnga po 'di'i ming dang*/ nga rgyal bzung ba'i sngags rnal 'byor rgyud dang 'dra yang don mi 'dra ste/ dmigs pa sogs kyang mi gcigarnal 'byor rgyud kyi de la sbyar gzhi dang yang mi sbyor/ 'bras bu 'grub tshul yang mi 'dra ste 'og tu 'chad do/ /kyai rdor skabs su/ rje btsun dam pa sa skya pa gong ma rnams zla ba kha sbyor mnyam sbyor dang*/ nyi zla kha sbyor mi mnyam sbyor zhes gsung ngo*/ /'dir slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i sgrub thabs kyi tshig tu bskyed chog mi gsal yang lugs 'di gnyis ka rung bar mngon no/ /bzhi pa ni/ dbyings dang ye shes rgyas btab phyir/ /sogs kyi rnam gzhag mang po byed mod/ ha cang nus pa che bar ma mthong la/ de dag tshang bar bla ma snga rabs rnams kyi gsung la ma mthong bas bar skabs su byung ba'i gtam yin la phyis de dag la bshad yams su dpyad pa rgyas par byed pa ltar byas te mthar rang lugs su khas blangs nas/

slar rgyu'i dus su gnas pa ltar dbang mngon byang lnga'i tshul du bskur bas 'grub pa'i rgyu byed/ lam bskyed rim du de ltar bsgoms pas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed dang*/ 'bras dus 'tshang rgya tshul yin pas rgyu 'bras su 'gro ba'i bshad pa dgos/ mtshon don sgrigs pa tsam la snying po med do/ /zhes mtshon don sgrigs pa 'ga' zhig rang lugs su khas blangs nas/ de 'dra snying po med ces rang gis rang la co 'dri ba ste/ phyi rabs kyi mkhas pa dag gis chos mthun tsam la snying po med zer bas yid drangs te brjod 'dod kyi dbang gi rjes su zlos pa'o/ /chos mthun tsam zhig ka min na mnyam sbyor mi mnyam sbyor re res rdzogs rim yongs rdzogs kyi smin byed du mi 'gro ba'i skyon bzlog tu med de/ de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa zhig go /'dir smras pa/ don gyi gtso bo 'khrul gyur na/ /gnad rnams 'khrul 'gyur de dgag bya/ /nges med gtam gyi lan brjod na/ /dus kyang gron du mi 'gyur ram/ gnyis pa 'bras bu zhal phyag rdzogs pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin zhes pas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ sku mdog dkar po ni/ gzhi'i dus su sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dri mas ma gos pa dang*/ 'bras dus thugs dag pa gnyis ldan dang*/ kha dog dkar po tshon thams cad kyi gzhi yin pa bzhin du/ longs spyod rdzogs sku yang sprul pa thams cad kyi sprul gzhi'i sku yin pa mtshon/ lugs 'di la nges par rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po yin te/ rgyud dang sgrubs thabs gnyis char du/ /sku mdog dkar po khro bo che/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /spyir rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa nag por byed pa yang 'ga' zhig tu 'byung ste/ chos nyid mi 'gyur ba mtshon pa yin zhes gsung ngo*/ /'di'i zhal phyag gi grangs ni sna tshogs par 'dod pa byung ba/ spyir khungs zhig yod na mi 'gal mod/ /'on kyang zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa rtsa bar gsungs pas/

rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yang rtsa ba'i lha yin pas de ltar 'grig cing*/ dus min 'chi las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /yan lag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang sbyar/ /thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni/ /zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar/ /zhes rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa slob dpon gyi sgrub thabs su rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi phyag mtshan ston byed du grangs pa phyag bzhi pa'i dbang du mdzad de/ rtsa phyag 'bras bu rdor 'dzin dang 'dra bas dogs pa chung ba'i dbang du byas shing*/ phyag lhag ma gnyis kyi phyag mtshan ston byed du snang bas so/ /phyag bzhi ni so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'am bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dag pa'o/ /sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni mngon byang lnga pa yin na/ so sor 'byed pa mi rigs so snyam na/ sku der 'grub bzhin pa mngon byang lnga par 'jog la/ grub zin nas gsal 'debs pa 'bras bu'i skabs su 'jog go /gsum pa la mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i mdzad pas bar srid dgug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin te/ sna rtse gnyis su yi ge d+yaṃ dang byaṃ gis mtshan pa bshad rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin kha bgang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ bde ba chen po'i mdzad pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ /'dod chags can zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis so/ /de yan chad ni rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa pha ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /mngon rtaugs kyi gtso bo'i sku gsum lam byed dang*/ srid pa gsum sbyong byed kyi dbang du byas na/ srid pa gsum gyi ltos sa ltos 'jog 'bras bu rdor 'dzin la ltos nas 'jog dgos pas/ da lta 'bras bu rdor 'dzin gyi rgyu bar srid kyi nga rgyal la gnas pas de dag kyang bar do sbyong byed kyi khongs su 'du ba yin no/ /mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi skabs su skye srid 'grub tshul rgyas par bshad pa de dag ni rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dgos kyi bar do dang skye srid kyi dbang du byas pa ste/

rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa pha ma dang mtshungs pa yin la/ sbyang gzhi dang rnam pa mthun par pha dang ma'i skye ba 'grub tshul gyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ mngon rtogs gcig nyid la yang srid pa sbyong tshul lan mang du byung ba ni/ de dang de'i dri ma sbyong ba la mthu che ba yin no/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dri za nye bar gnas pa'i rkyen gyi 'dod pas shin tu non pas/ rdo rje dang pad+ma sad par gyur pa de sbyong zhing*/ bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ni pha ma snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe/ sems rgyud bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa sbyong zhing*/ sbyong 'bras la sbyar na rgyu rdor 'dzin du bzhengs pa longs sku 'grub pa dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te snyoms par 'jug pa ni sprul pa'i sku sprul par bzhed nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'dod chags chen pos rnam par rol pa dang mtshungs pa yin la/ dag rdzogs kyi rim pas lam du 'khyer tshul ni gong bzhin no/ /'di'i rjes su snying rje'i dbang bskur byed pa lwa ba pa'i rgyud 'grail nas 'dren pa ni gsang 'dus zhabs lugs kyi rgyas bkab ste de ltar byas pas spyir rung mod kyang*/ 'di'i lugs ni ma yin pas mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa la bar srid 'jug pa dang*/ zhu ba glus bskul ba dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nā da zhes sogs te 'dod chags chen pos 'dul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams 'khor lo bde mchog bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas snyoms 'jug mdzad par bsam mo/ /skul byed yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras grogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang lhan cig tu ngo bo nam mkhar gnas pa'i nā da bar do'i rnam shes kyi rang bzhin de rkyen sangs rgyas yab yum 'dod chags chen po'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba mthong ba'i rkyen gyis bsam pa sprul pa'i skur skye ba blangs la sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pas 'jug tshul skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin du lam rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal nas zhugs te/

sangs rgyas thams cad dang lhan cig tu thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas/ yum gyi pad mar lhung ba las thig le dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni dri za'i sems can gyi skye srid du bzung ba sbyong ba yin no/ kha cig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams nyid bar srid kyi ngo bor 'dod pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis mngon du gzhal yas khang la nā da thim par byed de/ gnyis char la lung rigs kyis gnod cing*/ 'ga' zhig bar do cha gnyis su 'jog pa la/ gzhi'i dus su bar do gnyis rgyud gcig la mi yong bas mi 'thad ces pa dang*/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyur rang sems bsre ba ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten la sems med pas mi rung snyam pa ni shin tu 'byams pa'i rnam rtog ste/ sbyang gzhi la pha ma'i lus bzhin lag gi rnam pa can thig le gor gor po ru song*/ de nyid bur 'gro ba mi srid kyang de sbyong ba la lam du de la sgom dgos pas/ de ltar gzhi dang ma mthun pa ni yon tan yin gyi skyon ma yin/ snod kyi 'jig rten la sems med ces pa yang phyi rol gyi 'jig rten 'di sems can yin par ni kho bo cag kyang mi 'dod/ de dag la sems bsre ba'i dmigs pa byed pa tsam las lhag pa snang ba thams cad sems kyi snang ba las phyi don du grub par med par khas len/ phyi'i yul snang la sems bsre ba mi 'thad na/ khyed dag snang ba thams cad he ru kar bsgom zhes pa'i tshig tsam ni khas len par snang bas bem po'i rang bzhin gyi he ru ka zhig sgom mam ci/ gzhan yang 'di dag la mang du brtag par byar yod do/ /des na 'dir rus sbal gyi tshul la ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab mngon byang lnga sogs bskyed pa'i skabs de rnams la rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam bsre zhing*/ rang nyid yin pa'i nga rgyal yang 'jug pa yin la/ dkyus ltar na/ mngon byang gsum pa'i tshe sems snang bsre zhing nga rgyal yang 'jug pa yin la/

rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa la ltos pa'i bar do 'jug mtshams yang de nyid yin no/ /'di la nam mkha'i nā da nas cha gcig chad de thim pa la sogs pa ni mi byed pa'i lugs de nyid gzhung gi dgongs par mngon no/ / gnyis pa ni/ bar srid zhugs shing thig le 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis kyang thig ler zhu ba ni/ dri za zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'dzag bde lhag par thob pas rnam rtog gi rgyu ba rags pa 'gags pa mtshon zh-ing thig le'i ngo bo gcig tu gyur pas ni skye srid bzung ba'i sems can de mngal du dang por khu khrag sems gsum ro gcig tu 'dres nas zla ba gcig gi bar du sems brgyal ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa de sbyong ba yin no/ /de las bskul ba ni thig le las byung ba'i sangs rgyas lha mo dang bcas pa rnams te/ de rnams kyis bskul ba ni mngal du khams lnga rang rang gi rlung dang bcas pa rnams kyis mngal 'phel bar byed pa yin te/ sas sra bar byed/ chus bsdud par byed/ mes smin par byed/ rlung gis rgyas par byed/ nam mkhas 'phel ba'i skabs sbyin par byed de/ de ltar 'byung ba bzhis phan 'dogs par mtshon pa yin no/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po mngal gyi gnas skabs ni/ bskul bas sogs te/ de ltar bskul ba'i rkyen gyis thig le de nyid cha gnyis su gyur te/ hūṃ dang aṃ yab yum gnyis su gyur pas ni mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu'i rim pas yan lag dang nying lag yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar du sbyong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa btsas pa'i gnas skabs ni 'bras bu'i bde mchog sogs so/ /yi ge de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur pa ste/ sku tsam gsal 'debs pa ni/ btsas pa tsam dang*/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod cing phyogs bzhi'i bgegs tshar gcod par bsam pa ni btsas ma thag nas sna sgor rlung rgyus te/ dbu ma'i dbugs dang bcas pas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung dgu brgya ba phrag gcig bde bar rgyu bas 'byung ba'i khams mi 'khrugs par byed pa'o/

/de yan chad sbyang 'bras la sbyar na/ sems can rnams 'dul ba'i don du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ston par bzhed de/ bde ba chen po rjes su chags pa'i ye shes de/ sems can rnams kyi snang ngor mngal bzung ba'i tshul ston pa dang*/ sku bltams te phyogs bzhir goms pa bdun bdun bor zhing nges par brjod par mdzad pa dang mtshungs so/ /gong ma'i lam dang sbyar ba la 'di yan chad kyi lam lnga rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas te/ dang po tshogs bsags pa'i skabs ni tshogs lam/ nā da nam mkhar gnas pa'i skabs ni sbyor lam/ zhugs shing thim pa ni mthong lam/ rim gyis bzhengs pa mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu ni sa bcu ste sgom lam/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin du bzhed zin pa ni mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /rdzogs rim gy-i smin byed du 'gyur tshul ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rtsa 'khor bzhi dbu ma dang bcas pa 'byung bzhi ri rab dang*/ gdan pad+mas rtsa 'dab rnams mtshon te/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi bstan nas/ de la gnad du bsnun pas ye shes 'char tshul ni lha dang sbyor ba yin te/ nyi zlas ni rtsa 'khor de rnams su khams dkar dmar 'du 'phrod kyi 'bar 'dzag 'byung ba dang*/ sa bon rlung dang*/ phyag mtshan rnam rtog thim pa/ gcig tu 'dres pas stong pa nyid/ sku yongs rdzogs ni rgyu de rnams 'dus pa las bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can 'byung ba'o/ /yang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa ni khams dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod/ zhu ba ni rnam rtog 'gags pa/ sa bon ni rlung sems bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin du bzhengs pa ni/ yan lag bdun ldan gyi ye shes thob pa ste/ dag rdzogs smin gsum gyi sgo nas lam du 'khyer ba'o/ /sprul sku'i ring lam zhes bya ba ni rdzogs rim gyi sprul sku lam byed rnams ni 'bras bu la nye ba yin la/ 'dir yid kyis bsgoms pa'i lha sku la mos pa byed pa ni de bas ches ring ba'i don no/

/thig le bzhi zhes sogs la zhal bzhis ni 'khor lo bzhi'i thig le dang*/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis bsags pa dang*/ zhabs gnyis ni dbu ma dang rtsa yid bzang ma dag pa'i bdag nyid de/ de rnams bsgom pas rdzogs rim gyi tshe de ltar 'grub pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'o/ /yang na sprul sku sogs kyi don 'bras dus sprul sku rags pa'i sku 'dzin pa ltar snang ba skye ba dang rnam par mthun pa yin la/ de dang mthun par bsgom pas dag rdzogs gong dang 'dra zhing*/ rdzogs rim snang phyogs lha skus rags pa'i lus sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba la dngos su rgyas 'debs pa'i smin byed do/ /de nas dharma dhā tu sogs kyi nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal byed pa ste/ chos dbyings stong pa nyid kyi ye shes lha skur shar ba de'o/ /zhais pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa nyer bsgrub ni/ go cha gsum sogs so/ /de yang go cha 'god pa ste/ go cha'i lha bcu gnyis kyi skye mched bcu gnyis byin gyis rlob pa yin la/ gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar chad mi 'jug pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod do// mngon brjod las/ lha nyid sngags kyi tshul gyis ni/ /dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed/ ces gsungs pas/ 'di rnams zhal phyag rgyas par gsal thebs shing mos na bya/ ma yin na yi ge nyid lhar mos pas kyang rung ngo*/ /go cha gsum zhes pa ni/ go cha gnyis dang go cha chen po lus dkyil te gsum mo/ /sbyang gzhi lus la sogs pa'i skye mched rnams rim gyis 'phel ba dang*/ sbyangs 'bras ni spyan la sogs pa'i skye mched rnams de bzhin gshegs pas rdul phra rab kyi ngo bor sprul pa yin no/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ gnas gsum du sngags dgod pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa yin la/ sbyang gzhi ni rim gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi nus pa 'phel zhing rdzogs pa dang*/ sbyangs 'bras ni rang gi sgo gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa gnas lnga byin gyis brlabs pa ni 'di'i yan lag ste/

rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs pa yin la/ sbyang gzhi ni rtsa dang khams kyi nus pa cher 'phel bas nyon mongs pa dug lnga rags por gyur pa dang*/ sbyangs 'bras ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du ston pa'o/ /de ltar skye mched dang lus ngag yid gsum gnas lnga rnams byin gyis brlabs pas rim pa ltar mig la sogs pa'i rlung dang*/ khu ba dang*/ khrag dang*/ sems dang*/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi dang*/ bde ba skul byed brla'i rtsa bo che rnams byin gyis brlabs pas rdzogs rim gyi tshe de dag gi rlung thim sla/ rtsa mdud grol sla/ thig le rgyas shing brtan pa'i nus pa 'jog /mngon shes lnga la sogs pa sgrub bla ba'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub chen la gsum gyi dang po ye shes sems dpa'i rgyas btab ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i sogs te/ sngar rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos kyang ngang gis 'jug pa'i 'du shes ni/ rang dang sangs rgyas rnams tha dad dang*/ rang dman zhing de rnams bzang ba'i 'du shes 'byung ba la dam ye bsres pas de rnams sbyong zhing ye shes pa'i nga rgyal tu na 'pho ste/ sngar rang nyid gsar du sangs rgyas pa'i nga rgyal yod pa las/ 'dis thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas thob pa zhig yin pa'i nga rgyal 'byung zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rang nyid la 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos pas/ de thams cad kyi byin brlabs 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod/ nga rgyal de ltar 'pho ba'i phyir spyan sogs cha shas re re la dmigs nas kyang nga rgyal byed dgos so/ /sbyang gzhi ni 'dod pa'i yul la nye bar sems pa dang*/ nges tshig ldan zhes pa la sbyangs 'bras kyi nges tshig ni/ 'dod chags bral tshul gyi nges tshig ste 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i 'dul ba'i sdom pa la brten nas dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams dang thun mong bsam gtan sogs yon tan mang po gser du thob pa'i tshun ston pa'o/

/lam gong ma'i smin byed kyi dbang du byas nas 'dod chags bral tshul gyi nges tshig ste rigs lnga'i nges don gyi dam tshig rnams mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu'o/ /dam ye bsre ba bsgrub pa'i nang du bsdu ba ni gzhung dang mi mthun pa'i bab col lo/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang bskur sogs te rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes pa nges tshig gi 'phros te/ nye rgyu'i dbang gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang chos mtshungs pa'i mthong lam 'grub pa dang sbyar ro/ /'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa sogs rtsa khams thams cad dag cing byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ rigs bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pas de'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gnad do/ /sbyang gzhi rang rang gi rigs kyi bya ba la dbang bskur bas gnas pa dang*/ sbyangs 'bras ni rdo rje gdan du mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa'i tshul ston pa dang*/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis 'gros ltar thig le dbab zlog gi rim pas spyi bor brtan par byed pa'i rdzogs rim gyi smin byed do/ /gsum pa ni/ sgrub pa chen po de'i yan lag mchod pa dang rjes chags gnyis yin te/ dang po'i sbyang gzhi 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs spyod pa dang*/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan zin pa na/ khams gsum gyi mchod pa'i bkod pa rgya chen pos mchod par 'gyur ba mtshon/ gnyis pa'i sbyang gzhi ni/ na tshod rdzogs te 'dod pa'i rtse dga' don du gnyer bas bud med la mngon par sems shing*/ bag ma len pa dang*/ gnyis sbyor la 'jug pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ni/ sprul pa'i sku de 'dod chags chen po'i lam la mos pa rnams rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du yab yum rjes su chags pa'i sprul pa ston pa'o/ /mchod pa dang rjes chags gong 'og gang du byung kyang lam gong ma'i smin byed kyi dbang du byas na spyod pa dang sbyor ro/ /da ni de dag gi dge 'bras bshad de/ de ltar yan lag bzhi las bsnyen pa ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu ste/

rgyu rdor 'dzin dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bskyed pa ni rgyu mthun rgyu dang 'dra ba'i don no/ /nyon yid gnas gyur dang*/ me long ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu byed do/ /nyer sgrub rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ste skye mched byin rlabs yin la/ skye byed rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i ngo bo yin pas so/ /yid rtog pa dang bcas pa gnas gyur/ mnyam nyid mngon du byed sogs gong dang 'dra/ sgrub pa sku gsung thugs byin rlabs las spang bya 'joms pa dang*/ yon tan bskyed cing byin gyis brlob pa tsam gzhan gyis mi byed pas skyes bu byed 'bras so/ /dbang shes dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sbyor/ sgrub chen ni dbang bskur te dri ma bral bar byed pas bral 'bras te/ kun gzhi dang bya grub ye shes sbyor te/ gnas gyur ye shes gnyis gong dang mi mthun pa 'di ni spang bya spong sla rim dang*/ ye shes skye sla rim gyi dbang du byas la/ gong gi ni gnas gyur las thob tshul rgyu 'bras kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /des dang po sbyor ba bstan zin te rgyal mchog gnyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dag pa'i nang du mdor bsdus sbyar ba tsam yin gyi/ blo rno bas rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rtsa bar ni rjes dran gyi smin byed du sbyar ba tsam ma gtogs kho bos logs shin tu ma smos so/ /'on kyang blo brtul ba rnams kyi bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir 'dir brjod par bya'o/ /des na gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog la/ rgyu thig le sgrub pa/ 'bras bu dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ spros te gnas su 'god pa/ byin gyis brlabs shing mchod par byed pa'o/ /dang po ni rjes chags kyi dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas rnams smin mtshams nas bcug ste a wa dhū tī'i lam nas brgyud nas mkha' nang du byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba ste/ 'jug pa'i lam 'di ni bde mchog nyid kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa ste/

sbyang gzhi dbang po gnyis sbyor las thig le 'pho ba/ sbyangs 'bras byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed cing*/ sems can thams cad bde ba chen po la 'god par mdzad/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor mang po sprul par byed pa'o/ /lam gong ma'i smin byed du 'gro tshul ni/ yas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug brtan par byas te/ bde chen lhan skyes kyi dga' ba thob pa ste/ sngags rim dang ye shes kyi rim pa'i phyogs gcig gi smin byed do/ /rgyud sde gzhan gyi bskyed rim la med pa'i don/ smin mtshams nas dhū tī'i lam du 'jug pa'i dgos don gyi gtso bo yang 'di'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkha' nang du gzhal yas khang lha tshogs dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa bskyed pa ste/ 'ga' zhig bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa mi bsgoms par bzhed/ kha cig de mi 'thad de mngal dkyil gyi cha de lus la bstims pa sogs kyi lus dkyil gsal 'debs dgos pa la/ lus dkyil la bsrung 'khor dgos pas so/ / zhes dgongs so/ /spyir nag po pa'i lugs la lus dkyil la bsrung 'khor mdzad pa ni nges par dgos par mngon te/ ji skad du/ go rim bzhin du lus skyes nas/ /rdo rje phur bu lhan cig skyes/ /bcings pa thig skud rab tu ldan/ / shin tu mtshams med brtan par bcings/ /zhes nag po spyod pa chung ngus sdom pa bshad pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung*/ slob dpon 'di'i dgongs pa kho na 'grel pa der gsungs so/ /lus dkyil bskyed chog la ni de ltar dgos pa'i nges pa med pas mngal dkyil la ni/ bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'i nges pa ma mthong ngo*/ /gsum pa ni/ bla ma rnams thams cad cha gnyis su btang nas cha gcig lus dkyil gyi rgyur gtong*/ cha gcig rang mtshungs lus dkyil gyi lha gang na yod pa'i lus kyi cha de nas spro bar mdzad/ yang na cha gcig kho na dang por der reg pas lus dkyil 'grub/

de nas phyir 'god par bzhed/ spyir lus dkyil ni rtsa khams sogs lha de dang der gyur pa tsam zhig bsgom pa yin/ de dag dang yig 'bru sogs las bskyed pa mtha' gcig tu mi dgos mod/ man ngag la de ltar yod pa'i phyir rung ste/ lus dkyil du 'gro ba tsam la de ltar mi dgos kyang byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo khyad par can du 'gro bas rgya 'grel 'khyams po'i khungs tshol ba lhur blangs te byin rlabs chung ngu ma gtong zhig 'dir phyi nang dus gcig tu bskyed pa yin mod/ nang lus dkyil 'og nas 'byung bas 'dir mi brjod do/ /des na 'di la 'byin pa'i lam phyin ci log tu sbyar ba ste/ bha ga nas mi spro bar yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas dhū tī'i nang brgyud thugs kar drangs/ thugs ka sogs so so'i gnas nas spro ba yin no/ /'di rgyud nas phyin ci log tu nges par sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa slob dpon chen po'i gzhung du bskyed rim la sbyor ba'i tshe/ mngal 'byin gyi tshul 'di la sbyor te/ gsang 'dus kyi zab don dang yang thun no/ /'di'i lugs la phyi nang stabs cig gsal 'debs zhes kyang gsung ba mtha' gcig tu ma nges la/ mkha' dkyil gyi lha sa bon las bskyed pa ltar na gong du bshad pa'i byang chub bzhi bskyed tshang la/ dkyus ltar na ye shes gzhugs pa dang dbang bskur ba yi ge dgod pa'i yan lag yin zhing thig ler zhu ba stong nyid byang chub yin pas yan lag gsum tshang ngo*/ /bzhi pa la gnyis kyi dang po byin rlabs ni gsum ste/ skad cig rnam pas pho nya gsum bsre ba dang*/ ye shes pa bstims pa/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab bo/ /dang po ni ye shes sems dpa' ltar spyan drangs te bstims pa'i dmigs pa mi byed par rang gi bsgoms pa de rnams pho nya gzhan gnyis dang dbyer med du nga rgyal byed pa ste/ dper na rang gis bsgoms pa'i lus dkyil gyi spyi bo'i khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma dang phyi dkyil gyi de gnyis ngo bo gcig par mos/

'di ka phyi'i yul pul+li ra ma la ya na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes de gnyis dngos yin la/ 'di gnyis dbyer med 'di ka lhan skyes chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs pa ste/ longs sku'i rang bzhin de gnyis dngos yin no/ /zhes mos pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'o/ / phyag rgya'i dbye ba'i skabs kyi pho nya bzhi po 'dir 'dus te/ de'i rigs skyes/ gnas skyes/ mthar skyes rnams kyang 'di'i zhing skyes su bsdus pa ste/ rang gis bsgoms pa la 'dir gsum bsre'i skabs 'dir sngags skyes su ming 'dogs/ spyi khyab tu bde mchog gi skor las sngags skyes zhes 'byung ba/ gnas skyes dang mthar skyes kyi spyi'i ming yin no/ /de yang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pa'i skabs gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma pho nya gsum char yid yul du byas/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya sogs kyis dbyer med kyi ngo bor mos pa bya/ 'dis zhing gi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis myur du byin gyis brlob ste/ sngags skyes kyi 'du ba ci rigs pa 'phral du thob pa'ang yod/ spyod pa'i skabs su lhan skyes kyi 'du ba thob pa'i rgyur 'gro ste/ rgyud gzhan la med pa'i bskyed rim gyi zab khyad che shos cig go kha cig pho nya gsum du ma zad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma gzhan thams cad bsre dgos pa dang*/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren du 'dus pas zur du mi dgos zer te pho nya gsum po 'dir ma 'dus pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo khyaid kyis tshol shig /ye shes pa bstims pa dang mi 'dra lugs gong du bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa ye shes pa bstim pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang sems spyan 'dren pa ste/ de rnams dam tshig pa'i ngo bor gnas pa dam ye bsre ba dang*/ gsum pa dbang gi rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab ste/ phyogs kyi rim pas rigs bzhi so so'i rgyas gdab pa'am/ bde chen 'khor lo pa la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor ba la mi bskyod pa/

gsung 'khor ba la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor ba la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don grub ste/ phal cher ngo bo nyid kyi rgya'o/ /'di la ye shes pa gzhug pa'i sngon du cho ga 'ching ba dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs mdzad pa'ang 'byung ba ni khungs yod na legs mod/ 'on kyang ma bshad pas ma grub kyang rung ngo*/ /de rnams sbyang gzhi la mngal dkyil spro ba ni/ bu bu mo bskyed pa dang*/ bsre ba ni rigs kyi bya bas bskyed bsring pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang dbang bskur ni gong dang 'dra'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul pa dang 'dra/ khyad par gtum mo zhes sogs kyi don ni/ mkha' nang gi dkyil 'khor yar drangs pas ye shes kyi rim pa'i rjes dran bcu drug gi bde chen dang*/ mkha'i dkyil 'khor nyid lhan skyes las langs pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi gsal snang dang*/ lha rnams phyir spro ba ni rjes dran gyi tshe lhar snang rab 'byams mched pa dang*/ bsre bas rdzogs rim skabs pho nya bzhi'i 'du ba thob pa dang*/ ye shes pa bsre ba ni/ sgyu lus rdo rje gsum mi phyed pa lus sems gnyis snang zlog pa dang*/ dbang bskur ni gong dang 'dra ste smin byed du 'gro tshul lo/ /gnyis pa mchod pa la sngags mchod/ phyi nang gsang ba yid byung bstod pa dang rig ma bcu drug la sogs pa ci rigs pas mchod bstod byed pa ste/ sbyang gzhi sogs bshad zin to/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i sprul sku lam byed dang*/ sku gsum dang shes bya thams cad la dmigs pas rnam mkhyen lam byed 'khor dang bcas te bshad zin to/ /gsum pa

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ las rgyal mchog ni £© kha cig mchod pa man chad 'dir bsdu ba ni gzo lum ste/ bla med kyi skabs mchod pa 'dir bsdu ba phra thig gi rjes su 'byung ba'i gnad kas gsang 'dus 'phags skor tsam ma gtogs gzhan gang la yang med cing dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog tu bsdu ba/ ye shes zhabs lugs/ bshed skor/ kyai rdor/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ mahā ma ya sogs mtha' yas pa zhig na yod cing 'di yang zhabs lugs dang 'dra'o/ /lha rnams de ltar bsgom pa/ mi 'dus pa lta bu'i phal par zhen pa zlog pa'i phyir byang phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa bya ste/ gal te lam la zhen na lam lhar dag pa dran te phar dag tshur dag gi byed par mkhas pa chen po bu ston chos kyi rgyal po yan chad du byon pa'i lam 'di'i skyes chen rnams gsung*/ de yang kun spyod dang mngon spyod las lha so bdun byang phyogs la sbyar skabs so drug rnal 'byor ma so drug la sbyar ba shes rab gtso bo'i dbang du byas pa ste/ lha mo rnams kyi yab lha mo'i dag pas shes dgos shing yang dag ting nge 'dzin yab la sbyar ba dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbang du byas pa ste rdo rje phag mo'ang des shes so/ /'di la chos sku lam byed thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ gzhi shes lam byed ces bya'o/ /sngags bzla ba nas thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i bar yang las rgyal mchog 'di nyid kyi yan lag yin te/ de la bzlas pa/ phra thig /dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu/ thun mtshams kyi lhar langs nas dag pa gsum dran pa'o/ /dang po la bzlas bya'i sngags dang*/ bzla tshul gnyis/ dang po la gtso bo'i sngags ni rin chen bzhi ste/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ go cha ste yab yum dbyer med du byas pa bzhi'o/ khyad par 'di'i lugs la nye ba'i snying po'i snying po ste lnga'o/ /'khor rnams kyi sngags la ni phreng ba'i sngags zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ do li'am/ bod skad khyogs kyi bzlas pa ni/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas zhal nas zhal du 'jug cing*/ gsang ba nas gsang bar yang 'jug cing 'khor bar sgom pa'o/ /bkod pa'i bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar sngags kyi 'khor lo bkod nas klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla ba'o/ /spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ni/ sngags las 'od zer spros don gnyis byas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs bsdus te snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim pa nyid bsgom zhing bzlas pa'o/ khro bo'i bzlas pa ni/ skad gsang drag pos drag tu bzla'o/ /shub bu'i bzlas pa ni/ mchu dang lce rtse mgul tsam gyi sgra chung ngur bzla ba'o/ /rang bzhin gyi bzlas pa ni/ a haṃ gnyis dran pa'i sgo nas bzla ba'o/ /'gog pa'i bzlas pa ni rlung kha sbyor bzung ste/ sngags kyi sgra dang yi ge'i gzugs dran par byas te de nyid bzla ba'o/ /yid bzlas ni/ ngag gi bya ba rlung 'dzin pa tsam yang spangs te/ yid kho nas sngags kyi sgra'am gzugs dran pa'i sgo nas yang yang bzla ba'o/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su mang du bshad mod kyi/ 'di ni bskyed rim gyi rdor bzlas te/ lha rnams kyi gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum bkod nas/ de nyid yang yang dran par byed pa'o/ /de dag gi dmigs pa dang*/ las bzhi so so'i dmigs pa'i khyad par rnams ni sgrub thabs rnams las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa phra thig ni/ skabs 'dir 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bde stong gis rgyas 'debs pa ste/ bla ma gong ma rnams dkyil 'khor phal cher bsdus nas sgom pa mdzad de/ lag len gyi tshe ni de ltar rung ba yin yang*/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ bzlas pa'i gong ngam mjug tu yang rung ste/ dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par bsgom pa nyid yin te/ gtso bor de rnams la bde stong gis rgyas 'debs pa'i ched yin pas so/ /'on kyang las dang po pas mos tsam gyi sgo nas bde stong gis rgyas 'debs pa ni/ gong gsang ba'i mchod pa'i skabs su yod la/

dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bde stong gis rgyas 'debs pa gsal por ma nus na/ gzhan rnams bsdus te rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gnas pa la bde stong gis rgyas 'debs shing*/ de la goms nas phyis dmigs pa'i yul rgya je che la slob pa yin pas bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pa de 'khrul pa ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'od gsal du bcug pas snang ba thams cad stong par rtogs pa'i gnad yod la/ 'dir lus dkyil nye bar bsdu ba dgos pa la/ de ji ltar bya snyam na/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bsdu ba'i rim pa bzhin du nang gi lha rnams gcig la gcig thim pa'i tshul gyis bsdu ba'am/ yang na gnas de rnams nyid du zhu zhing thim par sgom pa gang yang rung bar bya ste/ lus dkyil 'od gsal du bsdu/ /'di yis rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshe 'chi ba 'od gsal ji ma ji bzhin gyi khams thim rim khyad par can rnams 'byung ba dang*/ /rtsa khams de dag byin gyis brlabs pas dbu mar thim sla ba dang*/ bde ba skye sla ba dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas byin rlabs 'phral du 'jug cing*/ phyis 'du ba khyad par can thob pa dang*/ thams cad du bsrung ba mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ thun mtshams kyi skabs su lha'i snang ba dang mi 'bral zhing go cha dgod pas bar chad mi 'jug pa dang*/ dag pa gsum dran pas sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la gnas pa dang*/ gang snang thams cad lha'i rnal rol du myur du shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa don dngos bstan rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dag pa sbyar ba ni/ ma rigs sogs te/ de la ma rig pa ni phung po la bdag dang bdag gir blta ba ste/ phyin ci log bzhi'i lta ba dang bcas pa ste/ mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar 'dzin pa dang*/ sdug bsngal la bde bar dang*/ mi rtag pa la rtag pa dang*/ bdag med la bdag tu 'dzin pa ni phyin ci log bzhi'o/ /de las 'du byed las 'byung ba ni/

'dod khams kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba bsod nams dang*/ mi dge ba'i las bsod nams ma yin pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i las te khams gong mar 'phen byed kyi las sgom byung gi dge ba rnams dang*/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi bsdus pa'i dge ba rnams so/ /de yang sngar gyi ma rig pa des kun nas bslangs pa'o/ /lung ma bstan dang zag med kyi dge ba ni 'di'i 'du byed du mi yong ngo*/ /las de'i bag chags bgos pa'i rnam shes skye ba len mkhan ni rnam shes/ rnam shes des skye ba blangs ma thag pa skye mched drug ma dod gong nur nur po sogs ming dang gzugs so/ /de yang tshor ba sogs phung po bzhi la med/ gzugs ni gzugs phung ngo*/ /ming sogs skye mched drug byung nas yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus nas spyod mi nus tshud chad ni skye mched drug gi skabs so/ /de ltar gsum 'dus pa na/ reg pa drug po 'byung ste/ yul sim gdung bar ma'i rgyu mi shes pa tshun chad reg pa'o/ /de shes nas tshor ba 'jog ste reg pa las byung ba tshor ba la spyod nus pa'i skabs yin pas so/ /tshor ba las bde sdug la thob 'dod spang blang 'dod pa'i sred pa 'byung*/ de byung ba na blang dor lag len du rtsom pa'i len pa 'byung ste/ 'khrig pa spyod nus kyang mi 'khrig bar du tshor ba/ 'khrig 'dod kyi sred kyang yul mi tshol bar du sred pa/ yul la yongs su rgyug pa na nye bar len pa'o/ /srid pa ni las kyi bag chags gsos btab ste nus pa mthu can du song ba ste/ skye ba phyi mar bde sdug gi 'bras bu 'byung ba'i las gtso bor gsog pa nas srid pa'o// srid pa de las phyi ma'i skye ba 'byung ba ni skye ba ste/ shi nas nying mtshams sbyor ba'i skabs so/ /phyi ma'i ming gzugs nas tshor ba'i bar sogs 'di'i rga shi'o/ /mngal skyes kyi skye ba'i dbang du byas pa'i tshar gcig go /'dir de tsam gyi dbang du byas pa ste/

ma rig pa dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam shes gsum nā da ma zhugs gong gi sbyang gzhi dang*/ ming gzugs dang skye mched drug gi cha shas shig 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bskyed chog dang bcas pas sbyong ba dang*/ skye mched drug gi cha cig /'dir go cha zhes pa ni mtshon byed tsam ste/ rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa yang bsdu bas de gnyis kyis sbyong zhing*/ reg pa ni gnas lnga byin gyis brlob pas dang*/ sogs kyi sgras tshor ba ye shes gzhug pas sbyong zhing sred pa ni dbang bskur ba dang*/ len pa ni mchod pa rjes chags dang bcas pas te/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi srid pa dang*/ las rgyal mchog dang nyer bsdus ni skye ba dang*/ thun mtshams kyi lha yan lag dang bcas pas ni rga shi sbyong ba ste/ de ltar rten 'brel bcu gnyis sbyong ba'o/ /'phros don la rig pa rnam pa bzhi zhes bya ba ni/ rgyud dang*/ gleng gzhi dang*/ nges tshig dang rgyu'o/ /chags bral gyi tshul la/ mir skyes pa ni rgyud/ rab tu byung ba ni gleng gzhi/ tshul khrims la gnas shing thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa ni nges tshig /'bras bu 'dod pas spang bya gnyis kyi gnyen po rgyud la bskyed pa ni rgyu ste/ byang chub thob pa la de ltar dgos so/ /de rnams bskyed rim la sbyar na 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs shing go cha dgod pa ni rgyud/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni gleng gzhi/ ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs ni nges tshig /dbang bskur ba sogs ni rgyu'o/ /sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ mi ru skyes pa 'bras bu'i dam pa dang po ste/ /rang gi khyim nas nges 'byung rnyed pa gnyis pa yin/ /rab tu byung nas dge ba sgrub pa gsum pa ste/ /rtse gcig yid ni rnyed pas bzhi pa dag tu gsungs/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ sgron gsal las kyang 'di dang 'dra bar gsungs so/ /de yang 'dod chags bral tshul gyis rig pa bzhi po 'di ni/ sngags kyi lugs la sprul pa tsam ma gtogs dngos gnas ma yin mod/

sprul pa'i mdzad pa bzhi po de dang mthun par bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu lam byed do/ /de nyid dper byas nas 'dod chags chos kyi tshul bzhi ni/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa bskyed rim dang de'i phyogs su mthun pa'i lus dben la sogs pa'i lha sku bsgoms pas rigs kyi nus pa sad pa ni rgyud/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor gyi rnam pa ro gcig tu gyur pa ste rlung sems kyi sku grub pa ni gleng gzhi/ rigs lnga'i grangs nges yi sdom pa thams cad mngon du gyur pa ni 'od gsal dang zung 'jug ste nges tshig /sgeg pa la sogs pa 'dod chags chen po'i spyod pa spyod pa ni rgyu ste ji skad du/ sgron gsal las/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bskyed pa ni/ /rgyud ces bya ba yin par brjod/ /slar yang rigs gcig gyur pa ni/ /gleng gzhi yin par rab tu bstan/ /rdo rje la sogs bzung ba nyid/ /nges pa'i tshig ni yin par bshad/ /sgeg pa la sogs spyod pa ni/ /rgyu zhes bya ba yin par bshad/ /ces so/ /de la nā da dang rgyu rdor 'dzin dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas tha dad par dmigs pa'i skabs ni rgyud/ byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig tu zhu ba dang bzhengs pa ni gleng gzhi/ skye mched byin rlabs nas dbang bskur ba'i bar ni nges tshig /mchod pa dang rjes chags kyi mdzad pa ni rgyu'o/ /de la rgyud ces bya ba ni gzhi dang rnam pa mthun pa'i rgyu ni sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu 'phral du 'grub nges pa zhig gi ming yin la/ gleng gzhi ni nges pa ster ba'i don/ nges tshig ni nges par spyod dgos pa/ rgyu ni 'bras bu la nye bar sbyor ba'i nye rgyu'o/ /chags tshul gyi rig pa bzhi dngos ni/ mdo lugs kyi lam thams cad rdzogs par sngon du song nas/ sngags la zhugs te sangs rgyas tshul yin la/ phyogs mthun 'dod chags chen po'i tshul gyi lam thams cad la yod pa dang*/ de las kyang phal cher rdzogs rim du snang bas lam gong ma'i smin byed du 'gro tshul lo/

/de yang rten 'brel bcu gnyis la legs par sbyar bas/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi skye ba dang rnam pa mthun par ni sgom pa snang mod kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon du byed pa'i skye ba dang rnam pa mthun pa med do snyam pa'i dogs pa spong ba'i phy-ir 'di rnams brjod pa yin pas/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi zhar byung ngo*/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag ni/ mdo lugs kyi gzhung rgyas pa rnams las shes par bya zhing*/ theg pa 'di nyid du yang gshin rje gshed dmar po dang mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la sogs par rgyas par gsungs pas de dag tu shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa snang stong bde ba sgrub tshul la £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ gsum/ £© bskyed rim gyi bar bar du bde stong gi rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ khyad par bskyed rim gyi lha sku nyid la bde stong gis rgyas 'debs pa/ phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mngon byang bzhi pa'i skabs nyi zla sa bon 'dres pa dang*/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum mnyam sbyor gyis zhu ba dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs nas rjes chags mdzad pa dang*/ mngal du dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i don du zhu bde lhan skyes bsgoms pa dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyi dus su bde ba gtso che zhing*/ ye shes tshogs gsog pa dang*/ nyer bsdu'i skabs su stong pa'i rgyas 'debs gtso che'o/ /gnyis pa phra thig gi rnal 'byor la/ bskyed rim gyi ye shes/ de'i byed las so/ /dang po ni/ phra thig sogs te/ 'khor lo sdom pa 'dir/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di yi mtshan ma khyim du ni/ /rdo rje lta bu'i me long bcas/ /zhes sogs gsang ba'i sna rtser bsgom pa'i thig le dang*/ mngon brjod la sogs pa'i bshad rgyud rnams las phra thig mtha' yas pa zhig bshad mod gyi/ 'dir gtso bor gtum mo gnyis te de gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gyis lha sku la rgyas btab pas/

lha skur snang ba de yang bde stong gi ngo bor lam gyis shar ba na/ de nyid la nan tan du bsgoms pas rlung rnams dhū tīr thim pas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs par gtogs pa'i bde ba skye zhing*/ de dang lha sku gnyis ched gtad kyi rgyas btab mi dgos par lhan cig tu 'char zhing*/ rnam rtog gi bar mi chod pa na dran pa gcig pa la gnas pa zhes bya/ de nyid bsrings te bsgoms pas reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed pa'i tshe rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'o/ /de la gtum mo gnyis ni mi dmigs kyi gtum mo dang*/ phyag rgya'i gtum mo'o/ /dang po ni 'dir gtso bor dpyid thig yin la/ gnyis pa yang gsang ba'i thig le gtso che bar mngon/ de yang rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis thig le 'ching nus pas ni gnyis ka bsgoms pas bde stong gis rgyas 'debs la gcig tu 'bad par bya zhing*/ de ltar mi nus pas rnal 'byor lam la brten pa 'ba' zhig bsgom mo/ /phra thig zhes bya ba/ ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba mang na yang*/ phra mo rlung gi rnal 'byor dang*/ thig le thig le'i gzugs sam dbab ldog gi rnal 'byor la ngos 'dzin pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni bde stong sogs te/ lhar snang dang nga rgyal zhu bdes byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam pa ma 'gags pa la ngo bo spros pa'i rnam pa dang bral ba'i ye shes so/ kha cig lha'i nga rgyal shugs drag bskyed na/ bdag 'dzin gsos 'debs par 'gyur bas/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por snang tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan rnam rtog gtan nas med par sgom zhes zer ro/ /de dag ni rnam rtog lam byed kyi gdams ngag gi gnad ma longs pa ste/ de ltar gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal bsgoms pas kyang gti mug gsos 'debs dang*/ phyag rgya bsten pas kyang 'dod chags gsos btab pas grol ba la sgrib par 'gyur ro/ /de dag thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis yin no zhai na/ 'di yang de ltar te/ rdo rje gur las kyang*/

sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /ces gsungs shing*/ de ni phra ba'i bdag tsam la dgongs pa yin te/ gzhan du bdag 'dzin bsgoms pas bdag med rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur na rgyu 'bras phyin ci log tu 'gyur bas so snyam du mi bsam ste/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi don rnams ni/ mi 'tsham par ni snang yang nyi ma'i dpes/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don byed nus pas na/ /rnal 'byor 'gas ni the tshom ma byed cig/ces 'jam dpal zhal lung las gsungs pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ rnam rtog nyid kyi rnam rtog dang*/ /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa dag/ces rnam rtog gi khyad par 'ga' zhig gis rnam rtog dang*/ 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags 'dag pa la sogs pa yod na nga rgyal kho nas ci zhig nyes/ gsum pa ni/ tha mal snang zhen sogs te/ gzhan rnams gong du brjod zin la/ phra rags rim pa zhes bya ba ni/ rags pa bskyed rim gyi lha sku yan lag bdun ldan dang*/ phra ba rdzogs rim gyi rtogs par na 'phos pa'i lha'i gsal snang ste/ yan lag bdun ldan zhes bya ba ni/ 'dir dngos ni ma yin mod/ rnam pa mthun pa tsam lam du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa lus dkyil sgom pa'i rim pa la/ gzhung gi don dang*/ 'phros don cung zad mtha' dpyad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las mdor bstan ni khyad par sogs so/ /thun mong ma yin pa zhes pa ni/ man ngag las ni gzhan la'ang 'byung ba srid mod kyi/ rgyud gzhan gyi dngos bstan du ni phra mo rtsa khams kyi lus dkyil 'di lta bu rgyud sde gzhan rnams las mi 'byung bas so/ /rgyas bshad ni snying gar sogs te/ snying ga'i dpyid dpa' bo yab he ru ka dang lte ba'i gtum mo dang dhū tī sogs rtsa bzhi rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur pa lte ba nas snying gar bsgoms pas/ rdzogs rim gyi tshe snying gar dpyid thig 'du 'phrod byung ste thugs kyi sgo gnyis 'byed pa'i smin byed du 'gyur ba dang*/

yum bzhi snying ga'i phyogs bzhi'i rtsa/ gsum skor ma sogs yongs su gyur par bsgoms te/ snying ga'i 'khor lor bkod pas/ snying ga'i phyogs bzhi'i rtsa nas 'byung bzhi'i rlung*/ rlung thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog skyed par byed pa de nang du 'dus pas/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skyed par byed pa'i gzhi 'dings pa'o/ /mtshams kyi mchod pa'i rtsa rnams thod pa bzhir bsgoms shing byin gyis brlabs pas/ 'byung ba'i khams bzhi'i tshogs thams cad dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems su dag pa'i rgyur 'gyur snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa rnams bu ga brgyad la yan lag gi rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i tshul du 'brel ba yin pas/ de rnams khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i ma mo brgyad du bsgoms shing gnas der bkod pas/ bu ga brgyad du rgyu ba yan lag gi rlung rnams 'dus pas dbang shes drug bde ba chen por shar ba'i stobs kyis drangs pa lkog gyur gyi yul drug shes pa'i mngon shes dang*/ bde ba thob pa'i rgyu ste da lta 'dzag gegs mi 'byung zhing phyis phyag rgya bsten pa na/ thig le 'dzag med du 'ching ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /spyi bo la sogs pa'i rlung 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad la thugs 'khor ba/ mtshan khung sogs khrag 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad la gsung 'khor ba/ mtshan ma sogs khu ba 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad la sku 'khor ba ste/ mi phyed ma sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa rnams lhar gyur te/ gnas de dang de la bkod pas rlung 'pho ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ thig le 'pho ba bcu drug dbu mar thim zhing 'gags te/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga pa khyab byed kyi rlung yang thim pa'i rgyu byed do/ /don bsdu ni/ gdod ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'di bsgoms pas rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rlung dang thig le de dag thim par 'gyur ba'i smin byed mchog yin te/ de yang rdzogs pa'i sogs kyis bstan no/

/mchog ces bya ba ni smin byed tsam ni phyi dkyil gyis kyang 'grub mod kyi/ de bas ches rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa skyai ba la myur bas na'o/ /lus dkyil 'dir bsgoms pas kyang*/ rlung de dag ci rigs zlog pas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa dang phyogs mthun pa'i bde stong gi ye shes skye zhing*/ thog mar rlung gang zlog pa'i nges pa ni med de/ dgos su sems bzung na gang zin pa de nyid nas zlog pa yin no/ /rdzogs rim gyi tshe spyir rang rang gi las kyi mthu dang*/ las 'phro'i khyad par gyi go rim ni ma nges par 'byung ba shas che la/ dgos kyi dmigs pa bsgoms na phal cher de dang de thog mar ldog mod/ spyi khyab tu thog mar sgo brgyad kyi rlung ldog ste sku'i sgo dgu 'gag go /de nas smin mtshams dang lte ba nas/ de nas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rlung rnams dang*/ de nas snying ga'i phyogs mtshams rnams ldog ste gsung gi sgo bzhi 'byed/ mthar snying gar 'dus te thugs kyi sgo gnyis 'byed/ de nas rim gyis snying ga'i thig le la rlung rnams thim par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la/ lus dkyil gyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ gzhan gyis btags pa'i mtha' dgag pa/ rgyud gzhung gi dgongs pa rnam par dbye ba'i 'jug sgo tsam bstan pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ yul chen sogs gyi dgongs pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus la bkod pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor te/ 'on kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i lus dkyil du 'gyur ba la ni/ lus de dang de'i lhar bsgoms pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ thun mong ba lus la bkod pa tsam gyi lus dkyil ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud du snying ga'i bdag 'jug gi don du dkyil 'khor snying gar 'god pa lta bu dang*/ dngos gnas la med kyang kun brtags gtso che ba rags pa phung khams kyi lus dkyil gsang 'dus 'phags skor la yod pa lta bu dang*/ dngos gnas la zhugs pa gtso che ba phra mo rtsa khams kyilus dkyil/

'khor lo bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs de gsum mo/ /phyi ma la yang*/ phyi dkyil dang sbrags te sgom pa lū nag lta bu dang*/ lus dkyil 'ba' zhig sgom pa dril bu lus dkyil lta bu'o/ /rgyud gzhan gyi man ngag la lus dkyil yod pa rnams kyi rten so'i rgyud kyi tshig rnams kyi tshig don ni/ lus dkyil mi ston pa sha stag ste/ gsang 'dus su/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes sogs dang*/ kyai rdor gyi yang*/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes pa la sogs pa lha so so'i dag pa ston pa tsam du snang zhing*/ gdan bzhi'i lus dkyil ni thun mong pa lus la bkod pa tsam yin la/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i lus dkyil yang man ngag yin gyi rgyud kyi dngos bstan la med do/ /des na bde mchog gi dgongs pa rgyud sde gzhan la sbyar ba'i man ngag go /'o na gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar zhe na/ phung sogs rags pa'i lha lus la bkod pa tsam zhig la/ de'i dag pa mdzad pa tsam ste/ des ni bde mchog pa'i lugs la zab mo lus dkyil gyi go mi chod la/ der 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa rnams la lus dkyil gsungs so snyam na/ spyir ni de dag byin gyis brlob pa'i lha tsam zhig ma gtogs lus dkyil rang du mi gsal mod/ lus dkyil yin du chug kyang*/ der rtsa dang bde chen sgrub tshul mang po zhig bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dgongs pa bshad cing*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud bsdus pa 'di'i yang le'u gnyis kyi tshig rnams phal cher drangs so/ /gsang 'dus rang rkang du lus dkyil med pas/ 'dus pa'i dgongs par rdzogs par 'grel pa ye shes zhabs lugs sogs la yang med de/ rgyud sde gzhan kyai rdor sogs la'ang 'dra'o/ / spyir gsang 'dus lus dkyil de bde mchog lū yi pa'i phung khams byin rlabs rgyas pa dang*/

bskyed tshul la khyad par cung zad kyang med de/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor du byas ma byas kyi lus dkyil yin min tsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ kha cig mngon brjod le'u dgu pa'i dpa' gcig gi dkyil 'khor de phyi dkyil med pa'i lus dkyil yin zhes dam bca' skam po gcig mdzad la/ de sgrub byed du byas pa thams cad sgrub byed bsgrub bya dang ma mtshungs pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i gtso bo'i sku la lus dkyil bkod pa dang*/ phyi dkyil lha bcu gsum ma'am/ lha lnga'am/ dpa' bo gcig pa rnams phyi dkyil rgyas bsdus yin pa'i phyir/ phyi dkyil med pa ma yin zhing*/ dpa' bo gcig pa zhes pa'i tshig gis kyang lus dkyil rkyang pa yin par 'dod pa bkag ste/ lus dkyil la ltos nas dpa' bo gcig pa yin pa dang*/ lha tshogs drug cu yod pa dngos su 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir/ des na dpa' bo gcig pa zhes phyi dkyil la ltos pa'i dpa' bo gcig go /phyi dkyil gyi dpa' gcig yin kyang*/ des phyi dkyil du mi 'gro na ni/ phyi dkyil lha lnga sogs kyis kyang go mi chod dgos te khyad par dbyer med pa'i phyir ro// mthar lus dkyil yod na lus dky-il rkyang pa yin par khas blangs par song bas rang gi dbye ba byas pa dang 'gal lo/ / yang 'di skad ces lū nag gi gzhung*/ 'khrul spong*/ mi thub zla ba/ rgyud mngon brjod rnams las lus dkyil gyi rten gyi dkyil 'khor ma bshad/ lū yi pa'i 'grel pa/ sdom 'byung nas gzhal yas khang sam+pu ṭi bzhin 'byung*/ 'di ni dgos te/ gsang 'dus la yod pas te/ de dag thams cad du 'dra bas so/ /sngon la gzhal yas khang gcig bsgom dgos shing*/ gzhal yas khang snga ma de bsdus nas bskyed pa ma yin te/ mdo bsre las/ sngar bskyed pa'i gzhal yas khang na gnas par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /snga ma'i nang du gsar pa cig bsgom pa'ang min/

bod kha cig lus kyi cha re re gzhal yas khang gi char mos pa byed pa tsam rgyud dang mkhas grub mi bzhed de/ rdo rje phreng bar/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /zhes pas gyur par sgom pa ma gtogs dod du sgom par ma bshad/ rnam gzhag rim par/ tshangs pa'i thig nas yang dag brtsams/ /gru bzhi par ni rab tu dbye/ /gzhal yas khang ltar snang ba yi/ rnal 'byor pa yi sku dkyil 'khor/ /zhes lus dkyil khang pa gru bzhir bsgom par bshad pas so/ kha cig gdod ma nas grub pa gsal 'debs par 'dod de/ de lta na lus can rnams 'bad med du grol bar 'gyur/ lus dkyil yin na grub bzhi lus las byed dgos/ zhes dang*/ de'i rjes 'brang kha cig brten pa lha zhal phyag can du bsgoms nas/ rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam par mi bsgom pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing*/ de med na lha la bzhugs sa med par 'gro zer la/ gong gi 'phros la lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum du bsgom pa lū nag lta bu la dgos/ dril bu pa lta bu nang dkyil rkyang pa la mi dgos zhes dang*/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang la nang ma bsres phan chad phyi dkyil/ nang gi cha shas bsres nas nang dkyil te/ dper na 'og gzhi rlung la rkang mthil gyi cha bsres nas de'i nga rgyal yang dgos zhes sogs dang dgos su dril bu lugs la mi 'dra ba mang ste re zhig bzhag go /de ltar gsung pa ni yang dag ma yin pa kho na ste/ lū yi pa'i 'grel pa gcig kho na la yod pas yod pa'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro na/ rgyud gzhung thams cad las ma bshad pas ma byas kyang rung ba'i rgyu mtshan du ci'i phyir mi 'gro/ gsang 'dus lus dkyil skabs phyi'i gzhal yas khang yod pas 'dir yang dgos na/ 'di la rtsa khams kyi lus dkyil yod pas/ gsang 'dus la yang dgos par 'gyur te/ thams cad du 'dra bar khyed nyid kyi khas blangs pas so/ /phyi dkyil dang 'brel ba yin na/ sdud mi dgos par kho bo cag kyang 'dod/

/gzhal yas khang gi nang du lus dkyil gzhal yas khang gnyis pa gcig bre nang du bre bcug pa ltar su yang mi 'dod do/ /rgyud dang mkhas grub mi bzhed de gsang 'dus rdor phreng nas ma bshad pas so/ /zhes gsung pa 'di las khyab mtha' rtsing ba ci yod/ kho bo cag kyang gzhal yas khang gi rnam par mi bsgom mod/ de'i dod du gsal mi 'debs te/ de rang dngos yin pa'i mos pa byed do/ /gyur pa'i go ba'ang bdag nyid sangs rgyas dngos su gyur pa yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal byed pa dang 'dra ste/ de la rnam pa gsal 'debs dgos pas ma khyab pa bzhin no/ /rnam gzhag rim par lus dkyil skabs su gru bzhi zhes gsungs pas/ dmigs pa la khang bzang gru bzhi bsgom dgos na/ tshangs pa'i thig nas zhes gsungs pas/ lus dkyil sgom dus dmigs pas thig 'debs dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gdod ma nas grub pa sogs skyon yin na rang bzhin gyis grub ces pa'ang skyon du 'gro ste/ gdod ma dang rang bzhin ming 'dogs tsam ma gtogs 'dra bas/ 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /zhes grub chen dril bu pa'i gsung de la thog mar dgag pa gyis shig khyed ltar na sgrub gzhi rtsa khams gdod nas grub zer bar 'dug pas/ da lta'i rtsa khams rnams 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas grub par khas blangs pas lus rtag pa'am/ sngar nas lus grub zin zin pa yin par 'gyur bas/ da res skye ba ma blangs par thal ba min nam/ grub mtha' ngan pa skyong ba'i phyir/ /ltag brjod lhur len byed pa la/ /nor pa brgyud mar 'byung ba ni/ /dngos po'i chos nyid ces bya'o/ kho bo cag ni rtsa khams sogs de dag 'bras bu'i dkyil 'khor rigs kyi khyad chos su gdod nas grub ces 'jogalus dkyil yin na sgrub gzhi lus la byed dgos zhes pa ni/ ming gzhi'i phung po rigs bzhi'i sgrub gzhir byed pa gsang 'dus lus dkyil te/

lus dkyil zab mo yin par 'dod pa dang nang 'gal lo/ /lha zhal phyag can sogs la lan ni spyir lha bsgoms la gzhal yas khang mi bsgoms pa'i bskyed rim ji snyed yod de mahā ma ya'i sgrub thabs ku ku ri pas mdzad pa lta bu dang*/ kyai rdor gyi he ru ka gsum las gzhal yas khang mi mdzad pa shin tu mang ba'i phyir/ khyed gong gi de'i khyad par mi 'thad par sems na phyi dkyil la gzhal yas khang med kyang chog lus dkyil la dgos par nges pa'i khyad par de bas kyang mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ lus dkyil la mos pa tsam gyi sgo nas kyang gzhal yang khang med pas chog pa rung na mos pa yod na ci'i phyir mi chog gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa ma bsgoms pas bzhugs sa med par 'gro na/ nyid kyi rang lugs la/ dril bu'i 'khor lo gsum gyi lha la'ang bzhugs sa med par 'gyur la/ de la bzhugs sa med pa rung na gzhan la'ang ci'i phyir mi rung*/ spyir rang lus kyi snang ba'i cha shas gzhal yas khang la bsre ba la khungs shig yod na rung ba srid de de la khungs mi snang*/ gzhal yas khang la rang lus kyi nga rgyal byas pas lus dkyil du 'gyur na/ rang he ru kar gsal bas spros pa'i 'khor gyi lha kun yang der thal te/ gzhi rang lugs kyi cha shas las byung zhing*/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sku gsung thugs dbyer med pa'i nga rgyal yod pa'i phyir ro// yang skad cig gis bskyed pa dril bu pa'i gzhung dngos na yod pa dbang po rab kyi lam yin zhes pa'i dbang po rno brtul yang lam yun ring du bsgoms ma bsgoms yin te/ sdom 'byung las dbang brtul rim bskyed dang*/ dbang rnon skad cig gis bskyed par gsungs pa yang gang zag gi blo sbyangs ma sbyangs la bshad pas so/ /zhes pa yang*/ de ni dbang brtul bskyed rim skabs/ dbang rnon rdzogs rim skabs su bshad pa spyi khyab 'di yin gyi/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi gzhi lus skad cig gis bskyed pa la gnod byed ma yin no/

/'di ni 'di rang gi skye shi bar do sbyong byed sogs zhib mo ma rig par gzhan gyis rgyas bkab pa ste/ khyed lta na dril bu lus dkyil la gzhan la med pa'i khyad par mang po yod zer skad byas kyang 'di mi zab par 'gyur te/ 'khor tshogs ma bskyed pa tsam gyis zab tu 'gro na ma gtogs lū yi pa las thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad gcig kyang 'don rgyu mi 'dug pas so/ /yang gzhan dag sems kho na dkyil 'khor du bskyed kyi lus ma yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ shin tu 'khyams pa ste/ rgyu mtshan dkyil 'khor 'bras dus kyi de sems las byung ba'i phyir zhes sogs gsungs te/ de lta na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yang lhar bskyed mi rigs par 'gyur te rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ de sems su shes par byas pas skyon med do snyam na/ lus las sgrub pa na yang de sems su shes pas skyon ci yod/ sgrub gzhi lus bzhi pa lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i don te bskyed gzhi de'o/ /nyid ltar na sems lus dkyil du bsgoms nas lus lhag mar 'jog gam ci/ bshad pa'i tshe yin gyi bsgom pa'i tshe lus kyang bsgoms na/ sgom don la mi 'dra ba med pas dgag sgrub mi dgos mod/ bshad pa dang nyams len phyin ci log na mi legs so/ /slob dpon dril bu pas rang bzhin shes gsungs pa nges don la dgos pa ma yin gyi kun rdzob tu me'i rang bzhin tsha ba/ bu ram gyi rang bzhin ro mngar zhes pa lta bu'o/ kho bo cag 'dir brgal brtag lhur len pa ma yin gyi/ lus dkyil gyi log rtog 'di rnams dgag bya che bar 'dug pas brgal brtag gi sgo phyogs tsam zur smos byas pa'o/ /rgyas par gzhan du brjod du rung ngo*/ /de tsam gyi bod phyi ma dang*/ sngar rabs pa'i lugs yin zer ba phyis byon gyis rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi khas len gyi gnad rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa la/ rgyud las 'byung tshul dang*/

de'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma yi sa dang gnas/ /he ru ka dpal sku'i yan lag /thams cad brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid can/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /zhes sogs dang*/ mtho ris sa steng sa 'og tu/ /dpa' bo'i yan lag brtan g.yo'i bdag /bu la sogs pa gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don mngon brjod las lus dkyil mang du gsungs shing*/ kun spyod la sogs pa bshad rgyud gzhan rnams las kyang rtsa khams kyi dag pa sogs la 'phros nas lus dkyil zur smos tsam mang du byung ngo*/ /de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel pa lha mang nyung gi khyad par mang po dang*/ bskyed tshul yang sa bon las bskyed pa dang*/ sngags las bskyed pa dang*/ skad cig gis bskyed pa sogs mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ dus skabs kyang lus dkyil thog mar sgom pa mi thub zla bas mdzad pa lta bur nyer sgrub kyi skabs su go cha chen po sgom pa dang*/ phyi dkyil gyi rjes su gsal 'debs pa lū yi pa lta bu dang*/ phal cher dus mnyam du gsal 'debs pa nag po lugs lta bu dang*/ lus dkyil kho na la mngon rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ sngon 'gro bsdus te stong pa cung zad bsgom pas 'chi ba chos sku lam byed/ gzhi lus kyi bar do longs sku dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sprul sku lam byed lus dkyil gyi skye ba sprul sku dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i longs sku lam byed/ chos sku lam byed byang phyogs kyi dag dran dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi yan lag lhag ma rnams kyang byed pa dril bu lus dkyil lta bu dang*/ phyi dkyil yang rgyas bsdus sna tshogs la brten pa ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lus dkyil rnams dang*/ thun mong gi lus dkyil yang ci rigs par 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa la/ lus dkyil gang la 'god pa'i gzhi/ gzhi de la 'god pa'i lha/ gnas gang du 'god cing bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni thams cad mtha' gcig tu nges pa dka' yang*/

lū dril nag gsum sogs da lta 'dug pa'i yab bka' rnams la gtso bo dang*/ yum bka' rnams la gtso mo'i sku ste/ gal te sgrub pa po phyag rgya dang lhan cig bskyed rim bsgoms pa yin na/ gnyis ka'i lus dkyil gnyis kas bsgom dgos pas yab yum gnyis char la 'god pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha cig nges par lha drug cu rtsa gnyis 'god par 'dod kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi'am dpa' mo nyer bzhi'am/ dpa' bo dpa' mo zhe brgyad 'god pa sogs sna tshogs snang bas so/ /'on kyang lū dril nag gsum la drug cu rtsa gnyis kar 'god dgos par snang ngo*/ /gsum pa la ma mo bcu gnyis kyi 'god sa dang*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi 'god sa/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha zhe brgyad gnas dang bcas pa sgom tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mngon brjod le'u dgu par/ ma mo bcu gnyis phyag bcu gnyis dang*/ thod pa bzhi zhal bzhi la 'god pa zhig gsungs/ 'ga' zhig snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba la 'god par mdzad pa yang yod/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad sgo brgyad la 'god par mdzad pa'i sgo brgyad kyang kha dang*/ lte ba dang*/ mtshan ma dang*/ bshang lam dang*/ smin mtshams dang*/ rna ba dang*/ mig dang*/ sna rnams la khwa gdong ma sogs rim pas 'god pa yang yod/ lū yi pa'i lugs sna tshogs pa rnams la de dag ci rigs pa byung ngo*/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi snying ga'i phyogs kyi rtsa la 'god pa dang*/ mtshams kyi rtsa la 'god pa gnyis dril bu lugs la'ang gdam nga can du snang zhing*/ snod bzhi yang de'i rigs pas shes so/ /sgo mtshams ma brgyad snying ga'i phyi sgor dngos la 'god pa dril bu lugs dang*/ rtsa de dang rgyud gcig pa sna bug gnyis gcig tu bgrangs pa'i bu ga brgyad la 'god pa nag po zhabs lugs te/ slob dpon nyid kyis/ rtsa'i sgor ni khwa gdong ma/ /zhes sogs dpyid thig las gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/
