rgyud gzhung rnams su gtso bo yab yum mi 'god pa dang*/ 'god kyang de'i gnas kyi gsal kha med pa mang du byung zhing*/ de'i phyir pra dzñā rak+ṣi tas kyang man ngag las shes dgos par gsungs te/ 'ga' zhig spyi bo'i haṃ gi gnas su yab dang*/ gsang gnas su phag mo sgom pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig snying gar yab dang*/ lte bar yang yum sgom pa bzhed pa'ang yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni dpyid dang phag mo zhal sbyor ba'i tshul yin pas yab yum gnyis snying ga chos 'khor gyi lte bar zhal sbyor du sgom pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ nyi shu rtsa bzhir dbye ba yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /gnas rnams dag ni thams cad du/ /rtsa rnams kun ni yang dag bshad/ /yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang*/ /rtsa'i gzugs kyi gnas pa'o/ /zhes rnal 'byor ma rnams rtsa'i rang bzhin du bshad cing*/ kun spyod dang*/ mngon brjod du/ so dang sen mo la ni thod pa'i dum bu'o/ /zhes sogs yab rnams la khams kyi dag pa bstan pas yum rnams de dag 'bab pa'i rten gyi rtsa yin par shes shing*/ khams de dag 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams gang yin pa de/ sam+pu ṭi/ sdom 'byung sogs su mi phyed ma la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams yin par bshad pas rtsa khams de rnams lha zhe brgyad du bskyed pa'i phyir/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su 'god par thun mong ma yin pa'i lus dkyil phal cher mthun no/ /mngon brjod nas rtsa 'khor la 'god pa sogs kyang bshad pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /bskyed tshul ni gnas nyer bzhi po yang 'khor lo gsum gyi rtsibs kyi rnam par bsgoms pa dang*/ gnas de la sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams dang yul nyer bzhir mos pa byed pa tsam ste lugs gnyis dang*/ sa bon las bskyed pa dang*/ mi bskyed pa'i lugs gnyis yod cing*/ lha bskyed pa yang mngon brjod las sa bon las bskyed par yang bshad cing*/

rgya gzhung mang por gnas kyi sa bon dang*/ lha so so'i mtshan sngags phyogs gcig tu zhu ba las/ lha dang gnas gnyis kar bskyed pa'ang yod/ thams cad skad cig gis bskyed pa'ang yod mod/ re zhig lū dril nag gsum la ni/ pu dza la sogs pa gnas kyi sa bon las so so'i rten brten pa thun mong du bskyed pa yin no/ /lnga pa la gzhung don gyi skabs su bshad pa'i rlung 'du tshul rnams te/ da lta ni gnas der sems yang yang gtad pas/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshe rlung sems 'phral du thim par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can byed cing*/ khyad par 'khor lo gsum gyi lus dkyil gyis ni khyab byed kyi rlung las su rung bas byang chub kyi sems lus thams cad la khyab par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'khor lo'i bzhi sogs dga' ba 'char ba'i gnas rnams su lha bskyed pas rtsa mdud grol sla zhing*/ rlung thim pas bde ba yun ring ba dang*/ lhas byin gyis brlabs pas ye shes khyad par can skye ba yin no/ /gtso bo yab yum bkod pas dpyid thig gi 'bar 'dzag khyad par can 'byung zhing*/ mthar rlung thim pa dang thig le 'dzag med kyi nus pas lcags la rtsis reg pa bzhin du ma dag pa'i lus zad nas/ 'ja' lus kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i brgyud pa'i rgyu khyad par can no/ /sems bzung bas rtsa rlung thig le gsum shin tu dul bar 'gyur bar ma zad/ rtsa rlung thig le la lha rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pas thun mong dang mchog gi nus mthu rnams ches bla lhag tu 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor la yul nyer bzhi na sprul pa'i sku ma bsdus par bzhugs pa'i dbang po dang rnal 'byor ma rnams su mos pa byas shing*/ spyan 'dren mchod pa sems 'dzin gyi ting nge 'dzin sogs bsgoms pa dang*/ zas kham gcig zos pa tsam yang de rnams mchod pa'i yan lag khyad par can du 'gyur te/ phyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas dngos grub 'byung ba bzhin/

de rnams mchod pas mnyes nas dngos grub stsol ba yin te/ lam 'di'i sgrub pa po la rdzu 'phrul yid mgyogs lta bu'i shugs kyis byon nas byin gyis brlobs pas so/ /rtsa rgyud las kyang*/ yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang*/ /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/ /yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /ces so/ /'o na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang spyan drangs te lus la bstims pas/ de rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur ram/ lus dkyil nyid lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci snyam na/ spyir de la'ang byin rlabs 'byung mod kyi/ byin rlabs khyad par can 'jug pa la ni/ so sor nges pa'i bskyed chog dgos te/ lus thams cad mi bskyod par sgom pa tsam la'ang byin rlabs shig 'byung mod kyi/ de bas mi bskyod pa'i spyan la sa snying*/ snyan la phyag rdor sogs bkod na bzang ba bzhin no/ / des na khyad par can gyi byin rlabs yul nges pa so so la 'jug pa de tsam thun mong gi cho ga rnams la mi 'byung ngo*/ /skabs 'dir mnyes par byas pas/ spyod pa'i skabs su zhing rnams su song ba na/ sngags skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma khyad par can rnams dang dang por 'du ba rnyed/ des bskul nas zhing skyes ma dang 'phrad cing*/ de bsten pas de la brten nas lhan skyes ma rnams bskul nus pas/ de dang mjal ba tsam gyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ lam 'di bsgom pa byin rlabs ches myur te/ /las dang po 'ang pho nya mchog rnams kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs te ma mo'i tshogs 'dus pa/ /stobs med ma tshogs rnal 'byor pas mi smad/ /lam 'di'i yon tan pha mtha' brjod byed na/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i tshig mchog grub par byos/ /'dren pa rnams kyi mthu yang bas gyur na/ /blo ldan gang zhig 'di yi tshad 'jal byed/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bde mchog bstod chen gyi rang 'grel phan bde'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i stod cha bzhugs/ -PAGE 346--PAGE 347--PAGE 31-
